news.Title: 台灣IC設計變差？聯發科陳冠州駁斥：我們比5年前強太多
news.Content:
台灣半導體產業協會（TSIA）今（29）日舉辦30周年年會論壇，台積電、聯發科、日月光與鈺創等業界巨頭齊聚，針對台灣半導體前景展開深度對談。鈺創董事長盧超群坦言憂心台灣 IC 設計與微系統能力逐漸退步，無法掌握 AI 資料中心關鍵趨勢，聯發科總經理陳冠州反駁，聯發科競爭力比5年前強非常多，其實台灣IC設計並非全面轉弱，只是過去靠「價格便宜、低成本」的舊勝利方程式已成過去式，產業關鍵在於是否有眼光提早布局。

台灣半導體產業協會（TSIA） 30周年年會論壇邀集台積電資深副總經理侯永清、聯發科總經理陳冠州、日月光半導體研發總經理李俊哲，以及鈺創董事長盧超群等重量級大老展開深度對談。

鈺創董事長盧超群坦言，台灣在半導體製造、封裝及設備材料上根基穩固，但他心中始終有深沉的擔憂：「我們半導體設計越來越差，包括 AI 資料中心（Data Center）這塊我們都無法掌握……我們一直對外說半導體很厲害，但我非常清楚，我們的集成電路很差，微系統（micro-system）也很差。」

面對盧超群的說法，聯發科總經理陳冠州並不這麼認為，他說，以聯發科為例，跟5年前相比，聯發科現在的競爭力強非常多，而且是全球布局，在全球喊話的力量比以前強非常多，能力也強非常多。

陳冠州直言，IC 設計並非全面轉弱，重點在於企業是否有眼光提早布局，「機會是給事先準備好的人。」

陳冠州指出，過去台灣半導體靠著「價格便宜、能做出品質接近但成本極低」的產品就能贏，「但這已經不再是我們的勝利方程式。」他透漏，聯發科目前積極參與國際標準制定，並全力布局 5G 與 6G 專利，搶先參與標準制定的好處在於能精準掌握上市時機（Timing）。

「我們現在賺的，不再是壓縮成本（Cost-down）的辛苦錢，而是搶攻市場先機（Time-to-market）的高價值利潤。」陳冠州強調，在產品生命週期剛啟動時切入，才能讓願意嘗鮮的客戶支付溢價（Price premium），為台灣產業創造更高的價值。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: Alphabet and Microsoft are on both sides of the AI boom's biggest bills: Chart of the Day
news.Content:
Wall Street bought Microsoft and sold Alphabet after the two reported quarterly earnings Wednesday night. Both rent computing power to the AI labs and own stakes in them, but this quarter Microsoft cashed in while Alphabet's bets cost it.

Microsoft ( MSFT ) stock rose about 2% after hours, while Alphabet ( GOOGL , GOOG ) fell nearly 10%, on track for its worst day since October 2023, after its sales came up short .

For Microsoft, the labs show up as sales. OpenAI paid it $10 billion in the quarter that ended in September, according to Microsoft's quarterly filing. That's about 11% of Microsoft's $92 billion in revenue, and more than its Xbox and Windows businesses brought in combined.

Some of that money is still owed. OpenAI's unpaid bills to Microsoft rose to about $7 billion from $6 billion three months earlier. Microsoft also owns about 24% of the ChatGPT maker, but the stake barely moved its profit this time.

The order book cooled, too. Microsoft's backlog — revenue customers have signed up for, but Microsoft hasn't yet booked — slipped to about $677 billion, and new bookings fell 12% from a year earlier. CFO Amy Hood blamed "large Azure commitments in the prior year" for the tough comparison.

Alphabet's bets on the labs worked the other way. Its stakes in other companies, including roughly 14% of Anthropic and a piece of SpaceX ( SPCX ), supplied about $6 of its $9.11 in per-share profit in the second quarter.

This time they cost it. A nearly $9 billion loss on those holdings cut earnings by $0.55 a share, to $2.12. CFO Anat Ashkenazi said on the call that the loss came "primarily" from SpaceX, whose stock dropped about 12% during the quarter.

Alphabet is also footing the bill to build. It spent $51 billion on data centers and equipment in the quarter, more than double a year earlier, and burned about $9 billion in free cash flow — the cash left after those investments — for a second straight quarter. Microsoft generated about $19 billion and said it expects to stay positive this fiscal year.

To cover the gap, Alphabet bought back no stock, sold about $29 billion of bonds and $12 billion of new shares, and nearly tripled its long-term debt this year to about $125 billion. Meta ( META ) took a similar route with its nearly $100 billion stock sale .

The payoff is showing up in Google Cloud, where revenue doubled to about $31 billion and the backlog of signed contracts rose to $561 billion from $514 billion three months earlier. Anthropic has committed at least $115 billion to Google for computing power, according to its IPO filing, about a fifth of that backlog by Yahoo Finance calculations.

Story Continues

The next swing could come from Anthropic itself. Its IPO could start trading as soon as Nov. 16 , and once it does, Alphabet's stake gets valued at the market price each quarter. At the reported $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion valuation, that could turn the drag back into a windfall by year-end.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella doesn't want to lean on the labs forever. Asked on the call where Azure's AI growth is coming from, he said he's after breadth, not "four customers who buy a lot of capacity from you and you can show a few quarters of growth."

"That's not a business as far as I'm concerned," he said.

news.Title: 友達第三季獲利由盈轉虧 法說會利空出盡？分析師看明日股價恐承壓
news.Content:
面板大廠友達（2409）今（29）日舉行法說會，第三季虧損25億元，第四季面板營收預估持續下滑，不過，同日也宣布以388億元出售廠房給台積電（2330），加上積極布局AI眼鏡、先進封裝等新事業，利多與利空消息交雜。明（30）日股價表現如何？證期雙證分析師翁偉捷認為，友達面板本業尚未看到明確復甦跡象，AI新事業也缺乏具體訂單及量產時程，短線股價恐面臨較大壓力。

友達今日股價震盪走低，早盤一度衝上36.65元，隨後賣壓出籠，最低下探33.85元，終場收在34.05元，跌幅約4.22%。

翁偉捷表示，從友達目前的營運狀況來看，面板本業仍難以獲利，全球消費性電子市場需求疲弱，即使面板報價沒有持續大幅下跌，出貨需求仍受到衝擊。他認為，友達本業目前處於低谷，何時能走出谷底仍缺乏明確方向，因此對後續營運看法相對保守。

此外，友達也宣布出售廠房給台積電，翁偉捷指出，賣廠代表公司正在縮減部分廠房規模，並透過處分資產換取現金。他認為，這項消息未必能完全視為利多，市場也可能擔憂公司本業經營及資金運用狀況，因此對短期股價的正面幫助仍有待觀察。

對於友達積極布局AI眼鏡、低軌衛星及半導體先進封裝，翁偉捷認為，這些確實符合未來產業趨勢，但投資人更在意的是，公司究竟有沒有明確的客戶訂單、出貨時間及量產計畫。他直言，「到目前為止，只有聽到題材，並沒有看到產品。」認為缺乏具體營收貢獻表現，市場仍難以評估轉型能否成功。

翁偉捷進一步指出，友達目前營收結構仍以面板業務為主，在本業尚未改善之前，即使市場因AI題材出現短線行情，股價上漲的延續性也可能有限。他表示，相較於提出多項新事業方向，友達更需要向投資人說明哪些產品已經取得訂單，以及未來何時能正式出貨。

展望明日股價，翁偉捷認為，若從基本面及目前已知消息判斷，友達短線股價承壓的可能性較高，但也不排除市場將法說會解讀為「利空出盡」，帶動短線反彈。他指出，實際漲跌仍取決於明日開盤後的市場情緒與資金反應，投資人仍須留意題材炒作帶來的波動風險。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: Nasdaq futures fall 1% as Alphabet results intensify AI spending fears
news.Content:
By Shashwat Chauhan

Oct 29 (Reuters) - Nasdaq futures fell about 1% on Thursday as Alphabet's results reignited concerns over mounting AI costs, while investors awaited a key inflation reading a day after the US Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged.

Alphabet shares ‌slid 10.2% in premarket trading, putting the Google parent on track to lose more than $400 billion in market value if ‌losses hold, after reporting disappointing search advertising results and a surge in cash burn as AI-related spending accelerated.

"Investors are starting to scrutinize monetization timelines versus the capital expenditure burn ​rates. Some investors are no longer giving all hyperscalers a 'free pass' to spend without limit," said Jeremy Saltzberg, VP and senior investment officer at Check Capital Management.

Microsoft, however, climbed 3.6% after the company delivered a big cash-flow beat and forecast strong cloud growth, offering fresh evidence that its hefty AI bets were working.

Investor enthusiasm for AI trade has been tempered this month by concerns that debt-fueled spending will be harder to justify as borrowing costs ‌climb. The unveiling of Anthropic's US IPO filing ⁠on Monday provided a short-lived reprieve, before worries over AI-related spending resurfaced.

Other early movers included cybersecurity firm Fortinet, which tumbled 25% after reporting third-quarter results. Software maker ServiceNow dropped 18.2% after missing third-quarter profit estimates.

Software-related companies such ⁠as Zscaler and Salesforce were among the laggards in sector-wide weakness.

Marvell Technology fell 9.7% after media reports said the company was in advanced talks to buy data-center optics maker Lumentum Holdings. Lumentum shares rose 4.2%.

Memory chipmaker Micron Technology dropped 3.3%, tracking weakness in rival Samsung Electronics after the South Korean company reported ​its ​earnings.

The broader semiconductor segment was trading lower, with Nvidia down about 0.7%, AMD ​sliding 2.8% and Intel off 3.7%.

Intel and Amazon are some ‌of the major technology companies scheduled to report after markets close on Thursday.

Earnings due before the opening bell include reports from drugmakers Merck and Eli Lilly, construction equipment maker Caterpillar and alternative investment managers Ares Management and Blue Owl.

At 05:18 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 267 points, or 0.51%, S&P 500 E-minis were down 20.5 points, or 0.26%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 303 points, or 1.01%.

Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday, as expected, opting to delay any changes to borrowing costs until after next week's US midterm elections ‌while it awaits further data on inflation.

Story Continues

"The decision to hold seems to be ​a short pause to assess ahead of a likely policy hike in December, rather ​than an indication that no further tightening is needed," said Jon ​Butcher, senior US economist at Aberdeen.

The market is now looking to the September Personal Consumption Expenditures report, the ‌Fed's preferred inflation gauge due later in the day, for ​insights into the central bank's next ​policy moves. The third-quarter GDP reading is also set for release.

Traders currently see a more than 81% chance the Fed will hike interest rates in December, according to the CME FedWatch Tool, as key inflation metrics remain elevated amid the oil shock linked ​to the Middle East conflict.

Money market participants are ‌pricing in an additional rate hike by mid-2027, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Among other stocks, car e-commerce platform Carvana ​jumped 7.8% after its third-quarter revenue surpassed estimates, while Chipotle Mexican Grill gained 6.7% after reporting better-than-expected quarterly comparable sales.

(Reporting ​by Shashwat Chauhan in Bengaluru; Editing by Mrigank Dhaniwala and Shilpi Majumdar)

news.Title: 外資轉賣超688億元　聯電跌停遭砍12.92萬張居榜首
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年10月29日電）台股今天下跌667.25點，三大法人合計賣超新台幣816.66億元，其中外資及陸資轉為賣超688.15億元，晶圓代工廠聯電在法人說明會後股價跌停，遭外資大舉調節12.92萬張登上榜首；面板雙虎及主動式ETF（指數股票型基金）也名列前茅。

台股今天開低走低，投資人觀望中東局勢和全球貨幣政策走向，電子類股及中小型股表現疲弱，指數盤中最低至46055.07點、重挫逾980點，終場收在46368.33點，下跌667.25點，跌幅1.42%，失守季線約46505點，成交金額達7891.52億元。

觀察外資今天賣超榜前10名，晶圓代工廠聯電 (2303) 在召開法說會後，今天爆量下殺至跌停115.5元，外資單日狂砍12.92萬張，高居賣超榜首。

面板族群同樣成為外資調節標的，友達 (2409) 遭減碼逾5.04萬張名列第3，群創 (3481) 也遭提款逾4.63萬張位居第4。

部分主動式ETF與傳產龍頭股也面臨外資拋售壓力。主動中信台灣收益（00406A）遭調節7.82萬張，主動統一升級50（00403A）遭賣超2.9萬張，主動統一台股增長（00981A）遭減碼2.62萬張；台玻 (1802) 遭砍1.46萬張。

反觀買超部分，外資轉向防禦型金融股與記憶體族群避險，買超前10名中金融及銀行股占5檔，包括台新新光金 (2887) 、中信金 (2891) 、彰銀 (2801) 、兆豐金 (2886) 、永豐金 (2890) 。記憶體雙雄華邦電 (2344) 、南亞科 (2408) 也上榜，分別獲外資買超1.43萬張、5661張。

news.Title: 友達決議中科廠售台積電　華亞廠出售廣達案終止
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年10月29日電）面板廠友達光電 (2409) 今天董事會通過出售中科廠，包括5代、7.5代廠售予台積電 (2330) ，行政程續完成時點恐落在明年以後；而先前董事會通過華亞廠不動產及其相關廠務附屬設施售予廣達電腦 (2382) ，因雙方對廠房使用規格及交付時程未達成協議，決議終止。

友達今天舉行線上法人說明會，由董事長彭(雙)浪說明資產活化、半導體先進封裝、光通訊等議題。他表示，隨著中科廠將出售給台積電，活化資產將告一段落；但中科廠將會繼續生產運作一段時間，與台積電完成交易行政程序，最快也是明年以後的事。

友達今天公告，台中市西屯區安林段共9筆建號的二期廠房及其相關廠務附屬設施，權狀面積42萬9030.19平方公尺，約12萬9781.63坪，使用面積約16.6萬坪，將出售給台灣積體電路製造公司，交易總金額新台幣388億元。

友達持續投資AI相關技術，繼今年前7月累計通過資本支出近240億元，今天董事會決議再增加資本支出57.28億元，為產線優化及創新研究院新技術布局。

彭(雙)浪強調，由於「光進銅退」，有各種通訊方案競爭，友達鎖定光互連需求，與富采 (3714) 合作，透過微型發光二極體（Micro LED）、VCSEL半導體雷射光源技術做元件；至於是否要做成共封裝光學模組（CPO），由客戶決定。他評估，Micro LED用於光通訊1至2年量產，2至3年貢獻營收。

至於Micro LED用於顯示器，彭(雙)浪強調，除手錶之外，還有更多可攜式裝置將採用，且透明顯示器已有車商在歐洲車展採用，進一步帶動友達Micro LED在車用顯示器的市場詢問度。

針對半導體先進封裝部分，彭(雙)浪表示，半導體封裝前段製程，從鑽孔到玻璃核心基板（Glass CoreSubstrate），不管鍍銅或重布線層（RDL）都有布局，與合作夥伴共同開發，尺寸規格從500x500到310x310都有。

對於半導體先進封裝投入時程，彭(雙)浪表示，無塵室是現成的，董事會雖已通過試產線預算，但許多設備目前還沒進來，時間還要再等等。

友達總經理張博儀表示，電視產品第3季雖有旺季備貨需求，但資訊電子產品（IT）受記憶體缺貨影響，終端產品漲價，消費者降低購買意願；預期第4季電視產品旺季備貨告一段落，而IT產品延續第3季狀況，第4季顯示器產品將較第3季續減，面板產線將維持按需生產節奏。

張博儀說，第3季車用市場也受地緣政治影響，中國從內需轉為出口導向，影響國際市場，預期第4季市場表現與第3季持平。另外，整合式的垂直場域業務因能源事業切割獨立，營收將會減少，但整體維持穩定。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: Why Microsoft stock isn't getting crushed like Google stock after its earnings report
news.Content:
While Alphabet's ( GOOGL ) stock is getting crushed on Thursday after earnings, Microsoft ( MSFT ) is getting a pass.

Another way of saying it: Microsoft shares aren't trading down in sympathy.

And there is one simple reason why this is the case.

Microsoft's quarter is being seen as one of higher-than-expected growth that is sustainable, while Alphabet's quarter was sluggish and hinted at slowing growth rates in coming quarters.

Microsoft's Azure sales growth came in about 300 basis points above analyst estimates. Overall sales for the important cloud business grew 48%, excluding currency fluctuations.

Execs guided to 49% to 50% Azure sales growth in the current quarter, ahead of consensus estimates by four percentage points.

The company's capex came in about $5 billion below estimates, and other parts of the business showed sales upside.

Sales and earnings for the quarter came in ahead of analyst forecasts.

"Net/net, these results increase our confidence in the company's ability to sustain mid/upper-teens revenue growth and that strong cost of goods sold/expense operational efficiencies should be supportive of expanding operating margins," said stifel analyst Brad Reback.

Microsoft shares rose 4% in pre-market trading.

Alphabet shares tanked 10% in pre-market trading after a third quarter that could best be characterized as a letdown, both on its own and versus Microsoft.

First, Google's search business notched sales of $63.4 billion, below the $64.9 billion expected. The miss fueled fears Google's search empire is being chipped away by the likes of Claude and ChatGPT, despite massive investment by Google.

Second, Google posted negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion versus a Wall Street estimate for negative $3.5 billion. In a market getting jittery about negative free cash flow at Big Tech (see the reaction to Meta's ( META ) results last week, when it also had negative free cash flow for the first time in years), Google's print stunk up the joint.

"Alphabet's 3Q results reinforced concerns we had heading into the print, re: Search is decelerating and margins have peaked near-term. This could create an air pocket over the next 1-2 quarters as investors await signs for whether this is transitory or structural," KeyBanc analyst Justin Patterson said.

Brian Sozzi is Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor, host of the Sozzi Unleashed morning show, the ' Power Players With Brian Sozzi' podcast and a member of Yahoo Finance's editorial leadership team.

news.Title: Alphabet, Microsoft earnings in focus; Warsh on AI, rates - what’s moving markets
news.Content:
Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices are mixed, as investors parsed through a fresh batch of megacap technology sector earnings and digested the Federal Reserve's latest interest rate announcement. Elsewhere, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh casts doubt over whether higher interest rates could impact runaway artificial intelligence spending.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

1. Nasdaq futures drop

Nasdaq futures, in particular, have slumped. By 04:03 ET (08:03 GMT), the Nasdaq futures contract had dropped by 400 points, or 1.3%, S&P 500 futures had declined by 36 points, or 0.5%, and Dow futures had climbed by 150 points, or 0.3%.

The main averages on Wall Street advanced in the prior session, buoyed by renewed belief in the AI trade following weeks of worry around debt-fueled spending and rising borrowing costs. A slew of new financing deals, solid earnings, and cloud-computing giant Oracle's pledge to limit fundraising through fiscal 2030 helped to support tech stocks.

However, echoing the often rollercoaster nature of AI sentiment, a more cautious tech mood was "the main theme in markets" on Thursday morning, analysts at Deutsche Bank said.

2. Alphabet falls

Denting optimism around the AI trade were "underwhelming results" from Google-parent Alphabet, the Deutsche Bank analysts flagged.

Shares of the search titan plummeted by more than 10% in premarket U.S. trading after its third-quarter missed expectations, largely because of disappointing revenue from Google's services unit.

Google's typically mighty ad revenue also grew at its slowest pace in five quarters, exacerbating fears around the possible returns the company will eventually reap from its massive AI spending plans. In a call with investors, Google management said that while users were embracing its "AI Mode" search option, these queries have been monetized at a slower rate than traditional searches.

At the same time, free cash flow fell deeper into negative territory, reflecting a $6.5 billion increase in capital expenditures versus the prior quarter to $51.4 billion. Like its Big Tech peers, Alphabet has invested heavily in rapidly building out its AI capabilities, dedicating hundreds of billions of dollars to the development of the nascent technology.

3. Samsung's chip division profit misses estimates

Meanwhile, Samsung Electronics posted operating profit in its key semiconductor division that fell short of analysts' lofty expectations. In Korean trading, shares of Samsung retreated by more than 4% -- slightly trimming a meteoric rise in the stock so far this year.

Story Continues

Samsung also offered no new details about a possible shareholder return plan, overshadowing a fourth straight quarter of record group-wide income. Overall operating profit came in at 100 trillion won, or around $74.52 billion.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Executives at the company also told investors that next year's supply of memory chips is already fully booked, thanks to soaring demand for the processors needed to help power cutting-edge AI systems. Samsung, the world's biggest producer of memory chips, counts Nvidia and other large AI infrastructure names as clients.

Indeed, demand is so strong that Samsung warned that tightness in the memory-chip market will continue for the next few years, likely driving up prices as a result.

4. Microsoft rises amid cloud unit strength

Microsoft, on the other hand, gained in premarket trading. The software behemoth reported that growth at its all-important cloud division accelerated once again, possibly soothing jitters around returns from massive AI investments.

Underpinned by 48% expansion in the Azure cloud unit, Microsoft logged better-than-anticipated overall revenue growth of 19% to $92.28 billion in the first quarter.

Adjusted profit for the quarter stood at $4.89 a share, also above Wall Street expectations. Earlier this week, Microsoft said that it would offer buyouts to a big chunk of its workforce, with The Wall Street Journal reporting that roughly 60,000 employees may be eligible for the program. Microsoft's headcount was 223,000 workers at the end of June.

The Deutsche Bank analysts said that, despite being generally upbeat, Microsoft's returns were "insufficient to brighten the overall gloomy tech mood this morning." More tech earnings are due out after the bell, including returns from Amazon and Intel.

5. Warsh flags potential impact of elevated rates on AI

Further adding to this glum feeling was Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who presented new doubts around the AI trade's ability to withstand higher interest rates.

AI companies have recently turned to bond and equity markets to fund their ambitions, turning away from a prior strategy of relying on cash flows. In turn, concerns have risen around the impact of a possible uptick in borrowing costs by central banks eager to quell inflationary pressures.

Speaking after the Fed left interest rates unchanged as anticipated on Wednesday, Warsh said that although there was once a narrative that tighter monetary policy was "not going to have any effect on AI because the returns that investors are expecting are so different," he has been "skeptical of that view."

"Interest rates get in the cracks. Interest rates affect, directly or indirectly, almost everything," Warsh said. Markets widely anticipate that the Fed will hike rates in December, after having lifted borrowing costs for the first time since 2023 in September.

Beyond the Fed, the European Central Bank will announce its own interest rate decision later today.

news.Title: 友達桃園華亞廠房 廣達不買了 破局原因曝光
news.Content:
友達（2409）賣廠案一成一敗！原訂以197億元出售桃園華亞科技園區廠房給廣達（2382），因雙方對廠房使用規格及交付時程始終無法達成共識，今（29）日正式宣布終止交易。不過，友達同日也拍板另一筆重大資產處分案，將台中二期廠房及相關廠務設施以388億元出售給台積電（2330），預估可認列約185億元處分利益。友達董事長彭双浪表示，公司今年陸續推動廠區處分，經整體評估後，剩餘廠房空間已達適當配置，現階段資產活化工作告一段落。

197億購廠案喊卡

廣達原於今年7月28日經董事會及審計委員會通過收購友達華亞廠房，交易金額為197億元，標的包含桃園龜山約1.97萬坪土地、約4.93萬坪建物及相關附屬設備。廣達原規劃透過購廠支應2028年以後的AI產品訂單需求，並預計於2027年第4季完成點交，盼進一步擴大台灣AI伺服器後段組裝產能。然而，雙方經多次協商，仍無法就廠房使用規格與交付時程取得共識，最終決定終止交易。廣達強調，取消收購對AI伺服器後段組裝產能沒有影響，現階段資本支出規劃也沒有新的變動；友達則表示，終止交易對公司財務及業務並無影響，後續將另尋合適買家。

友達388億出售中科廠

相較於華亞廠交易告吹，友達出售台中二期廠房給台積電的案子順利拍板。根據公告，交易標的位於台中市西屯區，包含5代廠、7.5代廠、無塵室及相關廠務附屬設施，建物權狀面積約12.98萬坪，使用面積約16.6萬坪，交易總金額388億元。友達指出，交易價格參考市場行情及專業估價報告，兩家估價機構估值分別為387.5億元及385.39億元；扣除相關交易費用及預估稅費後，預估處分利益約185億元，款項將依不動產買賣契約約定分期支付。

資產活化告一段落

友達董事長彭双浪表示，出售廠房主要是為了聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產並優化財務結構。經整體評估，公司現有廠房空間已達適當配置，因此現階段資產活化告一段落，未來將把出售廠房回收的資金投入策略性及未來發展項目，支持公司轉型與新事業布局。值得注意的是，友達第3季營收668.8億元，季減5.7%、年減4.3%，本業營業淨損23.7億元，歸屬母公司業主淨損25億元，每股虧損0.33元。在面板需求降溫、本業轉虧之際，資產處分能否進一步改善財務結構，以及新事業布局後續成效，將成為市場關注焦點。

news.Title: 記憶體飆漲新手機變貴　OPPO：產業壓力恐持續至2028年
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年10月29日電）記憶體成本攀升，手機價格面臨漲價壓力。OPPO今天在台發表Find X10系列，頂規版本售價新台幣5.89萬元，OPPO表示，今年記憶體供應鏈變化大，對手機產業造成影響，研調判斷記憶體漲價壓力明年恐持續，並延續至2028年，但OPPO現售機型沒有漲價計畫。

OPPO今天在台發表Find X10系列，搭載聯發科技天璣9600系列晶片，以及全球第一款3顆2億哈蘇鏡頭，預計11月2日全台通路開賣。

聯發科技資深副總經理徐敬全表示，聯發科技與OPPO長期深化技術合作，Find X10 Pro Max搭載天璣9600 Pro，以AI原生架構與台積電2奈米製程，為高解析影像處理與AI創作提供算力。

由於OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 16B、512GB版本售價達5萬8990元，較上一代相比漲幅不小，OPPO台灣市場總經理劉金表示，今年記憶體供應鏈變化大，對整體手機產業造成影響，但現售產品無漲價計畫，會與供應鏈緊密配合優化資源，透過策略性成本管控維持價格穩定且不缺貨。

劉金表示，OPPO今年在台灣銷售市占「穩中有升」，截至今年前9月，銷售額年增約15%至20%，主因高階與中高階熱銷機型帶動。

他表示，儘管價格調漲，但規格升級有感，預估Find X10系列銷售目標比較前一代銷量增15%至20%，預測既有用戶升級會占50%至60%。

針對記憶體零組件漲價趨勢看法，他分享，研調機構認為，記憶體漲價壓力明年可能會持續存在，且這波漲價週期可能延續至2028 年，OPPO將調整產品組合與差異化策略，確保在台灣市場長期競爭力。

news.Title: Google財報利空衝擊台股重挫667點再失季線！聯電法說會變法會 智原穩懋連兩根漲停逆勢高飛｜Yahoo財經掃描
news.Content:
AI疑慮再起、電子股倒一片，台股下挫667點再失季線！今(29)日加權指數終場下跌667.25點、跌幅1.42%，收46,368.33點，成交金額7,904.13億元。Google母公司Alphabet盤後財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對AI投資回收與科技股估值的疑慮，電子權值股賣壓湧現，大盤一度重挫980.51點，尾盤跌幅逐步收斂。

台積電(2330)尾盤獲買單拉抬，終場下跌10元、跌幅0.41%，收2,415元；聯發科(2454)重挫4.49%，台達電(2308)下跌4.52%，鴻海(2317)、日月光投控(3711)分別走弱逾1%。昨日召開法說會的聯電(2303)未獲利多加持，跌停收115.5元，玉晶光(3406)也觸及跌停，熱門電子股普遍承壓。盤面仍有個股逆勢突圍，穩懋(3105)受SpaceX訂單與光通訊布局題材激勵，智原(3035)則因取得大型2奈米雲端AI訂單，雙雙連兩日漲停；誠美材(4960)、東台(4526)也因切入半導體與先進封裝供應鏈的轉型題材受到關注。電子類股指數下跌1.74%，櫃買指數下挫1.83%，金融類股指數則逆勢上漲1.05%，呈現電子走弱、金融撐盤的格局。

亞洲市場漲跌互見，日經指數上漲1.10%，韓國綜合指數則下跌1.24%，香港恆生指數下跌0.59%，上海綜合指數下跌0.82%。

📝盤點熱門股：主動中信台灣收益、聯電、友達

熱門成交榜前五名全數收黑，ETF包辦三席，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)以78.70萬張奪冠，昨日反彈後今日走弱、失守9元，價格反覆震盪，買賣換手熱絡；群益臺灣加權正2(00685L)、元大台灣50正2(00631L)也同步回落，隨大盤震盪，槓桿型ETF交投持續活躍。

個股方面，排名第二的晶圓代工股聯電(2303)法說會釋出明年晶圓平均售價可望成長一成、追加32億美元資本支出等消息，仍難抵賣壓，終場重挫跌停，爆量交易成為盤面焦點。排名第三的面板股友達(2409)，在前一日外資回補與法說會登場之際，CPO、扇出型封裝等轉型進展受到關注，買賣熱絡但股價明顯回落；分析師提醒，外資買盤可能偏向短線回補，後續仍須有新利多支撐。

📌三大法人買賣超

三大法人今日合計賣超816.66億元，其中，外資大舉賣超688.15億元，成為法人賣壓主力；自營商同步賣超215億元，投信則逆勢買超86.49億元。整體來看，外資與自營商聯手減碼，投信雖站在買方，仍難抵銷兩者賣超力道。

✨本日議題股：法說會變法會股-聯電、精測

法說行情一夕變「法會」！精測(6510)、聯電(2303)昨才隨大盤反攻，今日卻雙雙遭遇賣壓。精測昨日攻上3200元漲停，今早一度重挫8.44%至2930元，終場收跌停，亮眼財報仍難撐住股價；聯電則在法說會釋出2027年晶圓平均售價可望成長約一成、追加32億美元資本支出等消息後，股價反而摜至115.5元跌停...... 點我看更多

news.Title: Google stock gets shredded after earnings—here's 2 reasons why investors hated the quarter
news.Content:
Sizzling Google Cloud growth of 103% isn't going to cut it for Alphabet ( GOOGL ) bulls the day after earnings.

Alphabet shares tanked 10% in pre-market trading on Thursday after a third quarter that could best be characterized as a letdown.

The Street is locked in on two aspects of the quarter.

First, Google's search business notched sales of $63.4 billion, below the $64.9 billion expected. The miss fueled fears Google's search empire is being chipped away by the likes of Claude and ChatGPT, despite massive investment by Google.

Second, Google posted negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion versus a Wall Street estimate for negative $3.5 billion. In a market getting jittery about negative free cash flow at Big Tech (see the reaction to Meta's ( META ) results last week, when it also had negative free cash flow for the first time in years), Google's print stunk up the joint.

"The bears will argue this is the first quarter that AI is starting to seriously hurt their search business and perhaps YouTube is facing some content monetization issues. Our view is that clearly there is some effect from consumers interacting with less advertising when they go to Google search and use Google AI (1B AI users and queries are at a 5 year high) as Google transitions to a world of AI and inevitably AI agents," Pivotal Research CEO Jeffrey Wlodarczak said.

Overall, Alphabet delivered a rare double-miss in its third-quarter earnings report, posting $127.57 billion in revenue against Wall Street's $128.2 billion consensus estimate.

Bottom-line results disappointed significantly as earnings per share fell to $2.12, badly missing analyst projections of $3.02 per share.

Brian Sozzi is Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor, host of the Sozzi Unleashed morning show, the ' Power Players With Brian Sozzi' podcast and a member of Yahoo Finance's editorial leadership team.

news.Title: Stock market today: Dow rises, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures fall as Alphabet stock sells off, AI jitters return
news.Content:
US stock futures diverged in premarket trading on Thursday as Alphabet's Q3 earnings sparked a sell-off in the stock and AI jitters returned to markets, dragging on the tech-heavy indexes.

Futures on the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( YM=F ) rose 0.3%. Those on the S&P 500 ( ES=F ) slid 0.4%, while contracts for the Nasdaq-100 ( NQ=F ) fell 1.3%.

Tech stocks snapped a positive run this week as investors digested the Fed's rate pause on Wednesday and earnings from Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Alphabet ( GOOG , GOOGL ). Microsoft beat analyst expectations on the top and bottom lines, while Alphabet sales came up short . Although Google posted cloud growth of 103%, concerns about its free cash flow and AI return on investment were the albatross on the company's quarter.

A sell-off in AI names spread to Asian markets as South Korea's Kospi ( ^KS11 ) index declined. The iShares Semiconductor Index ETF ( SOXX ) also skidded after hours as Nvidia ( NVDA ), AMD ( AMD ), Micron ( MU ), and other chip stocks fell.

Markets will get another dose of hyperscaler earnings after the bell on Thursday when Amazon ( AMZN ) reports results. Several other big corporations, including Eli Lilly ( LLY ), Mastercard ( MA ), Intel ( INTC ), Caterpillar ( CAT ), and Anheuser-Busch InBev ( BUD ), will also provide insight into the AI trade and other facets of the economy.

A day after the Fed's interest rate decision, investors will also be treated to inflation data by way of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index, which is expected to rise 3.1% on a core basis.

news.Title: 【公告】創意續租賃采鈺科技廠房半年作為EDA機房使用
news.Content:

news.Title: 聯發科為AI痛心疾首！總座陳冠州：全年預算「兩個月就花光」只能一直追加
news.Content:
半導體大廠聯發科（2454）總經理暨營運長陳冠州今（29）日在半導體協會演講，分享從 IC 設計公司視角看台灣半導體生態系的優勢與轉型。他強調，面對龐大的 AI 生態系，台灣絕對不能做「封閉式生態系」，而是要積極嵌入全球最大的生態系「打群架」，但也為了AI痛心疾首，「去年編的全年AI預算，兩個月就花光了，只能一直追加。」

陳冠州今天出席半導體協會30周年活動，他在演講中回顧，科技產業從 15 年前的桌上型電腦，一路演變到智慧型手機，再到現在最熱門的 AI 浪潮，整個產業賺錢的模式正在大翻轉。過去在電腦時代，規格大多由國外大廠說了算，台灣廠商能發揮的空間很有限；到了手機時代，聯發科成功躍升為全球主要的晶片大廠，讓台灣在核心零組件上賺到了更高的利潤與價值。

如今邁入AI 時代，產業遊戲規則徹底改變。國際雲端科技巨頭每年動輒砸上幾千億台幣投資，甚至紛紛投入研發自家專用的特殊晶片。陳冠州指出，這帶來了全新的客製化晶片（ASIC）商機，客戶需要的是能彈性設計、又能幫他們快速量產上市的服務，這正是聯發科與台灣半導體供應鏈搶攻高獲利的絕佳時機。

「今年是 AI 應用全面大爆發的一年！」陳冠州分析，未來的服務型態將不再是打開手機裡的應用程式商店下載 App，而是進入「身邊到處都有 AI 幫手（Agent）」的時代。從眼鏡、手機裡的生活小幫手，到雲端的大型伺服器，各式各樣的 AI 幫手無所不在，這也帶動了從個人裝置到雲端算力的龐大需求。

談到技術投資，陳冠州直言：「沒有一家公司能包辦所有技術」，必須採取跨界打群架策略，但聯發科在核心關鍵技術上絕不退縮。除了最先進的 2 奈米晶片製造與高階晶片封裝技術外，伺服器的核心就在於「算得快」與「傳得快」。聯發科在晶片之間的高速連線技術上扎根極深，目前的主流規格已獲客戶高度肯定，下一代更快的連線技術也在如火如荼開發中，並持續朝向結合光纖傳輸的新技術邁進。

「把一堆偉大的技術塞進產品，不代表產品就會偉大。」陳冠州也分享了聯發科的核心產品哲學，並強調，好的產品設計必須從實際使用體驗出發，了解使用者真正要在什麼情境下用、需要處理多大的資料量，以及每用一點電能發揮多少算力，這種整體系統架構的能力，是台灣產業必須持續加強的硬實力。

此外，聯發科內部正全面推動用 AI 來幫忙設計晶片、寫軟體以及改善生產良率。陳冠州幽默笑稱，用 AI 提高生產力已被證實非常有效，但也讓他「痛心疾首」，「去年編今年的 AI 預算，結果發現兩個月就花光了，只能一直追加！」

為了因應龐大的算力花費與資訊安全，聯發科目前也積極建立「智慧分流」機制：碰到複雜艱難的工作才交給昂貴的大型 AI 模型處理，簡單的工作則透過公司內部自己改進的小型模型來做，既能精打細算、省下龐大預算，又能打造安全的 AI 運作環境。陳冠州強調，擁抱 AI 研發流程已是不可逆的趨勢，期許聯發科與台灣半導體產業能攜手在全球生態系中持續轉型、再創高峰。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 算力暴增、量產縮減至3個月 台積發哥示警：台廠須打群架轉型系統解方
news.Content:
台灣半導體產業協會（TSIA）29日舉辦30週年年會，在聚焦如何鞏固台灣半導體優勢的論壇中，台積電業務開發副總經理袁立本與聯發科總經理陳冠州同台開講，指出AI產業已正式跨入以商業落地為主的規模化量產週期，算力需求飆升100倍、開發與量產週期卻遭極限壓縮，傳統單打獨鬥的代工思維已不足以應對，台灣供應鏈必須提早展開跨領域共同設計，從晶片製造轉型為全球AI系統整合解方提供者。

袁立本指出，2025年起AI產業徹底告別實驗室驗證，邁入大規模部署的工業化階段，重心轉向企業級AI代理、超大規模資料中心與實體機器人。在傳統伺服器時代，從晶片設計到資料中心部署動輒需要2年；如今AI伺服器上市週期被砍到只剩1年，樣品出爐到正式量產更僅剩短短3個月，產能爬坡的速度要求達到前所未有的極限。

不僅時程壓縮，硬體工程挑戰難度也暴增，袁立本說明，AI單機櫃功耗已從40千瓦一路暴衝至230千瓦，未來甚至上看600千瓦以上，散熱技術被迫全面由氣冷轉向水冷。他強調，面對晶片、載板、光學與散熱模組的極限架構，全世界只有台灣擁有從最前端晶圓製造到後端伺服器組裝的最完整聚落，產業鏈必須在研發初期就啟動「共同設計（Co-innovation）」，才能在首波驗證中一次過關，將地理群聚轉化為難以取代的生態系護城河。

陳冠州表示，AI推論運算正加速從雲端向終端邊緣裝置擴散，應用型態也由App模式全面走向AI代理（AI Agent）服務架構，隨著各大雲端服務巨頭積極投入客製化ASIC晶片開發，IC設計端必須具備高度彈性與極速量產的支援能力。

技術推進上，聯發科除跟進2奈米、A16先進製程，結合2.5D與3D先進封裝，更聚焦200G、400G超高速光電互聯技術，以解決伺服器內部與外部龐大的資料傳輸瓶頸。

陳冠州更透露，AI技術已全面反哺至IC設計流程，聯發科內部正全力打造AI原生（AI-native）研發架構。儘管導入大型模型讓算力預算不斷暴增、甚至編列2個月就宣告超支，但面對產業極速迭代的壓力，全面擁抱AI提升研發產能已是無可逆轉的生存關鍵。

news.Title: Nasdaq futures slide as mixed Big Tech results test AI trade
news.Content:
By Shashwat Chauhan

Oct 29 (Reuters) - Nasdaq futures dropped on Thursday as mixed earnings from Alphabet and Microsoft left investors weighing the payoff from heavy AI spending, with focus also on an inflation reading a day ‌after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged.

Alphabet slid 10.5% in premarket trading after the company reported disappointing ‌results in the core business of search advertising and a massive acceleration in cash burn as it poured resources into building out AI.

"Investors are starting ​to scrutinize monetization timelines versus the capital expenditure burn rates. Some investors are no longer giving all hyperscalers a 'free pass' to spend without limit," said Jeremy Saltzberg, VP and senior investment officer at Check Capital Management.

On the other hand, Microsoft climbed 3.5% after the company delivered a big cash-flow beat and forecast strong cloud growth, offering fresh evidence that its hefty AI bets were working.

Other early movers ‌included cybersecurity firm Fortinet, which tumbled 25.4% ⁠after reporting third-quarter results. Software maker ServiceNow dropped 19% after missing third-quarter profit estimates.

Other software-related companies, including Zscaler and Salesforce, were among the laggards in sector-wide weakness.

Marvell Technology fell 9.4% after media reports ⁠said the company is in advanced talks to buy data-center optics maker Lumentum Holdings. Lumentum shares rose 4.3%.

Marvell and Lumentum did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

The broader semiconductor space was trading lower, with Nvidia down 1%, AMD sliding 3.3% and Intel off ​3.6%.

Intel ​and Amazon are some of the major tech companies reporting after ​markets close on Thursday.

On the earnings docket before the ‌bell are drugmakers Merck and Eli Lilly, construction equipment maker Caterpillar, and alternative investment managers Ares Management and Blue Owl.

At 4:09 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 185 points, or 0.35%, and S&P 500 E-minis were down 31 points, or 0.41%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 365 points, or 1.22%.

Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday, as expected, opting to delay any changes to borrowing costs until after next week's US midterm elections while it awaits further data on inflation.

"The ‌decision to hold seems to be a short pause to assess ahead ​of a likely policy hike in December, rather than an indication that ​no further tightening is needed," said Jon Butcher, a ​senior US economist at Aberdeen.

Story Continues

Focus will be on the September Personal Consumption Expenditures report, the Fed's ‌preferred inflation gauge, due later in the day. A ​third-quarter GDP reading is also set ​for release.

Traders currently see a more than 81% chance the Fed will hike interest rates in December, as per the CME FedWatch Tool, as key inflation metrics remain elevated amid the oil shock caused by the Middle East ​conflict.

Money market participants are also pricing an ‌additional rate hike by mid-2027, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Among other stocks, car e-commerce platform Carvana jumped ​9.2% after its third-quarter revenue surpassed estimates, while Chipotle Mexican Grill gained 6.7% after reporting better-than-expected quarterly comparable ​sales.

(Reporting by Shashwat Chauhan in Bengaluru; Editing by Mrigank Dhaniwala)

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉Fed按兵不動 三大指數走低
news.Content:
中國股市A股三大指數周四（29日）收盤走低，美國聯準會（Fed）如市場預期維持利率不變，主席華許重申對抗通膨的決心，但Fed官員未明確暗示12月是否升息。

上證指數周四收報3,651.43點，跌0.82%。深證成指收報11,138.20點，跌2.92%。創業板指收報2,517.59點，跌4.45%。

美國聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）周三以 10 票贊成、2 票反對，決議將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.75%～4%。Fed 先前於 9 月升息 1 碼（25個基點），為 2023 年以來首次升息。

此次決策大致符合市場預期。芝商所FedWatch 工具的數據顯示，會前利率期貨交易反映Fed 維持利率不變的機率接近 93%。

華許在會後記者會表示，即使Fed官員本次暫停升息，仍聚焦於「物價穩定」，並形容就業情勢「相當正面」。他強調官員已清楚表明隨時準備依情勢採取行動。

不過，Fed 並未就 12 月是否升息給出明確訊號。決策官員在聲明中表示，希望美國接下來公布的數據能為下一次決策提供依據。

華許另宣布，Fed 將逐步調整會議安排，規劃明年八次會議中，有七次進行利率決策表決。富國銀行投資研究所認為，此舉符合華許減少前瞻指引、降低向市場釋出訊號頻率的方向。

news.Title: Will Moderna Soar on Nov. 6?
news.Content:
Biotech stock Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) has soared in the triple digits this year, powering past even some of the market's biggest artificial intelligence (AI) players such as Nvidia and Micron Technology . AI has been the space fueling S&P 500 momentum over the past three years, so it may seem surprising to see a healthcare player surpassing the tech giants.

But Moderna has attracted investor attention for good reason. The company is an expert in the high-potential messenger RNA technology -- a technology that Moderna proved could work when it won approval for its coronavirus vaccine in the early days of the pandemic. And Moderna is advancing successfully along the path to treating one of today's biggest healthcare challenges: cancer. The company's personalized cancer vaccine is involved in 10 clinical trials, including a phase 3 study in melanoma that recently delivered strong results.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Now, with a fresh catalyst coming up on Nov. 6, you may be wondering if this exciting biotech stock will take off once again. Let's find out.

Image source: Getty Images.

Moderna's first commercialized product

We'll start with a little background on Moderna. You may know the company best for its coronavirus vaccine , a product that defined it just a few years ago. That's because it was the company's first commercialized product, used Moderna's mRNA technology, and brought in billion-dollar revenue.

Times have changed, though, with demand for vaccines declining in later pandemic days -- and that hurt Moderna's growth. But this biotech never intended to rely on one vaccine, and today it's proving this. Moderna has since won approval of additional respiratory vaccines and has a full pipeline, with a focus on oncology and rare diseases. Pipeline candidates use mRNA technology, which involves teaching the body to make a particular protein to protect against or fight disease. The protein to be made depends on the illness.

In recent months, investors have paid close attention to one program in particular, and that's oncology. As mentioned, Moderna's intismeran autogene is being studied in several trials, and the one that's in the spotlight right now is the farthest along in development: a combination of intismeran autogene and Merck 's Keytruda in melanoma treatment. The companies released preliminary results in August, showing the combo met key survival goals, and Moderna stock surged 177% in one trading session.

Story Continues

A data leak sparks stock declines

In recent days, a data leak from that trial sparked a decline in Moderna stock. But the full release confirmed August's positive results, suggesting that some investors may have taken the occasion to lock in gains. Meanwhile, investors also may be wondering whether the Moderna candidate will be as successful in other types of cancer -- studies are ongoing.

Now, let's consider the potential catalyst ahead. Moderna is scheduled to report third-quarter earnings on Nov. 6. The company, after suffering as coronavirus vaccine demand declined, has taken measures to adjust costs and has made progress on the path to recovery. In the second quarter, Moderna reiterated that it may generate as much as 10% revenue growth this year. Investors will look for any additional guidance on this point in the upcoming report as well as any comments on the company's newest release: its flu vaccine, which launched last month.

Clues from management about what's ahead

But the most important focus likely will be any comments on the oncology opportunity . Moderna's personalized cancer vaccine could be a game changer, particularly if it works for many types of cancer. It may be too early today to determine this, as trials are ongoing, but investors will look for any clues from management. It's also key to remember that a personalized vaccine presents certain challenges when it comes to manufacturing and rollout -- it may be slower and more expensive to launch than a one-size-fits-all product.

Considering Moderna just delivered the latest data from the melanoma phase 3 trial, I wouldn't expect anything completely new during the earnings report. But any general commentary could impact investor appetite for the stock.

That said, I don't expect Moderna stock to soar right after the Nov. 6 earnings report. Instead, I think the next big leg up could happen ahead of a fresh data report or milestone regarding the personalized cancer vaccine candidate. Meanwhile, growth-oriented investors might take advantage of any dip or stagnation to add a few shares of this biotech to their portfolios.

news.Title: Uh-Oh! A New Inflation Forecast Suggests Trumpflation Is Evolving and Worsening.
news.Content:
For the better part of the nearly six years Donald Trump has been president, the stock market has thrived. The average annual return of the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES:^DJI), S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC), and Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) under Trump is higher than under most other presidents over the last 130 years.

While the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out and Trump's Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which permanently lowered the peak marginal corporate income tax rate from 35% to 21%, have been well-received by Wall Street, not all of Trump's policies are viewed favorably by investors.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

President Trump's policies are directly influencing consumer prices. Image source: Official White House Photo by Andrea Hanks, courtesy of the National Archives.

There's arguably no bigger headwind for the stock market than elevated inflation -- and no catalyst behind above-average inflation that's more prominent than President Trump's policies. Although headline inflation has retraced from its May 2026 high, a new forecast suggests that Trumpflation is evolving and worsening .

Two of President Trump's policies have lit a fire under consumer prices

A modest level of inflation (rising prices) is expected when the U.S. economy is expanding. But with the Consumer Price Index (i.e., headline inflation) surging to 4.2% in May, a three-year high, it's evident that other factors are at play.

In addition to the AI infrastructure build-out lifting consumer prices, two of President Trump's policies -- tariffs and the Iran war -- are directly boosting inflation.

According to a newly released report ("How Fast Do Tariffs Pass Through into Consumer Prices") by three New York Federal Reserve economists writing for Liberty Street Economics, the president's tariffs have increased goods price inflation by 2.9 percentage points as of February 2026.

Adding duties to imported goods risks increasing domestic production costs and passes the tariff hike almost directly onto consumers.

Meanwhile, the ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz, triggered by the Iran war, has disrupted the daily movement of about 20 million barrels of petroleum liquids. Gas and diesel prices have soared in the wake of this closure.

Image source: Getty Images.

Story Continues

Trumpflation is evolving, and that's a huge problem

The issue for the stock market and consumers is that the Iran war is no longer just a story about energy supply disruption. According to the Federal Reserve's latest October inflation update (as of Oct. 23), Trumpflation is evolving and worsening.

On the one hand, the October headline inflation forecast, courtesy of the Cleveland Fed's Inflation Nowcasting tool, moderated slightly from the previous update to 3.75% from 3.77%. Unfortunately, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE), is headed in the wrong direction.

Core PCE excludes volatile food and energy costs, providing economists with a clearer picture of long-term price trends. After three consecutive months at 3%, forecasts call for Core PCE to climb to 3.05% in September and 3.13% in October.

Though these increases are modest, they signal an evolution of Trumpflation. In other words, we're likely seeing Iran-war-driven inflation reaching the broader economy. This means everything from altered shipping routes to higher input costs for petroleum-based products (e.g., plastics) is hitting consumers' wallets.

The more Trumpflation evolves and becomes entrenched in the U.S. economy, the more likely it is that the Fed will get more aggressive with interest rate hikes. This is a potential worst-case scenario for a historically expensive stock market driven by debt financing amid the AI data center build-out.

news.Title: Fed持續升息必要性下降 「鉅亨買基金」看好美股基金布局時機
news.Content:
受國際油價持續攀升，美國通膨再升溫，聯準會(Fed)升息卻可能近尾聲！知名基金平台「鉅亨買基金」今(29)日表示，儘管能源價格上漲增添通膨壓力，但美國就業市場明顯降溫，企業招聘趨緩卻未出現大規模裁員，顯示經濟仍具韌性，Fed持續升息的必要性正在下降，據歷史經驗顯示，若經濟成功軟著陸，停止升息後美股一年平均上漲23%，建議可將美國股票基金納入配置並分批布局，以掌握中長期成長機會。

鉅亨買基金投資研究部主管羅瑤庭指出，油價上漲是聯準會難以鬆手的主要原因，以美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率由8月3.4%升至3.7%，能源價格年增率較前月增加4.3個百分點，成為推升通膨的主要力量。

此外，羅瑤庭強調，包括二手車、交通運輸服務及房租價格漲幅也同步擴大，核心CPI年增率亦增加0.1個百分點，能源價格若持續維持高檔，不僅增加企業營運成本，也可能延緩通膨回落至2%目標的速度，讓聯準會維持緊縮政策更長時間。

不過，與通膨升溫形成對比的是，美國就業市場已逐漸降溫，美國9月非農就業僅新增2.9萬人，遠低於8月的13.3萬人，也不及過去12個月平均每月新增的4.5萬人，反映企業聘僱需求明顯轉弱，但9月失業率仍維持在4.2%，首次申請失業救濟金人數也未明顯攀升。

羅瑤庭分析，此顯示美國勞動市場呈現「低招聘、低裁員」特徵，代表企業雖放緩擴編，卻未全面縮減人力，有助降低通膨壓力，也讓聯準會有機會在不引發經濟衰退的情況下結束升息。

至於升息接近尾聲，美股就一定會漲嗎？羅瑤庭表示，關鍵在於經濟能否軟著陸。歷史統計顯示，若美國經濟成功軟著陸，標普500指數在停止升息後1、2年及3年的平均累積報酬，分別達23%、57%及93.1%，目前美國雖面臨能源價格推升通膨的挑戰，但就業市場尚未明顯惡化，加上AI投資與生產力提升支撐經濟成長，軟著陸機會仍相對較高，若未來油價回穩、通膨逐步降溫，企業獲利持續成長，將為美股中長期表現提供支撐。

羅瑤庭建議，投資人不必因油價上漲或聯準會短期利率決策而過度悲觀，但也不宜將停止升息視為股市立即上漲的保證，現階段應持續觀察能源價格、就業變化及企業獲利，並以分批投入取代一次性追高。

基金配置方面，羅瑤庭提醒，投資人可納入涵蓋多元產業的美國股票基金，並搭配台股及科技基金，參與AI長期成長趨勢，同時運用「超底王」機制持續定期投入、逢低進行加碼，分散進場時點風險，在市場震盪中持續累積投資部位。

news.Title: TSIA估台灣半導體今年產值達5.3兆元大增22% 力挺政府重啟核電評估
news.Content:
TSIA台灣半導體協會今(29)日舉辦30周年年會，現任理事長侯永清表示，預估2026年台灣半導體產業總產值突破5.3兆元，年增率達22%，同時正式表態在合規與安全前提下支持政府重啟核電評估，並將攜手權值龍頭台積電(2330-TW)等夥伴壯大生態系。

針對半導體產業營運環境，侯永清強調，充足且穩定的電力供應至關重要，協會已多次對外呼籲政府正視用電需求。在理監事會一致同意下，協會正式發布支持政府在合乎法規及安全無虞的前提下，啟動重啟核能與核電廠的評估計畫，期盼藉此為台灣產業帶來更乾淨且穩定的能源供給。

在產業營運實績方面，侯永清回顧2026年產值表現優異，相較於2025年底的全體會員產值4.3兆元，大幅攀升並超過5.3兆元。回顧協會成立之初會員產值僅約1800億元，如今台灣在晶圓製造與封測領域產值均位居全球第一，IC設計領域則名列全球第二。

為加速強化在地供應鏈競爭力，協會攜手工研院及台積電合作成立技術驗證平台，彙整製造端所需的設備規格與數據資料。設備廠商可透過該平台深入掌握製造端核心規格，並直接進行系統驗證，進一步縮短研發週期並提升進步腳步。

面對材料與化學品供應商因應人工智慧需求而面臨的擴廠痛點，協會主動彙整業界建廠土地需求並向政府提出建言。在國科會主委吳誠文與經濟部部長郭智輝協助下，政府於兩個月內迅速完成用地媒合，目前已有4家材料夥伴完成行政手續，預計明年4月動工建廠，另有7家夥伴正在辦理相關行政作業。

在擴大產業整體實力上，協會已吸引18家跨國企業加入會員，深化與國際夥伴的研發與物料合作。組織架構上，協會於2024年成立設備委員會，今年2026年更進一步成立材料委員會，讓整體半導體產業鏈從製造與設計完整延伸至設備與材料，凝聚力量打群架。

綠色製造與國際溝通方面，協會積極代表台灣參與世界半導體理事會，在智慧財產權保護、能源、人才及關稅等關鍵議題上主導發聲並捍衛權益。協會在2023年首次發表節能減碳白皮書宣言，並於2024年發表能源宣言，成為世界半導體理事會成員區域中率先公布具體減碳路徑的先鋒。

news.Title: Microsoft: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
news.Content:
On its first quarter of fiscal 2027 earnings call, held on Oct. 28, 2026, Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) announced that Microsoft Cloud revenue surpassed $63 billion with 30% year-over-year growth. This expansion highlights how enterprise software adoption is shifting toward agentic systems and consumption-based billing models. Three key takeaways from management highlight the path forward for long-term investors.

1. Revenue Models Are Shifting From Fixed Seats to Consumption Billing

Management is expanding monetization beyond flat per-seat software subscriptions into usage-based billing tied directly to automated tasks. This shift expands the total addressable market, or TAM, and average revenue per user, or ARPU, as autonomous agents, under Microsoft's Copilot brand, handle higher-value business processes.

And as agents take on higher-value work, consumption opens up business-funded demand with spending tied directly to the value these agents deliver. The number of Copilot customers actively consuming credits through usage-based billing grew over 75% over the quarter.

-- Satya Nadella, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

2. Data Center Efficiency Gains Are Unlocking Extra Cloud Infrastructure Capacity

Engineering optimizations across graphics processing units, or GPUs, allowed the company to serve excess artificial intelligence demand without waiting for new physical infrastructure. Revenue for Foundry, the company's cloud platform for building artificial intelligence applications, grew rapidly as hardware throughput improved.

Foundry revenue more than tripled year-over-year with upside driven by efficiency gains across our GPU fleet that allowed us to allocate additional capacity to customers as well as higher revenue per token that we benefited from in the quarter.

-- Amy Hood, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

3. First-Party Artificial Intelligence Models Reduce Enterprise Training Costs

Microsoft Artificial Intelligence, or MAI, models match frontier performance within months while cutting compute overhead. By lowering training costs, the company passes savings directly to corporate customers running custom software workflows.

We also continue to make rapid progress with our first-party models. Our goal is to advance the cost-to-outcome frontier, which means delivering capabilities comparable to leading models within 3 to 6 months of their release at a fraction of the training cost, thereby allowing us to transfer those cost benefits to customers.

Story Continues

Looking Ahead

Cloud computing infrastructure demand continues to outpace available hardware capacity across global data centers. To capture this workload surge, the company added new facilities this quarter while accelerating hardware deployment speeds and optimizing existing server fleets.

Accelerating demand led to us adding 24 new data centers across 5 continents this quarter. And we are bringing capacity online faster, reducing dock-to-live times by about 20% quarter-over-quarter for new GB300s in our biggest regions, which make up the majority of the GPU deployments.

Looking forward, management is balancing $170 billion in annual capital expenditure with disciplined operational efficiency across every software layer. With broad enterprise adoption across cloud services and agentic workflows, execution discipline remains central to compounding shareholder value.

In closing, based on the demand we see, the strength of our products, and the efficiency we are driving across the stack, I've never been more confident in the long-term returns for our investments.

news.Title: 台股ETF規模衝9兆 11月除息秀估發34億紅包
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者謝旻蓁,攝影詹明樺

台股ETF11月除息秀即將登場，累計月初除息的檔數已來到15檔，預計將發放約34億元大禮包，有望成為台股資金動能。這波除息潮主要集中在各大投信的月月配標的，觀察殖利率前三名由主動式ETF包辦，理財專家分析，在台股劇烈波動之際，主動式ETF有望累積更多價差收益。

民眾：「我有在定期定額，那也有單筆。」

民眾：「天天（都會投資）。」

台股ETF投資熱度持續攀升，根據集保結算所統計，總受益人數已來到2236萬人，資產規模突破9兆元大關，緊接著11月除息秀強勢登場，預計將發放約34億元大紅包，不只讓存股族引頸期盼，也為台股資金動能再添柴火！

民眾：「目前（配息金額）還不錯，（買）高股息的比較多。」

投資人對ETF配息表現信心十足，這波資金焦點集中在各大投信「月月配」標的，累計月初除息已擴增至15檔，包含人氣較旺的元大台灣價值高息、統一台灣高息動能，以及剛掛牌就備受矚目的主動國泰動能高息。

財經作家 張琨琳：「我想10月份基本上，（股市）表現狀況是不錯，那剛好搭配到股東會剛結束，那所以整個配息的部分，應該表現是還不錯啦，可以讓投資人都非常滿意。」

進一步來看，高殖利率前三強由主動式ETF包辦，其中多日蟬聯台股成交量榜首的主動中信台灣收益，單次殖利率達1.5%，主動聯博全球非投、主動國泰動能高息分別有0.87%、0.82%，另外統一台灣高息動能、元大台灣價值高息、以及群益科技高息成長等高股息ETF也有亮眼表現。

財經作家 張琨琳：「其實主動式ETF最大好處，就是說可調控，搭配台股目前的震盪，大概每日均值，大概也有將近1000點的情況之下，對於主動式ETF所產生出來的價差的收益，我覺得表現一定會比，傳統型（被動式）來的更好。」

不過理財專家也提醒，投資ETF不能只看配息金額和殖利率，更要觀察後續填息表現，以及整體報酬率是否跟得上大盤，才能更完整地掌握投資績效。（記者謝旻蓁、詹明樺／台北採訪報導）

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資翻臉重砍688億元！聯電遭砍近13萬張淪賣超王 友達群創也難逃
news.Content:
（下午4點33分更新買賣超個股）

台股今（29）日遭遇賣壓，三大法人合計賣超816.66億元，外資翻空大舉調節688.15億元。晶圓代工二哥聯電（2303）淪為提款機，遭賣超近13萬張，以今日跌停價估算，外資提款金額約149.31億元；面板雙虎友達（2409）、群創（3481）也難逃賣壓，合計遭調節逾9.6萬張。分析師表示，Google母公司Alphabet財報不如市場預期，加深市場對美國科技股後續財報及AI投資回收的疑慮，促使外資提前調節持股，反映今晚美股可能下跌的預期。

外資今日賣超前三大：聯電、 00406A 、友達

外資今日賣超前十大，電子股占5檔、ETF占4檔、傳產股1檔。聯電遭外資調節12萬9271張，是榜上唯一賣超突破10萬張的標的；主動中信台灣收益（00406A）遭賣超7萬8278張，排名第二；面板大廠友達（2409）則遭賣超5萬436張，位居第三。

群創（3481）也遭外資賣超4萬6307張，排名第四，面板雙虎合計遭調節9萬6743張。其他電子股方面，記憶體大廠旺宏（2337）遭賣超1萬8674張，名列第八；筆電代工廠仁寶（2324）遭調節1萬6350張，排名第九。

外資今日買超前三大： 00712 、台新新光金、中信金

外資買超前十大，金融股占據5席，電子股有3檔，傳產股及ETF各1檔。復華富時不動產（00712）獲外資買超2萬566張，拿下買超冠軍；台新新光金獲敲進1萬9911張，排名第二；中信金則以1萬7315張緊追在後，位居第三。

電子股方面，華邦電（2344）獲外資買超1萬4319張，排名第四；智原（3035）獲買超8520張，位居第六；南亞科（2408）則以5661張排第十。

外資翻臉重砍688億元 三大法人賣超816億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計賣超816.66億元。其中，外資由買轉賣，賣超688.15億元。

投信續站買方，買超86.49億元，連續13個交易日買超台股達2,028.97億元。

自營商同樣由買轉賣，今日合計賣超215億元，其中自行買賣部分賣超1.84億元，避險操作賣超213.16億元。

AI砸大錢能回收？分析師揭科技股財報疑慮

資深證券分析師謝明哲表示，外資投資台股須先將資金換成新台幣，當台幣貶值，即使股價沒有變動，也可能因匯率變化產生損失，因此外資通常會偏向賣超。「資金匯出可能使台幣走弱，而台幣貶值又會加重外資調節意願，形成股匯相互影響的情況。」

另一項關鍵則是美國科技股表現。謝明哲表示，Google公布財報後，盤後股價暴跌10%，其他重要科技股盤後表現也不理想，市場關注焦點在於「花那麼多錢做AI，到底有沒有辦法回收」。在預期美股可能出現較大修正的情況下，除了主動調整持股的外資，也有隨國際股市漲跌調整部位的買賣盤，因而提前站在賣方。

至於外資明日是否延續大幅賣超，謝明哲表示，今日台股已提前反映部分美股下跌預期，後續須觀察今晚美股實際跌幅，是否較台股收盤前市場預期來得輕，作為明日能否止穩的判斷依據。他提醒，還須關注亞馬遜、英特爾及SanDisk財報公布後的盤後股價反應，才能進一步判斷台股跌破季線後，是否有短線反彈機會。

台股今日未能跟進前一交易日美股漲勢，盤中一度重挫980.51點至46,055.07點，逼近4萬6千點關卡，午盤後跌幅雖逐步收斂，終場仍下跌667.25點、收在46,368.33點，再度失守季線，成交金額8,213.76億元。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 友達第三季EPS-0.33元，台中廠售予台積電，交易金額388億元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】友達(2409)公布第三季財報，單季合併營收668.8億元，較2026年第二季減少5.7%，與2025年第三季相比減少4.3%；單季毛利率10.1%、營益率3.5%；單季歸屬母公司業主之淨損幣25億元，每股淨損0.33元。另外，友達盤後公布將台中廠二期廠房售予台積電(2330)，總交易金額388億元。而原本7月董事會通過處分華亞廠不動產及其相關廠務附屬設施予廣達，因對廠房使用規格及交付時程未達成協議，董事長決議終止本處分案。

友達表示，第三季整體營收季減5.7%，其中Display（顯示科技）因消費性電子產品需求持續放緩，營收較上一季減少11%。Mobility Solutions（智慧移動）因車用團隊持續深化與客戶合作，營收與上一季約略持平。Vertical Solutions（垂直場域）因零售、醫療、工商用面板出貨穩定成長，營收較上一季增長1%。獲利方面，本季因營收減少，毛利較上一季減少，本業獲利轉為虧損。

展望第四季，友達預期智慧移動營收與上季持平；垂直場域營收呈現低個位數至中個位數百分比季減；顯示業務第四季營收則較上季下滑。友達說明，旺季備貨已告一段落，品牌客戶對面板採購趨於保守。車用團隊持續爭取訂單，滿足客戶需求。垂直場域業務需求相對穩定。但目前外在影響景氣的變數仍多，管理團隊將會密切關注市場變化，隨時動態調整因應。

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股摜破季線收46368點　法人：短線築底區間震盪
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年10月29日電）台股今天開低走低，投資人觀望中東局勢和全球貨幣政策走向，電子類股及中小型股表現疲弱，盤中重挫逾980點，回測46000點關卡；終場收在46368.33點、下跌667.25點，跌幅1.42%，失守季線46505點，成交金額新台幣7891.52億元。

觀察今天各類股表現，電子與半導體指數跌勢較重，分別下挫1.74%、1.24%；傳產族群塑膠指數收跌2.02%，鋼鐵指數下挫1.35%，金融類股逆勢指數上揚1.05%。代表中小型股的櫃買指數開高後迅速翻黑，終場下跌1.83%。

電子權值股方面，台積電 (2330) 終場下跌0.41%，收在2415元；聯電 (2303) 收跌停價115.5元；聯發科 (2454) 挫4.49%，以4045元作收；鴻海 (2317) 跌1.39%，收248元。

主動式ETF（指數股票型基金）浮現賣壓，主動中信台灣收益（00406A）、主動統一台股增長（00981A）、主動統一升級50（00403A）終場跌幅均超過2%。

砷化鎵大廠穩懋 (3105) 第3季獲利亮眼，成為電子股少數亮點，開盤即亮燈漲停一價到底，收在594元，成交量逾5.6萬張。被動元件廠華新科 (2492) 展現抗跌韌性，終場大漲6.28%，收在423元。

千元以上高價股普遍走勢低迷，減為47檔，景碩 (3189) 與大量 (3167) 終場分別重挫7.34%、8.16%，跌出千金股行列，收在959元、946元。

台新投顧策略長黃文清接受中央社電訪分析，台股這波反彈過程成交量能並未明顯放大，整體動能偏弱，加上近期美股科技巨頭財報好壞參半，盤後公布Alphabet財報表現不如預期，拖累美股期指電子盤與亞股走弱，市場仍需時間消化負面訊息。

黃文清說，在中東情勢、美伊戰事風險及全球貨幣政策尚未明朗前，台股反彈力道相對受抑且速度放緩；但指數已具備築底條件，推估短線將在46000點至48000點附近區間震盪。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》智慧化農業—DE、AGCO、VMI
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 14:31:23 數位內容中心 發佈

Deere（DE.US）

近7日，Deere的智慧農業訊號仍集中在Production and Precision Agriculture業務，以及See&Spray以攝影機與人工智慧辨識雜草、逐株調整施藥。大型農機需求仍受景氣循環壓力影響，但本週可驗證重點仍是精準施作能力。

AGCO（AGCO.US）

近7日，AGCO持續推進PTx、FarmerCore、OutRun，並在Hesston廠試點Agility Robotics的Digit機器人，規劃自2027年開始。這使其智慧化布局從田間自主化方案，延伸到工廠端的自動化營運應用。

CNH Industrial（CNH.US）

近7日，CNH Industrial未公布新產品，但原始資料顯示公司持續整合FieldOps平台與人工智慧工具，推進軟體、數據與技術型服務的經常性收入。另在2025年已實現農業業務成本節省2.30億美元。

Valmont Industries（VMI.US）

10月27日，Valmont Industries公布2026年第三季10-Q，淨銷售額11億美元、年增5.5%，智慧農業相關業務仍以高效率灌溉為主，聚焦Valley與Zimmatic的中心支軸式與線性灌溉系統。

news.Title: 台灣半導體今年產值估破9.1兆！協會理事長侯永清喊話政府：重啟核電
news.Content:
台灣半導體產業協會（TSIA）迎來成立30周年，台積電資深副總經理暨副共同營運長、資訊安全長理事長，同時也是台灣半導體產業協會理事長侯永清指出，穩定且充足的電力對半導體發展至關重要，TSIA正式通過理監事會同意，公開支持政府在「合乎法規」與「安全無虞」兩大前提下，重啟核能與核電廠評估計劃，為台灣產業爭取更乾淨、充裕的能源保障。

2026年我國半導體產值衝破9.1兆 年增達40.9%

回顧TSIA發展歷程，侯永清表示，台灣半導體協會自1996年成立以來，從最初的4個委員會、57家會員，成長至今已擴增至12個委員會、220家會員。產值表現更是躍進式成長，從創會初期的1,800億元新台幣，躍升至2025年底的6.5兆元。

受惠於全球 AI 浪潮帶動與整體生態鏈擴張，侯永清預估，今年台灣半導體產業總產值將突破9.1兆元新台幣，相較於2025年的6.5兆元，年成長率高達40.9%。目前台灣在晶圓製造與封測領域穩居全球第一，IC 設計產值也高居全球第二。

針對未來的戰略布局，侯永清強調，半導體競爭不能只靠製造與設計，必須攜手材料與設備業者「打群架」。TSIA 於2025年成立設備委員會，今年更進一步成立材料委員會，補齊產業鏈最後一塊拼圖。

為加速設備商技術升級，TSIA聯合台積電與工研院打造驗證平台，開放製造規格與數據，供設備商進一步驗證與優化系統。在材料與化學品擴廠方面，針對業者面臨的用地難題，經主動向政府溝通，在國科會主委吳誠文與經濟部長郭智輝協調下，僅用2個月即完成選地。目前已有4家材料夥伴完成手續，預計2027年4月動工興建新廠，另有 7 家正規劃辦理中。

此外，TSIA積極引進國際戰力，自2023年以來，已推動18家國際企業加入協會，鼓勵外商在台設立研發、製造或物料中心。

展望未來，侯永清表示，雖然面對複雜的國際情勢與新挑戰，TSIA 將持續秉持「匯聚產業發展共識，促成會員合作與國際合作」的宗旨，以開放思維與積極行動，引領台灣半導體產業再創高峰。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股收跌667點！金融大軍撐盤 「這2檔」兩天兩漲停
news.Content:
台股今（29）日開低震盪，盤中一度下挫逾900點，尾盤以46368點作收失守季線，下跌667點，跌幅1.42%，成交量來到7800億元；櫃買指數則來到387.37點，下跌7.24點，跌幅1.83%。

權值股部分，台積電來到2415元，下跌10元，跌幅0.41%，聯發科來到4045元，下跌190元，跌幅4.49%，鴻海來到248元，跌幅1.39%，台達電、台塑化則有逾4%的跌幅。

觀察今日盤面，金融股強勢撐盤，第一金上漲3.86%來到44.45元，彰銀、兆豐金、華南金、合庫金、中信金、玉山金也上漲逾1%，台新新光金、國泰金、富邦金也有逾1%的漲幅。

此外，聯電28日舉行法說會，宣布2027年將漲價約10%，不過股民並未回心轉意，股價跌停亮燈來到115元，同為聯電集團股的智原再度收第二根漲停，來到231.5元；同樣公布財報的穩懋逆勢攻漲停、連2日亮燈；而昨日攻漲停的玉晶光今日則慘遭打入跌停，收1200元。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 2 Reasons I'd Buy Marvell Stock More Than 20% Below Its Record, and 1 Reason I'd Wait
news.Content:
On June 4, Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) stock ended the day at $316.43, a record close. As of this writing, shares trade near $248, or about 21% below that record, even after bouncing more than 10% from their Oct. 22 close.

The business hasn't gone backward in the meantime. At an investor day on Oct. 6, the company raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2028 (the year ending in January 2028) to around $20 billion. In August, it had called for about $18 billion. Reaching $20 billion would mean growth of about 67% from the roughly $12 billion Marvell expects this fiscal year.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

I think the drop is a chance to buy, but not all at once. Here are two reasons I'd buy shares now and one reason I'd hold some money back.

Image source: Getty Images.

1. The data center target moved up a year

Data centers are where almost all of Marvell's growth comes from. They made up 79% of revenue in the fiscal second quarter of 2027 (ended Aug. 1).

Showing how fast that business is growing, Marvell's data center revenue rose 46% year over year to about $2.17 billion in fiscal Q2. What's more, management guided for data center growth to accelerate to about 75% year over year in the fiscal third quarter, and it now expects data center revenue to climb about 60% for all of fiscal 2027, up from its earlier forecast of about 50%. "AI-related bookings remain exceptionally robust," CEO Matt Murphy said in the fiscal second-quarter earnings release.

The longer-term targets have moved up even faster. In 2024, Marvell set a goal of $15 billion in data center revenue for fiscal 2029. Last year, it lifted the goal to about $18 billion. And at this month's investor day, it said it now expects to hit about $18 billion a year early, in fiscal 2028.

For reference, Marvell's data center business took in $6.1 billion in fiscal 2026, so the new target is almost triple that. Put another way, every update has pulled more growth into the same years.

2. The stock got cheaper as the forecast rose

Granted, Marvell stock isn't cheap on this year's numbers. At around $248, it trades at about 59 times the earnings expected for this fiscal year. Against expected earnings for fiscal 2028, though, the price-to-earnings ratio drops to about 34.

For comparison, that same fiscal 2028 earnings estimate would have put the stock at about 43 times earnings at its June record. And since June, management's revenue outlook for fiscal 2028 has climbed by about $3.5 billion, from roughly $16.5 billion in May.

Story Continues

Profits are keeping up with sales, too. Marvell's non-GAAP (adjusted) earnings per share grew 40% year over year to $0.94 in fiscal Q2, up from $0.80 in fiscal Q1. Management guided for $1.10 this quarter.

Sure, 34 times earnings is a premium price. But for a company expecting revenue growth of around 67% in fiscal 2028, I'd call that a fair price -- and arguably a better deal than buyers got in June.

The reason I'd wait: Too much rides on a few customers

Marvell's growth relies on a handful of buyers. Its 10 biggest customers, distributors included, accounted for 82% of revenue in fiscal 2026, according to its latest quarterly filing. One direct customer alone made up 16% of revenue in fiscal Q2.

This concentration matters most in custom chips, which Marvell designs for individual cloud companies and expects to more than double in fiscal 2028. In the same filing, Marvell warned that big cloud computing providers "have already begun investing in proprietary chip design capabilities," a trend it said "could reduce demand for our products."

A single lost program likely wouldn't stop Marvell's growth. But with so much revenue coming from so few customers, one cloud giant taking work in-house could eat noticeably into Marvell's revenue. After all, a growth stock at 34 times expected earnings can fall hard on that sort of news.

Is Marvell stock a buy?

I think so. Marvell's data center outlook is bigger than it was when the stock peaked in June, and shares cost less.

But customer risk like this often shows up with little warning, so I wouldn't put a full position to work right now. I'd consider buying some shares here and adding more as reported results show custom chip sales growing the way management expects.

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》物流自動化—UPS、GXO、AMZN
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 14:16:19 數位內容中心 發佈

United Parcel Service, Inc.（UPS.US）

UPS在旺季前完成Denver、St.Paul、Syracuse與Portland共4座包裹分揀中心自動化改造。公司截至2026年7月1日已有68.5%的美國包裹量流經自動化設施，且每件處理成本較傳統機械化設施低28%，顯示自動化已由單點升級擴展到全網重組。

GXO Logistics, Inc.（GXO.US）

GXO於10月26日宣布，將把Agility Robotics的Digit擴大部署到美國另外2座物流設施，地點為Statesville與Lebanon，預計2027年初導入，用於電商履約與高重複性物料搬運。既有Flowery Branch據點自初始部署以來已搬運超過100,000個totes。

Agility Robotics

Agility Robotics本週的訊號，是把人形機器人部署從試點推向可量產交付。公司表示Digit在商業營運與客戶專案中的累計真實運作時數已超過65,000小時，並已建置7萬平方英尺的RoboFab設施，設計年產能最高可達10,000台機器人。

Amazon.com, Inc.（AMZN.US）

Amazon表示今年上半年same day或overnight配送件數年增超過40%，並計畫在2026年把robotic-arm fleet擴增至原本的2倍以上，同時推出新一代Proteus機器人。這次更新把自動化重點放在配送時效提升與倉內機器人規模同步擴張。

FedEx Corporation（FDX.US）

Broadcom於10月20日宣布延長與FedEx的技術合作，FedEx將持續以VMware Cloud Foundation、Avi Load Balancer與Tanzu Platform作為私有雲核心底座。此次動態聚焦路由、運能規劃、資料工具與物流網路自動化所需的數位基礎設施。

news.Title: 聯準會按兵不動、Google 財報分歧，資金為何悄悄流向 Lumentum 和穩懋？
news.Content:
一、聯準會按兵不動，美股連三紅卻不是全面狂歡

聯準會決議利率維持不變，符合市場預期，美股三大指數同步收紅、連三個交易日走高，費城半導體指數更一口氣強彈逾 1.7%。但這波上漲一點也不平均：同樣是科技巨頭，有人財報亮眼帶動整個類股起飛，有人卻讓市場開始懷疑砸下重金的 AI 到底幾年才回得了本。指數紅歸紅，資金其實正從部分族群撤出、集中到少數主流股身上，這種「指數漲、個股分化」，才是這次美股盤後需要關注的重點。而資金這一輪押對了哪些族群、又從哪裡悄悄撤退，恐怕才是接下來牽動台股、最該先搞懂的一件事。

立即前往豐雲學堂看更多

誰在撐盤、資金往哪跑？打開大戶投馬上看

貼上的影片.png

二、記憶體續強、Lumentum 點火光通訊，穩懋等台廠為何被點名？

這一輪領漲主角，是記憶體與 AI 基建兩大題材。SK海力士看好記憶體需求供不應求到 2030 年，ADR 單日大漲逾 13%；甲骨文（Oracle）調升 2030 財年營收展望、股價勁揚逾 10%。更受矚目的是光學大廠 Lumentum，單季營收年增逾 109%，等於宣告 AI 競賽已從「算得更快」延伸到「資料傳得更快」，矽光子與 CPO（共同封裝光學）題材正式走向量產。這條線一路連回台灣，光通訊與穩懋等代工概念股跟著受惠；就連聯電法說會也喊出「3 年內單季 AI 營收占比挑戰 25%」與矽光子布局。只是題材一喊，全場都在追，真正吃到訂單的台廠其實就只有幾家。

三、Google 財報藏隱憂，台股哪些族群會先被點名？

另一頭，Google（Alphabet）財報卻讓市場踩了煞車：雲端營收翻倍成長，龐大的資本支出與投資損益卻同步放大，連帶讓高度連動美系客戶的台積電與供應鏈一起承壓。一邊是記憶體、光通訊熱到發燙，一邊是科技巨頭財報開始分歧，台股接下來到底該順著美股盤後

news.Title: Tesla Is Flying in Europe, and We Aren't Talking About the Roadster -- 1 Big Concern Remains
news.Content: Tesla 's (NASDAQ: TSLA) recent Roadster demonstration was flying over cars. Whether you scoffed at the gimmick or simply enjoyed the wild spectacle, the company quietly recorded registrations flying higher in Europe. The latter is likely the more meaningful flying from Tesla, especially since it was its best month for Europe registrations ever. While Tesla doesn't break out its European deliveries, we can use vehicle registrations as a proxy for sales and better understand what's happened. Hint: It's good news for Tesla, although there is one growing concern. Missed ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Tesla achieved record vehicle registrations in Europe in September, with the Model Y and Model 3 leading the market.
• The Model Y saw registrations up 55% year-over-year, and the Model 3 more than doubled its September 2025 volume.
• Tesla's strong European performance is partly supported by increased exports from its Shanghai factory, mitigating challenges in the Chinese EV market.
• A significant concern is the rapid growth of Chinese automakers in Europe, whose registrations increased by 104% in September, capturing 14.5% market share.
• Chinese brands are leveraging hybrid vehicles to potentially bypass tariffs and are undercutting competitors on price, posing a growing threat to Tesla and other EV makers in Europe.

news.Title: 台股收盤／台股慘跌667點！台積電領跌櫃買挫1.8%　AI股又扛不住了
news.Content: 台股今（29）日上演大幅回檔走勢，儘管美股主要指數週三（28日）全面收紅，台股卻未能跟上國際股市漲勢。美股連3漲仍難救台股！今（29）日加權指數收46,368.33點，重挫667.25點，成交7,891.52億元；櫃買指數跌1.83%，成交2,127.33億元。 台股開高期待落空大盤重挫667點　成交金額突破1兆 加權指數早盤一路震盪走低，盤中一度跌破46,000點關卡，隨後低接買盤進場，跌幅略為收斂，終場下跌667.25點、跌幅1.42%，收在46,368.33點。代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步走弱，收387.37點，下跌7.24點、跌幅1.83%，顯示賣壓不只集中大型權值股，中小型股也受到衝擊。 上市市場成交金額達7,891.52億元，加計上櫃市場2,127.33億元，合計成交金額高達1兆18.85億元，顯示市場交易相當熱絡，但大量成交並未帶動股價上揚，反而反映多空雙方激烈交戰。從盤面觀察，上市股票下跌家數達912家，上漲僅320家；上櫃股票下跌728家，上漲352家，跌多漲少格局明顯，市場追價意願轉趨保守。 倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，盤後科技巨人財報好壞不一，微軟盤後漲逾4%、SK海力士ADR及甲骨文狂飆逾10%，但Alphabet則因廣告營收不如預期，盤後下跌逾7%，以及美期中選舉在即等不確定因素的影響下，使得今日台股並未能夠延續昨日反彈的氣勢，再度震盪拉回來，在利空淬鍊底部的過程中，初期由於市場信心不足，加上AI變現進度不如預期與資本支出過高，再度引發市場對AI估值過高與泡沫化的擔憂，以及中東緊張局勢未除、能源價格仍居高不下等，都是促使台股未能一鼓作氣往上攻的原因之一；，面對利空淬煉底部的過程中，指數反覆震盪上沖下洗，都是非常正常的現象，並不足為奇。某些具有實質基本面支撐、流動性佳的AI受惠股、且產業趨勢明確、低基期的族群，此時若能夠展現相對抗跌的韌性，逢低則是值得留意，譬如IP矽智財智原、CPO穩懋、鼎元、光電材料碩禾、吉祥全、網通康全電、顯卡麗臺、資服大世科、電源管理IC矽力、力智、工具機暨設備股東台、亞泰金、牧德、被動元件華新科、信昌電等低基期轉機股，其表現則是來的相對強勢，這些都是大家可持續留意與掌握的機會。 台積電跌10元拖累大盤　聯電、聯發科、台達電同步重挫 從成交值排行觀察，權值股台積電（2330）成為市場關注焦點，終場收2,415元，下跌10元、跌幅0.41%。其他電子權值股賣壓更加沉重，聯電（2303）跌停收115.5元，下跌12.5元、跌幅9.77%；聯發科（2454）收4,045元，下跌190元、跌幅4.49%；台達電（2308）收1,480元，下跌70元、跌幅4.52%；聯茂（6213）收745元，下跌33元、跌幅4.24%。其中，景碩（3189）跌勢明顯，收959元，下跌76元、跌幅7.34%，反映電子股短線調節壓力升高。 不過，盤面仍有少數強勢個股逆勢突圍。穩懋（3105）大漲54元，收594元，強攻漲停、漲幅10%；華新科（2492）上漲25元，收423元、漲幅6.28%，成為弱勢盤面中少數亮點。南亞科（2408）則收477元、維持平盤，顯示資金並未全面撤出電子族群，而是出現明顯的個股強弱分歧。 美股連3漲台股卻大跌　Fed利率按兵不動

news.Title: 台股2原因重挫！收盤下跌667點 聯電跌停 聯發科、台達電殺4％
news.Content:
台股今（29日）盤中一度下殺980.51點觸及46055.07點，尾盤跌幅略為收斂，終場下跌667.25點收在46368.33點，成交值7892億元。大型權值股仍疲弱，台積電下跌10元收在2415元，聯發科跌1940元（或4.49%）收在4045元，台達電跌70元（或4.52%）收在1480元，廣達挫低12元（或3.64%）收在318元，鴻海也下跌超過1%。

聯電昨（28日）召開法說會，宣布追加32億美元資本支出預算，加速擴張新加坡與台南產能，預計2028下半年之後陸續到位，價格與產品組合改善有利營運，但折舊及原物料成本上升恐壓抑毛利率，聯電股價殺至跌停，收在115.5元。

半導體電子股弱勢，資金流入金融、傳產及內需族群避險，金融類股指數上漲1.05%，另外水泥、食品、紡織及生技醫療等族群皆收紅。美國聯準會宣布維持利率不變，市場預估12月升息機率超過80%，且地緣政治風險仍高，沙烏地阿拉伯油廠遇襲，國際油價又跳升，通膨隱憂仍在。

台股幾乎回吐昨日漲幅，顯示市場觀望氣氛濃厚，追價信心與意願不高，失守季線的狀況下，恐會延長區間整理的時間。工商報導，統一投顧董事長黎方國說，台股短線負乖離過大，並有聯發科、台達電、聯電等電子大廠法說及鴻海科技日等利多登場，上市櫃第三季獲利亮眼，賣壓逐步消化下有助回歸基本面。

news.Title: 台股終場跌667點失守季線　聯電跌停

news.Title: Asia stocks mixed as Alphabet, Samsung results disappoint; more tech earnings loom
news.Content:
Investing.com-- Asian stocks were mixed on Thursday, as disappointing results from Alphabet and a sell-off in Samsung Electronics weighed on technology shares, while investors awaited earnings from Amazon and Intel for further clues on the outlook for artificial intelligence investment.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

U.S. stock index futures also fell in Asian trading Thursday, with Nasdaq 100 Futures sliding 1.2%. Wall Street ended slightly higher overnight.

Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares slumped about 10% in after-hours U.S. trading after the company reported results that fell short of expectations and signalled heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), by contrast, gained about 3% after its results showed stronger-than-expected cash flow.

S.Korea's KOSPI retreats on Samsung chip profit miss

South Korea's KOSPI ended 1.2% lower after falling as much as 3% earlier in the day.

Samsung Electronics (KS:005930) shares dropped nearly 4% despite the company reporting record third-quarter earnings, as investors focused on a miss in semiconductor profit expectations and uncertainty over additional shareholder returns.

Investors were also disappointed that Samsung did not provide immediate details of additional shareholder returns, with the company saying it would finalise its next policy in January. Its mobile business recorded an operating loss of 800 billion won as higher memory costs squeezed profitability.

Samsung warned that AI-driven memory demand would outstrip industry supply in 2027 and projected semiconductor capital expenditure of 76.8 trillion won this year, up 62% from 2025.

The decline followed a rally of nearly 7% in the KOSPI on Wednesday, when SK Hynix (KS:000660) surged 11% after reporting a stronger-than-expected profit and announcing a 100 trillion won ($75 billion) shareholder-return plan. SK Hynix shares rose a further 2.6% on Thursday.

Elsewhere, China's Shanghai Composite fell 0.8% and the blue-chip Shanghai Shenzhen CSI 300 index slipped 1%, with chip stocks leading losses.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 0.5%, with its Hang Seng TECH sub-index sliding 2.6%.

Among gainers, Japan's Nikkei 225 edged 1% higher, while the broader TOPIX index gained 0.3%.

Story Continues

Australia's S&P/ASX 200 gained 0.5%, while Singapore's Straits Times Index edged up 0.2%.

India's Nifty 50 index rose 0.6%.

Fed holds steady; BOJ decision awaited

Investors were also preparing for the Bank of Japan's policy decision on Friday, after its two-day meeting began on Thursday.

The central bank is widely expected to keep its policy rate at 1.25%, following a rate increase in September, while potentially raising its inflation forecasts as higher oil prices and a weak yen add to price pressures.

Markets will scrutinise Governor Kazuo Ueda's comments for clues on whether the BOJ could raise rates again as soon as December.

The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday, although two policymakers voted in favour of a rate increase.

Markets were pricing in roughly a 78% chance of a U.S. rate increase in December, according to CME FedWatch, leaving investors sensitive to incoming inflation data. September's U.S. personal consumption expenditures price index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, is due on Friday.

Attention later shifts to Amazon and Intel, whose results and guidance will help investors assess whether strong AI demand can sustain the enormous spending on data centres, chips and cloud infrastructure.

news.Title: 爸媽送10張台積電 兒離婚媳能拿？ 律師揭關鍵：「這筆錢」恐分一半
news.Content: 父母辛苦累積財富，想送兒子10張台積電（2330）股票，卻擔心孩子未來婚姻生變，資產會不會被媳婦分走？恩典法律事務所主 ...
news.AI_Summary:
• 父母贈與或繼承的台積電（2330）股票本金，原則上不列入夫妻剩餘財產分配計算，離婚時通常不必與配偶平分。
• 然而，股票持有期間累積的股利、股息若未花用而持續留存，可能被納入夫妻剩餘財產計算，成為離婚時另一半請求分配的關鍵。
• 法律規定，無償取得的財產（如父母贈與或繼承）原則上排除於夫妻剩餘財產差額分配計算範圍之外。
• 重點在於婚後持有期間產生的收益，若長期累積成為可計算的婚後財產，離婚時另一方就有機會依法主張分配。
• 此新聞主要探討股票本金與股利在離婚財產分配上的法律差異。

news.Title: 【Hot台股】南亞科漲逾4%後翻黑！網喊「記憶體剩牙科苦撐」分析師示警上檔有壓力
news.Content:
今日社群台股最Hot議題

「牙科優惠時間結束，10點開拉」、「牙科剛綠的是要載人上車？」、「記憶體剩牙科，苦苦支撐」、「昨天沒買到牙科，悶啊」、「牙科重返500大關了嗎」。

「牙科華崩還撐著欸，太扯」、「牙科這波要破前高嗎」、「誰要便宜的牙科？現在大特價給你啊，還不進場看牙」。

針對網友熱議話題…專家這麼說！

HOT台股今日值班專家－啟發投顧分析師白易弘

記憶體大廠南亞科（2408）今（29）日股價震盪，早盤一度衝上497.5元，漲逾4%，距離500元大關僅差2.5元。隨後翻黑又拉回紅盤，不少股民喊「牙科優惠時間結束，10點開拉」，也有股民表示「記憶體剩牙科苦撐」。

白易弘表示，受到昨晚美股科技及記憶體相關族群收高帶動，南亞科今日早盤開高，但由於股價短線已連續上漲，來到480元至500元附近，正好面臨先前高檔套牢區的賣壓，因此開高後漲幅收斂，盤中一度翻黑。

白易弘指出，南亞科近期漲勢較快，短線出現獲利了結賣壓並不意外，若股價拉回至5日均線附近，支撐可能相對較強。他認為，對於尚未進場的投資人，目前不宜急著追高，可先觀察股價是否回落至440元至450元附近，再評估進場時機。

至於網友關注南亞科能否再攻前高，白易弘認為，目前仍有一定壓力，短線須先站穩500元，才有機會進一步挑戰高點。他指出，下周記憶體廠將陸續公布營收，若營運數據提供支撐，南亞科才比較有機會再度挑戰500元關卡。

news.Title: Google跌勢引爆蔓延AI鏈！ 韓股重挫3% 台股跌逾800點
news.Content:
Google母公司Alphabet在29日盤後公布財報，第三季營收來到633億美元、年增12%，但依然遠低於外界預期，在財報不如預期及市場對其資本支出的疑慮升溫，股價盤後一度重挫逾10%，連帶影響其他AI巨頭股價同步下滑，亞股也遭受波及，日經指數由紅翻黑、韓股KOSPI指數跌3%，台股也下跌逾800點。

根據Alphabet公布的財報，第三季搜尋廣告營收達到633億美元，年增12％，但未能達到市場預期的649億美元，被市場視為一大警訊，這代表在AI搜尋模式快速普及下，目前尚未具備與傳統搜尋相當的廣告變現能力，恐影響Google長期仰賴的搜尋廣告主力業務，進一步讓未來營收承壓。

Alphabet財報曝光後，股價盤後一度重挫逾10%，市場對AI的擔憂情緒也蔓延到AI供應鏈，夜盤股價紛紛下跌走弱，AMD、英特爾下跌逾4%，美光、威騰電子、博通下跌逾3%，輝達、SpaceX、特斯拉也下跌逾1%；亞股也未能倖免，韓股KOSPI指數跌逾3%、三星電子重挫6%，日經指數由紅翻黑，在平盤附近震盪，台股也一度重挫逾800點。

針對財報不如預期，Google首席商務官Philipp Schindler表示，匯率逆風是造成本季搜尋廣告成長放緩的最大單一因素，以及歐盟取消最低限額豁免政策衝擊零售廣告主，他坦言，AI模式帶動搜尋量顯著提升，但目前變現率仍偏低，對營收成長造成一定影響；至於自由現金流降至負91億美元，財務長Anat Ashkenazi則表示，TPU系統須先投入現金建立庫存，之後才逐步認列銷售收入，因此會形成現金流與營收認列的時間差，公司仍預期整個投資週期的投入資本報酬率將高於資本成本。

news.Title: 聯電法說變法會「股價打跌停」 智原連拉2漲停
news.Content:
聯電（2303）28日公布第3季財報，營收創單季歷史次高、晶圓出貨量刷新紀錄，還預告2027年平均售價有望成長約10％，並追加32億美元，要布局先進封裝與矽光子。怎料「法說變法會」29日股價開低走低，股價一度打跌停。另一方面，集團旗下智原（3035）股價延續強勢，連拉2根漲停。

第3季營收742億元

聯電第3季合併營收達742.4億元，季增8％、年增25.6％，創單季歷史次高；毛利率34％，營業利益186.4億元，季增24.7％，歸屬母公司淨利164.3億元，每股純益（EPS）1.32元。第3季晶圓出貨量季增7.3％，突破120萬片12吋約當晶圓，創下歷史新高，產能利用率也從第2季的85％提升至92％，部分12吋晶圓廠產能已滿載，8吋晶圓廠營運亦明顯復甦。

展望第4季，聯電預估晶圓出貨量季增1％至3％，美元計價平均售價維持穩健，毛利率約34％，產能利用率則可望維持在91％至93％。執行長王石指出，高階智慧手機、工業應用需求強勁，車用市場也持續復甦，但電腦市場需求相對疲軟。隨著AI基礎建設持續發展，電源管理晶片（PMIC）、現場可程式化邏輯陣列（FPGA）及連接應用需求可望成長。

明年ASP喊漲1成

聯電看好2027年晶圓代工定價環境改善，預期平均售價將較2026年成長約10％，並從明年第1季開始呈現正向成長。然而，財務長劉啟東坦言，晶圓報價調升不代表毛利率就能同步大幅改善，因為原物料成本也在增加，加上未來數年折舊費用將持續上升，預期2027年折舊費用至少呈低個位數成長，2028年增幅可能進一步擴大。

聯電指出，未來至少3年，折舊與原物料成本都將對毛利率形成壓力，即使平均售價上漲，毛利率仍不容易回到過去景氣高峰水準。這也成為市場評估聯電後續獲利的重要變數，投資人關注漲價效益能否抵銷成本增加，以及產能受限後，營收與獲利還能有多少成長空間。

聯電重挫、智原連2根漲停

儘管營運展望不乏亮點，聯電股價仍遭賣壓襲擊。29日盤中最低殺到跌停價115.5元。相較之下，集團旗下智原受惠明年AI營收可望大幅成長，以及成功接獲美系雲端AI應用之大型專案，採用2奈米GAA製程，股價延續強勢，已連續第2個交易日攻上漲停，來到231.5元。

news.Title: 台股「金融兆元五哥」出列！謝金河：最兵肥馬壯時代
news.Content:
財經中心／李明融報導

台股多頭氣勢如虹，金融族群同步迎來前所未見的黃金盛世！財訊傳媒董事長謝金河指出，隨著元大金控（2885）股價強勢站上73元大關，總市值正式突破1兆元新台幣門檻，榮登全台第5家市值破兆的重量級金控。綜觀當前台股「金融兆元五哥」，從龍頭富邦金的2.25兆、國泰金1.69兆、中信金1.46兆、台新新光金1.05兆，再到新晉級的元大金，宣告台灣金融業正式邁入史上最「兵肥馬壯」的繁盛時代。謝金河更對比兩岸金融現況，盤點中國42家上市銀行竟「無一家股價淨值比高於1」，盛讚台灣金融體質脫胎換骨，迎來經濟實力推動資本市場的正向循環。

金控股價淨值比飆破2倍，甩開2000年打呆帳陰霾。（圖／民視資料照）

逾放覆蓋率創歷史最佳！金控股價淨值比飆破2倍　甩開2000年打呆帳陰霾

謝金河分析，金融業是貫穿國家經濟發展的任督二脈，當總體經濟走強，金融業自然水漲船高。他回顧台灣金融發展歷程，當前台灣金融業的逾期放款比率與呆帳覆蓋率均處於歷史上最健全的優異狀態，這項體質結構的轉變，直接推升了整體金控的股價淨值比（PB）。檢視目前盤面數據，華南金股價淨值比高達2.87倍、玉山金達2.83倍，永豐金與元大金也繳出2.48倍的高水準，中信金則達2.14倍；對比2000年前後扁政府時期，全台銀行業為了全力打呆帳，多數銀行的股價淨值比普遍在0.5以下掙扎，如今整體身價早已不可同日而語。

news.Title: 日股ETF氣勢強今年來皆大賺二位數 00951受益人激增奪雙冠王
news.Content:
日本政府積極作多股市，推出多項鼓勵散戶進場政策，如股票分割和降低投資金額，促使家庭資金更容易直接進入日本股市中，加上半導體產業大幅成長，帶動日股屢創新高，展開長達一年的多頭氣勢，也激勵日股ETF強勁的漲升行情，根據統計，9檔國內投信發行的日股ETF今年來皆大漲二位數以上，其中，聚焦半導體產業的台新日本半導體(00951-TW)及中信日本半導體(00954-TW)皆大漲3成以上高居前二名。績效第一的 00951 今年來受益人大增4836人，亦傲視同類型基金。

全球半導體市場劇烈震盪與地緣政治不確定性持續牽動市場投資情緒，觀察今年以來日股ETF受益人數變化，台新日本半導體及中信日本半導體增加人數最多，顯示日本半導體產業最受市場投資人關注，尤其在近期各家半導體設備供應商獲利普遍上修下，反映AI時代對算力需求的大幅提升，也證明AI時代對先進半導體製程設備的需求持續攀升。

台新日本半導體ETF經理人邱麒安表示，日本半導體身為全球半導體重鎮，受惠需求激增，日本半導體製造裝置協會（SEAJ）大幅上修2026年度日本半導體設備銷售額預估值至6.6兆日圓，年增26%，創歷史新高，2026-2028年複合成長率高達13.8%。

雖然日本半導體市況近期隨全球科技股修正而跌幅明顯，但這也為長線投資人創造了絕佳的逢低買進時機。隨著 AI 與高速運算需求持續擴張，加上日本首相積極落實振興財政，大規模補強在地半導體自主供應鏈，高純度的日本半導體材料與設備廠將迎來長線復甦，此時的價格回檔正是結構性布局的黃金買點。

news.Title: 台股昨日狂飆、今反手殺逾700點！4萬7得而復失，短線支撐受考驗
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】亞洲股市今日早盤漲跌分歧，受到聯準會維持利率不變，以及美股費城半導體指數上漲1.76%激勵，日、韓半導體股持續受到資金青睞。韓國KOSPI指數早盤一度上漲84.10點、漲幅1.40%，來到6,096.54點，但盤中翻跌急殺3%，使亞股全面下殺。日本日經225指數力撐漲勢，早盤一度漲約0.79%，來到64,460點附近，鎧俠、軟銀等科技股成為撐盤主力。台股早盤開低殺跌出現明顯回檔。加權指數昨日大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，今日以47,014.87點開出後，受到聯電(2303)為首電子權值股賣壓影響，跌幅迅速擴大，盤中一度重挫超過700點，回測46,200點附近，47,000點整數關卡再度失守。櫃買指數早盤則一度小幅上漲，部分中小型題材股仍有買盤支撐，顯示資金並未全面撤出市場。

權值股方面，台積電(2330)開盤下跌5元，報2,420元，早盤最低來到2,400元，跌幅約0.41%；聯發科(2454)昨日強彈6.94%，今日下殺5%。聯電(2303)雖然釋出2027年平均售價成長10%的展望，但股價不漲反跌，一度打入跌停。台達電(2308)最低1,430元，下跌逾7%；光學股大立光(3008)同步走弱，玉晶光(3406)跌停，反映高價電子股獲利了結壓力。

熱門族群方面，PCB與CCL相對抗跌，PCB材料設備族群早盤上漲約2.04%，亞泰金屬(6727)攻上漲停，達航科技(4577)漲逾7%。高階銅箔基板龍頭台光電(2383)盤中上漲超過3%，台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)也力撐平盤附近，顯示AI伺服器高速傳輸需求仍是重要支撐。ABF載板族群則觀察欣興(3037)、景碩(3189)、南電(8046)能否延續昨日反彈，尤其景碩昨日攻上漲停，短線須留意追價買盤能否持續。被動元件方面，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)、禾伸堂(3026)仍是市場觀察指標，族群經過昨日反攻後，今日需留意高檔調節壓力。

整體而言，台股昨日急漲近千點，今日隨即出現回檔，顯示短線籌碼尚未完全穩定。後續觀察46600點附近能否形成有效支撐，以及台積電能否止跌、櫃買指數能否維持相對強勢。若PCB、CCL及矽光子族群買盤延續，仍有機會支撐盤面輪動，但短線不宜過度追價，應留意成交量與權值股走勢變化。

news.Title: 〈房產〉台積電效應發酵！高雄租屋熱區三民區連4年稱冠 楠梓區升至第二
news.Content:
台積電(2330-TW)擴大在半導體S廊帶的投資，使高雄租屋熱區也出現變化。房仲業者根據高雄市地政局億年旺網站資料統計，至今年5月，高雄市租屋熱區第一名，由三民區奪冠，三民區租屋件數占全市比例達17.3%，且自該網站2023年統計以來，三民區已連續四年蟬聯冠軍。

排名第二為楠梓區，進一步觀察，楠梓區2023年時全市排名僅在第五位，近年來一路爬升，已連續兩年穩居第二。其他包括苓雅、左營與鳳山區，均入榜前五大租屋熱區。

台灣房屋集團趨勢中心經理李家妮表示，三民區腹地廣、人口基數大，區內住宅供給選擇性多元，擁有車站商圈、高醫、陽明、後驛等多個成熟生活圈，部分區段具備捷運、輕軌機能，並擁有大型醫院，高醫大、文藻、高科大等多所大學城，加上三民區房價水位為市區中相對親民的區域，因此長期累積了穩定的上班族與學生租屋需求支撐，無論房屋買賣或租賃市場，均具有一定的市場性支撐。

李家妮指出，近年受惠台積電進駐高雄，帶動科技產業廊帶成形，除了挹注就業機會，也為周邊住宅、廠辦及商用不動產租賃帶來新的需求，從南高雄的亞灣區串連至北高雄的台積電產業聚落，觀察2026年高雄15個主要行政區中，就約有7成區域，包括楠梓、左營、新興、小港等區，租屋熱度均較往年增加。

其中楠梓區，原就有加工區產業及高大特區需求支撐，近年再受惠台積電設廠效應，帶動區域就業與居住需求升溫，尤其在2025年進入裝機量產後，就業人力陸續進駐，部分外地就業族群為保有工作轉換與居住安排的彈性，前期多會傾向先以租代買，偏好鎖定鄰近產業園區、交通便捷及生活機能成熟的區域，以縮短通勤時間、降低居住成本，進而推升該區租屋市場熱度。

進一步觀察今年高雄市住宅租屋偏好，以住宅大樓及整棟（戶）出租為熱門類型，且租賃佔比均呈現上升趨勢，其次為獨立套房，占比約2成，但較往年下滑約1.5個百分點；租客來源有約2成是來自於外縣市，主要來自於屏東、台南及台北市。

台灣房屋高鐵重愛加盟店店東陳揚智表示，以三民區、楠梓區來說，過去有不少透天隔間套房、雅房，因租金相對親民，深受學生及單身上班族青睞，近年隨著台積電設廠與產業建設帶動周邊房市發展，新大樓供給增加，大樓租賃案件也隨之成長。以台積電廠區周邊兩房大樓，月租金約在2- 2.3萬元，雖然租金高於公寓及透天隔套產品，但因具備電梯管理、休閒娛樂公設，整體居住品質及便利性，更受科技就業族群青睞。

陳揚智表示，近年高雄房價處於相對高檔，加上限貸令實施後，資金壓力與購屋門檻提高，同時考量租金補貼紅利，都可能讓部分小資購屋族，選擇先以租代買，以降低短期居住成本，為符合家庭客群，整層2-3房的大樓租件需求也相對擴大。

news.Title: 被聯電拖累！00927等「4檔台股ETF」臉綠 最重跌近3%
news.Content:
晶圓代工大廠聯電（2303）昨日召開法說會，公布第三季每股盈餘 1.32 元，並宣布追加逾千億台幣資本支出強攻先進封裝與矽光子技術，可龐大資本支出引發市場對折舊衝擊毛利率的疑慮，股價今天跌破半根停板，同步重創群益00927在內等4檔高含聯電 ETF表現，最重跌近3％，分析師莊佳螢指出，資本支出的利多效益仍需要時間沉澱與發酵，聯電短線反彈壓力較大。不過考量股價已大幅拉回，建議手中有個股或相關 ETF 的投資人無須急於此刻殺低，可觀察後續築底狀況再行打算。

聯電昨日（28）召開法說會並公布第三季財報。受上一季高基期影響，第三季歸屬母公司淨利為 164.3 億元，季減 61%，但仍較去年同期成長 12%，單季每股盈餘（EPS）為 1.32 元。此外，聯電董事會亦同步核准追加約 32 億美元（折合新台幣逾千億元）資本支出，宣示全力強攻先進封裝與「矽光子」等前瞻關鍵技術。

龐大的資本支出利多卻未能激勵市場信心，聯電今（29）日開低走低，盤中重挫逾9%至116元，一舉摜破5日線、10日線與季線等多條重要均線。回顧聯電股價才於9月22日創下168.5元高點，短短兩個月內已修正逾三成，今日盤中低點更刷新8月下旬以來的新低紀錄。

聯電今日爆量殺盤，也同步重創其他聯電高含量ETF表現。其中，聯電持股比重高達19.06% 的永豐台灣ESG（00888）盤中重挫 2.74%；持股比重均超過16%的兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）與第一金工業菁英30（00728），盤中也雙雙跌逾 2%，另外，群益半導體收益（00927）持股約 8.63%，跌幅也超過2%。

在一片半導體慘綠之中，僅有國泰股利精選30（00701）展現抗跌韌性。儘管該檔 ETF 含有約 13% 的聯電持股，但受惠於成分股中其他高股息與防禦型標的支撐，盤中表現逆勢抗跌，成為今日相關概念 ETF 中的少數亮點。

對於聯電法說會上利多不漲反重挫的走勢，摩爾投顧分析師莊佳螢分析，市場主要顧慮的是龐大資本支出帶來的副作用。大筆資金投入後，隨之而來的設備折舊攤提將直接衝擊明年的毛利率表現，進而壓抑 EPS 成長空間，因此利多效益仍需要時間沉澱與發酵。

莊佳螢指出，在折舊壓力與毛利率受壓的雙重干擾下，聯電短線要快速強勢反彈壓力較大，投資人恐面臨較高的時間成本。不過，考量到股價短線已大幅拉回，建議手中有聯電持股或相關ETF的投資人無須急於在此刻殺低，可觀察後續築底狀況再做打算。

news.Title: 台股狂飆939點是逃命波？ 陳嘉偉示警「台積電季線恐下彎」 最壞情境曝
news.Content:
台股28日強勢反攻，加權指數大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，漲幅達2.04%，不過成交金額僅約7223億元，量能未能同步放大。承通投顧副總陳嘉偉卻對後市提出警告，認為這波上漲可能只是大盤自高點修正逾4000點後的「空頭反彈」，不代表趨勢已經反轉。他直言，若投資人未把握反彈減碼，應重新檢視持股風險，並提醒11月行情可能面臨更大壓力。

陳嘉偉示警M頭風險

陳嘉偉28日在個人 YT頻道 中指出，台股單日大漲近千點，但成交量沒有明顯擴增，量價結構仍有疑慮；櫃買指數表現也相對疲弱。他認為，市場可能形成M頭型態，若後續跌破前波低點的頸線，恐進一步加深修正壓力。他更將當前國際市場環境形容為多重風險交錯，認為亞洲金融風暴、網路泡沫、金融海嘯及歐債危機等歷史經驗，值得投資人引以為戒。不過，這些判斷屬於他的市場分析，後續仍須觀察指數走勢與成交量變化。

台積電季線恐轉為反壓

陳嘉偉特別關注台積電（2330）的技術面。他指出，台積電近期股價表現相對大盤疲弱，外資賣壓也成為市場關注焦點。由於季線計算涉及過去股價，隨著高檔扣抵值移動，若扣抵位置高於目前股價，季線可能轉為下彎，形成上檔壓力。

他並引用台積電過去季線下彎期間的歷史經驗，指出股價曾分別下跌32.6%及46.2%，作為評估風險的參考。若以台股49,968點高點試算，指數下跌32.6%將來到約33,678點；若下跌46.2%，則可能下探約26,882點，接近他所指的5年線位置。上述數字是依特定跌幅推算的情境，並非對未來指數的確定預測。

科技巨頭財報牽動後市

除了技術面，陳嘉偉也將AI產業投資列為潛在風險。他認為，美國科技巨頭面臨兩難：若持續擴大資本支出，市場可能質疑企業融資及投資回收能力；若放慢投資腳步，又可能引發AI成長動能減弱、泡沫疑慮升高的擔憂。此外，資料中心建設進度、融資成本及AI應用的商業化成果，都將影響市場對科技股的評價。

他也提醒，微軟、Google及亞馬遜等科技巨頭的財報與資本支出展望，將是後續重要觀察指標。整體而言，台股雖然出現強勁反彈，但成交量、台積電季線走勢、外資動向及AI產業投資效益，仍是判斷行情能否延續的關鍵。投資人應審慎評估風險，避免僅憑單日大漲就認定多頭行情已全面回歸。

news.Title: 小韭菜退場主力要幹麻？ 達人揭「殘酷對決」：廝殺兇更隱蔽
news.Content:
小韭菜離場不代表風險降低，當市場成交量顯著萎縮、流動性變薄，主力與機構將展開更殘酷的暗處對決。

全球股市成交量顯著降溫

投資達人葉育碩表示，最近市場的熱度，很明顯感受到確實不如前幾個月。成交量縮了，討論區安靜了，連原本天天盯盤的朋友都開始問：「是不是該先觀望一下？」這不只是感覺，數據也說話了。高盛首席美股策略師本·斯奈德（Ben Snider）指出，美國散戶股票交易活躍度較2025年底下降約45%，散戶交易僅占美股總成交量約9%，接近2020年以來最低水平。把鏡頭拉回亞洲，台股成交量從5月單日1.87兆元的歷史天量，到10月28日僅剩約7,200億至7,400億元；A股成交額也從6月峰值3.8兆回落至1.6兆附近；港股南向資金則從持續流入轉為連續11個交易日淨流出。各個市場不約而同地出現同一個訊號：散戶在退場。

主力收割對象向上移階

葉育碩談到，散戶在主力眼裡，說白了就是市場裡的小韭菜。漲的時候追高，跌的時候恐慌，籌碼最容易鬆動，也最容易被收割。韭菜被割完，要長出來也是需要時間的，當這批人陸續離場，市場的韭菜供給自然變少。然而，市場裡那些主力、大戶、機構也就是俗稱的禿鷹，原本靠著收割散戶獲利，現在小韭菜不夠割了，他們會收手嗎？大概率不會，禿鷹的邏輯很簡單，哪裡有肉，就往哪裡去。當散戶退場、成交量萎縮，市場的流動性變薄，價格更容易被資金推動。這時候，主力資金的博弈對象就從散戶，轉向其他機構和大戶，也就是所謂的大韭菜。機構之間的對決，比的是資訊、資金和節奏，猶如神仙打架，廝殺更隱蔽，也更兇狠。換句話說，小韭菜退場不等於市場變安全，而是收割的層級往上移了一階。以前是禿鷹割散戶，現在可能是大禿鷹割小禿鷹，或者機構互割。

操作難度增加觀望也是策略

葉育碩強調，這種時候反而更可怕，因為熱度低，不等於風險低。成交量萎縮、散戶離場，市場看似冷清，但主力資金的博弈可能更集中、更劇烈。籌碼變薄、流動性變差，波動未必變小，甚至可能更難捉摸。也別急著當留下來的大韭菜，如果資金量、資訊面、心理素質都不占優勢，在機構互割的環境裡硬扛，風險不比追高時低。所以說，觀望，也是一種策略，熱度降溫時，現金為王不丟臉。等市場情緒回穩、成交量重新放大，再考慮進場，勝率往往更高

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】美股白漲了？台股失守4萬7大關急墜逾700點 分析師呂漢威：不易回平盤
news.Content:
美股昨日收高，費城半導體指數再度上漲，且Fed決議暫時不升息，不過台股今日早盤卻一度挫逾700點，最低觸及46,266點。資深證券分析師呂漢威指出，今日成交量預估在8000億元左右，低接買盤出現但未出現追買力道，在量能無法帶上來的情況下要在今日漲回來並不容易。

今日值班分析師： 資深證券分析師呂漢威

Fed如預期維持利率不變，美股方面，四大指數週三同步收紅，費半指數勁揚1.76%。不過台指期夜盤下跌128點，台股今日早盤也下挫逾600點。

呂漢威認為，昨日拉高之後，外資顯然還是有一些賣壓出現就今日的盤勢來看，有低接的買盤慢慢出現，但並沒有追買力道，因此要拉回平盤並不容易。

呂漢威也指出，現在這個時間點要漸漸地等待財報、營收出爐來刺激買盤，如今天的台光電等個股都有反映，但追價力道低導致漲勢無法擴張。

至於今日預估成交量，呂漢威認為，資金追買的意願並不高，量能相較昨日沒有擴張，帶約仍落在8000億元左右，還是呈現比較觀望的態勢，操作上還是建議逢低介入不追高避免風險。

news.Title: 富邦金拓美股延伸交易，雪梨分行搶攻企業金融
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 09:50:23 數位內容中心 發佈

富邦金（2881）第4季先由富邦證券開放美股盤前與盤後交易，補上一般交易時段外的下單需求，客戶可在美國上市公司財報、法說會與重要經濟數據公布前後直接委託。盤前交易時段為台灣時間16時至21時30分或17時至22時30分，盤後為4時至6時或5時至7時，現階段僅接受當日限價委託。

銀行版圖則往澳洲推進，台北富邦銀行已設立雪梨分行，成為富邦集團首個南半球據點，承作聯貸、雙邊融資、貿易融資與跨境金融服務，鎖定台商與跨國企業在紐澳及亞洲之間的資金調度需求。後續授信方向已涵蓋能源轉型、基礎建設、高科技及醫療生技，企業金融與機構金融成為當地業務主軸。

專案融資端已先落地。台北富邦銀行統籌主辦苗栗竹南頭份污水下水道BOT案33.5億元綠色聯貸，參貸機構13家，超額認購率198%，資金用於償還既有第一至三期工程借款，以及支應第四期建設與新增用戶接管。竹南頭份系統目前已完成43,131戶接管，第四期預計再增加16,000戶，現有水資源處理中心每日可處理生活污水3.1萬噸。台北富邦銀行在新南向授信擴張速度也居前，2026年前9月授信餘額較2025年底增加607億元，排名國銀第2。

財務面上，富邦金2026年前9月稅後淨利1,272.2億元，EPS為8.8元，雙創歷史同期次高，其中富邦人壽前9月FVOCI股票處分利得累計1,227.4億元，對保留盈餘影響數達2,499.6億元。台北富邦銀行截至2026年8月底外幣存款餘額為1兆3,017億元，在國銀排名第4，富邦人壽截至2025年度綠色金融投資規模達1.99兆元，2030年目標較基準年成長32%。

news.Title: 台股站回季線！ 杜金龍持股拉高至7成 「這3檔」緊抱到過年
news.Content:
台股多頭強勢反攻！台股加權指數28日大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，重新站回4萬7千點大關及季線，為近期震盪行情注入強心針。資深分析師杜金龍認為，台股在4萬6000點附近已展現支撐力道，隨著融資餘額快速下降、籌碼逐步沉澱，年底至明年初的跨年行情值得期待。他透露，已將個人持股比重從6成提高至7成以上，並點名台積電（2330）、欣興（3037）、南亞（1303）3檔個股，認為後續表現值得關注。

杜金龍持股加碼至7成

台股近期經歷一波修正，市場一度擔憂外資賣壓與籌碼鬆動，不過杜金龍觀察，大盤在45,676點附近出現支撐，指數跌破4萬6000點後也迅速反彈，加上短線融資餘額下降，有助於籌碼沉澱。他因此將持股比重從原本的6成提高至7成以上，對後續行情抱持期待。

至於進場節奏，杜金龍提出3個觀察時點，包括大盤大幅拉回時逢低布局、美國選舉前後，以及台灣選舉前後。他預估，11月下旬起台股有機會迎來跨年反彈行情，動能可能延續至2027年2月初，甚至5月。依據波浪理論推估，指數波段高點可望挑戰5萬3000點至6萬點，但實際走勢仍須觀察國際局勢、資金流向及市場基本面變化。

台積電、欣興、南亞成焦點

個股方面，杜金龍首先看好權值股台積電。他透露，先前在2420元及2390元分批買進，並觀察2380元附近的支撐力道。台積電28日上漲25元，收在2425元，後續表現仍須留意先進製程需求、AI晶片成長動能及外資買賣超。至於外資喊出的5000元長線目標價，仍屬市場預估，並非股價保證。

第二檔是ABF載板廠欣興。杜金龍透露以1090元買進，關注法說會釋出的營運展望，以及AI相關需求對載板產業的帶動。市場法人目標價則有1500元至1800元的評估，後續仍需觀察產業景氣、訂單及獲利表現。

第三檔為南亞。文章指出，南亞近期成交量放大，市場關注其轉投資南電、南亞科的表現，以及相關投資價值對公司淨值的影響。部分外資與本土法人將目標價調升至400元以上，惟股價能否進一步走高，仍取決於塑化景氣、轉投資績效與整體市場氣氛。

跨年行情能否延續？

台股28日大漲近千點，重新站回4萬7000點，短線氣氛明顯回溫。杜金龍看好4萬6000點附近的支撐，並提高個人持股比重，反映其對跨年行情的樂觀看法。不過，指數能否持續上攻、個股目標價是否實現，仍有不確定性。投資人布局台積電、欣興及南亞等標的時，仍應評估自身風險承受能力，留意股價波動、產業基本面與資金變化，避免單憑市場預測追高。

（封面圖／翻攝《賺錢放大術》YT頻道）
