news.Title: 華東Q4營收看續增  毛利率估穩健
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 09:36:14 王怡茹 發佈

記憶體封測廠華東(8110)受惠記憶體封測需求維持高檔，加上價格調漲效益持續發酵，第三季營收22.63億元，季增16.5%、年增20.9%，創2023年以來單季新高。展望第四季，法人表示，隨主要客戶訂單需求持強，加上封測漲價效益持續挹注，預期營收可望續呈季增，明年展望亦樂觀。

華東隸屬華新麗華(1605)集團，營運以記憶體IC封裝及測試為主，為全球主要記憶體封測業者之一，主力產品為利基型DRAM封測，客戶包括南亞科(2408)、華邦電(2344)等。公司近年持續提高集團企業客戶業務比重，其中華邦電為重要客戶，亦為近年營運成長動能之一。

從營收走勢來看，華東今年7月營收6.88億元，8月進一步攀升至7.98億元，創47個月新高，9月營收則為7.77億元、月減2.66%、年增19.11%；第三季合併營收22.63億元，季增16.5%、年增20.9%，創2023年以來單季新高。累計前三季營收61.76億元、年增15.98%。

獲利方面，華東今年上半年毛利率9.57%，較去年同期轉正；營益率2.74%，亦較去年同期轉正，歸屬母公司稅後淨利13.29億元，每股稅後盈餘(EPS)2.59元，上半年獲利已超越去年全年。

法人分析，隨上游記憶體原廠產能維持高檔，後段封測供需持續緊俏，封測協力廠今年初已陸續啟動漲價，幅度約2至3成，帶動華東毛利率明顯改善。隨主要客戶訂單需求維持強勁，加上價格調整效益持續挹注，預期公司第四季營收有機會較第三季成長，毛利率則有望維持10%左右水準。

此外，華邦電日前宣布，將以全現金方式取得英飛凌(Infineon Technologies)旗下NOR Flash及F-RAM相關事業重組後100%股權，交易預計2027年下半年完成。法人認為，隨主要客戶持續擴大記憶體事業布局，中長期有利華東爭取更多封測委外商機。

news.Title: Google財報暴雷拖累！台積電下殺10元回測季線 分析師：買黑不買紅
news.Content:
Google財報暴雷！台積電（2330） 今（29）日盤中跌10元回測季線，終結連二漲，分析師表示，外資還在觀望中，但台積電基本面表現無虞，一旦不確定性消弭仍有機會挑戰前高 2,590 元，投資人可秉持「買黑不買紅」原則，可趁股價貼近季線2420元附近逢低分批布局。

美國聯準會（Fed）如期維持利率不變，市場目光轉向企業關鍵財報表現，激勵美股四大指數周三（28日）全數收紅，寫下連三漲紀錄，費城半導體指數勁揚 1.75%，台積電 ADR 表現穩健，上漲 2.64 美元（或 0.60%），收在 439.51 美元。

在美股收紅的背景下，台股今（29）日早盤卻未能延續多頭氣勢，權值股台積電開低走低，盤中最低觸及2,415 元，下跌10 元（跌幅約 0.41％）。

國泰證期顧問處協理郭經緯指出，外資目前態度轉趨觀望，使台積電股價於季線約2,420元附近震盪整理。不過從基本面來看，台積電營運表現無虞，先前法說會不僅對第四季展望保持正向，也重申對人工智慧（AI）強勁需求不變，晶圓代工與先進封裝的能見度更已達明年。

郭經緯分析，近期干擾市場的主要因素，來自美國期中選舉的不確定性，以及部分科技巨頭的財報表現。以 Google 母公司Alphabet為例，雖然在 AI 帶動下雲端業務營收翻倍，但龐大的基礎建設資本支出持續消耗現金，加上股權投資出現鉅額虧損，引發市場疑慮。不過，一旦這些短期不確定性逐漸消弭，台積電後續仍有機會挑戰前高2,590元。

針對投資人近期的操作策略，郭經緯建議採取「買黑不買紅」原則，可趁股價貼近季線時逢低分批布局。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 超越"超級循環" 測試設備商愛德萬再升財測 股價飆
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 09:22:32 蔡承啟 發佈

AI相關半導體市場進入高速成長階段、超越「超級循環(Supercycle)」，全球半導體測試設備巨擘、輝達(Nvidia)測試設備供應商愛德萬測試(Advantest)再度調升財測，財測優於市場預期，且宣布買回庫藏股。今日股價聞訊飆漲。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間29日上午8點55分為止，愛德萬飆漲8.02%至37,730日圓，今年迄今股價累計狂飄約92%。

愛德萬28日於日股盤後公布財報新聞稿指出，隨著AI普及，帶動測試設備需求超乎預期，因此今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)合併營收目標自原先(7月)預估的1兆7,140億日圓上修至1兆8,630億日圓(將年增65.1%)、合併營益目標自8,460億日圓上修至9,670億日圓(將年增93.7%)、合併純益目標自6,600億日圓上修至7,415億日圓(將年增97.5%)，營收、營益、純益將續創歷史新高紀錄。此為愛德萬繼7月之後、第2度上修今年度財測預估。

日媒報導，愛德萬集團CEO Douglas Lefever在28日舉行的財報說明會上表示，「AI相關半導體市場正處於高速成長階段，甚至可稱為超越『超級循環(Supercycle)』的『巨型循環(Megacycle)』。愛德萬將提前擴充產能、大幅加快擴產速度」。

路透社報導，分析師平均預估愛德萬今年度純益將為6,637億日圓，愛德萬上修過後的數值優於市場預期。

愛德萬將今年度「測試系統事業」銷售額(營收)目標自原先預估的1兆5,750億日圓上修至1兆7,145億日圓。其中，SoC用測試設備銷售額目標自1兆2,435億日圓上修至1兆3,750億日圓、記憶體用測試設備銷售額目標自2,270億日圓上修至2,290億日圓。

愛德萬同時公布上季(2026年7-9月)財報：合併營收較去年同期暴增81.7%至4,777億日圓、合併營益飆增146.0%至2,668億日圓、合併純益飆增142.7%至1,933億日圓。

就部門別銷售情況來看，上季愛德萬「測試系統事業」銷售額暴增83.9%至4,367億日圓。其中，SoC用測試設備銷售額飆增103.3%至3,533億日圓、記憶體用測試設備銷售額大增21.6%至534億日圓。

就區域別銷售情況來看，上季愛德萬於台灣市場的銷售額較去年同期飆增126.4%至2,613億日圓、中國市場銷售額暴增72.9%至901億日圓、南韓銷售額增加15.1%至646億日圓。

愛德萬並於28日宣布，將祭出庫藏股買回措施，買回上限為2,800億日圓、1,100萬股(佔已發行股數比重1.5%)，買回期間為2026年10月29日-2027年3月24日。

(圖片來源： 愛德萬 )

news.Content:
10:05更新：台股賣壓沉重，盤中一度下跌768.84點觸及46266.74點，台達電跌逾6%觸及1455元，聯發科跌逾3%，台積電下跌25元至2400元，廣達跌逾2%，聯電一度跌停殺至115.5元。

展望台股後市，工商報導，統一投顧董事長黎方國說，台股短線負乖離過大，並有聯發科、台達電、聯電等電子大廠法說及鴻海科技日等利多登場，上市櫃第三季獲利亮眼，賣壓逐步消化下有助回歸基本面。

news.Title: 台股千點反攻是逃命？專家警告要出大事 台積電季線下彎空頭風暴
news.Content:
台股昨（28）日強勢反彈開高走高，收盤大漲939.35點，以47035.58點作收，但成交量僅7221億。但承通投顧副總陳嘉偉直言，「這個反彈是讓你逃命」，因為量才是價的根本，但今天的反彈成交量太少，其實是台股跌了4千多點後的空頭反彈。

陳嘉偉在個人YT節目中指出，台股昨單日上漲逾900點，但成交量未能同步放大，反彈的持續性仍有待觀察，從技術分析角度來看，價格與成交量必須相互配合。因此他提醒，如果沒有利用昨天大漲跑掉，今天早上一定要賣掉，不然真的就出大事了。」

陳嘉偉預期台股將迎來年線的對稱跌幅，甚至恐下探5年線，11月恐將更慘，因為弱勢反彈會往下跌破頸線。而且他認為這次全球股市是完美風暴，結合1997年亞洲金融風暴、2000年網路泡沫、以及2008年的金融海嘯和2010年的歐債危機利空，正面臨多重風險交錯的環境。

此外，陳嘉偉也將美國科技股及人工智慧（AI）產業的資本支出列為另一項重要風險。尤其大陸開源實驗室占全世界Token使用量達70%，「美國人賺不到一毛錢」，加上美國民眾反對建設資料中心、建設延誤，舉債投資市場上也不買帳，如果投資回收不如預期，企業可能必須重新調整資本支出計畫，甚至尋求其他融資方式。

再從台股指標股台積電來看，10月法說會股價也沒有爬起來，外資拚命倒貨。他認為現在台積電表現遠比台股弱，已形成季線下彎，而台積電很少季線下彎，前一次是因川普關稅大跌32.6%，往前一次季線下彎是俄烏戰爭下跌46.2%。

陳嘉偉分析，萬一這次台積電下跌32.6%，若台股跌幅一樣，將是年線對稱跌幅；如果台積電跌到46.2%，台股則會跌到約26882點，即5年線位置。他再度強調台股M頭已經做完了，第二個頭已經開始崩盤，「空頭大屠殺只是剛開始。」

news.Title: 外資上週狂買日股1.18兆日圓、扭轉賣超，日債買超驟減逾九成
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本財務省週四(29日)公布最新跨境證券投資統計顯示，截至10月24日止當週，外國投資人淨買進日本股票及投資基金持分1兆1,809億日圓，扭轉前一週淨賣出675億日圓的局面，顯示海外資金重新加碼日本股市。不過，外資同期淨買進日本中長期債券僅433億日圓，較前一週修正後的1兆4,543億日圓大幅縮減約97%，反映外資對日本股票與債券的配置出現明顯分化。從股票市場資金動向觀察，外資在10月初一度大幅加碼日股，截至10月10日止當週買超金額達3兆5,455億日圓，隨後一週小幅賣超675億日圓，最新一週再度轉為逾1兆日圓買超，反映海外資金對日本股市的投資意願仍有支撐。然而，單週資金流入並不代表市場已形成持續買超趨勢，後續仍須觀察海外機構投資人對日本企業獲利、利率政策及股市估值的評估。

債券市場方面，外資對日本中長期債券雖維持淨買進，但買超規模由1兆4,543億日圓驟降至433億日圓，顯示資金流入動能顯著放緩。與此同時，外資淨賣出日本短期債券1兆1,817億日圓，抵銷中長期債券買盤後，外資對日本債券整體仍呈淨賣出。由於日本公債殖利率走高、日銀貨幣政策正常化及全球利率變動持續影響投資配置，外資對不同期限債券的需求差異，仍是觀察日本金融市場的重要指標。

日本投資人海外配置則呈現買股、賣債格局。截至10月24日止當週，日本投資人淨買進海外股票及投資基金持分2,881億日圓，高於前一週的1,283億日圓；海外中長期債券淨賣出926億日圓，較前一週賣超1,605億日圓收斂，顯示日資持續調整海外債券部位，但減碼幅度有所縮小。市場將持續關注日本公債殖利率、日銀利率政策及全球金融市場變化，評估海外資金回流日股與日本投資人調整跨境資產配置的趨勢能否延續。

news.Title: 【股市焦點】南亞科441元貴不貴？新光證券：供給變化成關鍵
news.Content:
記憶體景氣強勢復甦，南亞科(2408-TW)第3季獲利同步衝上高峰，但股價已提前出現修正，市場開始關注這波DRAM漲價行情還能延續多久。

南亞科第3季營收達1,336.49億元，毛利率85.7%、營益率80%，單季每股稅後純益（EPS）25.4元，稅後淨利876.27億元。第3季DRAM ASP季增逾60%，即使位元出貨量季減中個位數，營收仍較第2季成長61.9%，顯示本波獲利主要由價格上漲帶動。公司10月法說也表示，第4季DRAM市場仍處於缺貨狀態，ASP與毛利率仍有續升空間。

新光證券表示，南亞科第3季毛利率達85.7%，反映DRAM平均售價（ASP）大幅上揚、既有產線成本基礎相對低，以及新廠折舊尚未全面進入成本等因素；以股價441元推算，若採5倍峰值獲利本益比，隱含ASP較第3季回落約11%，若採12倍正常化獲利評價，則隱含ASP下跌約52%，顯示市場已開始交易未來景氣正常化的風險。

延伸市場分析，開始配置你的台美股投資

新光證券指出，股價走勢已開始反映更長期的循環變化。南亞科股價10月初高點一度來到537元，至10月26日最低收在414元，波段回檔約23%，隔日反彈至441元。若直接將第3季EPS年化，全年獲利約101.6元，441元股價對應本益比僅約4.3倍；但新光證券提醒，循環股不能單純以單季高峰獲利年化評價，真正關鍵在於高價能維持多久，以及市場願意給予多少本益比。

新光證券分析，中國長鑫存儲的技術進展也值得留意。長鑫已公布4F² DRAM架構進展，並計畫於年底推出伺服器DDR5 RDIMM，但產品推出仍不等於大規模有效供給，後續仍須觀察客戶認證與良率爬坡。

至於SK海力士，雖然獲利強勁並計畫增加投資，但已與主要客戶簽訂涵蓋2027至2028年逾半產能的長期供貨協議，新增投資是否超過已鎖定需求，同樣是判斷供給壓力的關鍵。

在AI巨頭Anthropic表態未來將採購8000億美元的AI晶片利多帶動下，台股早盤以46,402點紅盤開出後，多頭大軍氣勢如虹，AI類股全面大漲，上漲家數超過1千3百家，指數終場幾乎以全日最高點47,035點作收，狂噴939點，一舉站上47,000點大關。權值股方面，台積電上漲1.04%、鴻海上漲1.61%、聯發科上漲6.94%、廣達上漲0.76%，台達電上漲2.64%。盤面強勢股，景碩、創意、富喬、穩懋、金像電、玉晶光、晶豪科、全新等漲停；聯發科、南亞、南亞科、健策、日月光投控、台燿、精材、華新科、友達、信驊等漲幅6%以上。盤面弱勢股，泓德能源、川飛跌停；宏正、浩鼎、安克、巨虹等跌幅5%以上。終場台灣加權指數上漲939.35點，以47035.58點作收，成交量7221.36億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股漲跌互見，電子上漲2.48%、傳產上漲1.09%、金融下跌0.56%。次族群方面，以塑膠、光電、電子零組件表現較佳，分別上漲5.35%、5.11及4.38%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計買超324.42億元。其中外資買超159.57億元，投信買超143.2億元，自營商買超21.65億元。外資買超前五大為友達、華邦電、群創、力積電、聯電；賣超前五大為旺宏、欣銓、台玻、寶成、華航。投信買超前五大為日月光投控、華新科、頎邦、元大金、全新；賣超前五大為兆豐金、台塑化、彰銀、聯電、貿聯-KY。資券變化方面，融資增89.13億元，融資餘額為6323億元，融券減2.47萬張，融券餘額為19.3萬張。外資台指期部位，空單減少1,050口，淨空單部位84,917口，借券賣出金額234.22億元。成交比重：電子85.19%、傳產12.30%、金融2.51%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

美國聯準會如預期維持利率不變，主席華許強調抗通膨決心，但市場仍押注12月有升息可能；與此同時，胡塞襲擊阿拉伯煉油廠引發恐慌，壓抑高估值族群表現。所幸SK海力士釋出HBM極佳展望，激勵其美股ADR暴漲13.3%、美光大漲5.86%，甲骨文亦大漲10.73%。美股四大指數週三同步收紅，費半指數勁揚1.76%。美股盤後科技巨頭財報好壞互見，微軟盤後股價上漲逾4%，Alphabet則不如預期，盤後重挫逾7%。整體預估今日指數震盪盤堅。台股後市分析如下：

第一、全球記憶體二哥SK海力士於法說會震撼宣布，旗下DRAM與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）產能到2029年已全數完售，並與14家大客戶簽署長約，預期供不應求將一路延續至2030年。

第二、日本政府在27日稍晚決定，對來自中國和台灣、以不正當低價出口的含鎳冷軋不鏽鋼板徵收反傾銷稅，為期5年，從10月31日開始課徵。日本將對來自中國的產品課徵27.7%和42.1%的關稅，對來自台灣的產品課徵3.6%和20.1%的關稅。

第三、技術面觀察，週三指數拉出一根長大紅K棒，強勢收復10日均線。下檔指標方面，KD與RSI指標同步昂首向上，MACD黑柱體亦顯著縮小，短線結構已由整理重回多方主導。

四、盤面資金聚焦IC設計、PCB、探針卡等族群，包括創意、智原、富喬、金像電、中探針、精測等表現強勢。

【投資策略】：

中東地緣戰火再度升溫推升油價，疊加美國10年期公債殖利率上漲、Fed內部仍有鷹派升息雜音，對國際金融市場帶來波動壓力，加上微軟與Google財報盤後好壞參半，使台股反彈之路遭受壓力。但SK海力士獲利暴增、甲骨文擴大導入AI伺服器等實質利多帶動下，費半連四日反彈。在通膨黏性與海外財報分化影響下，預期大盤呈現高檔震盪格局。操作建議保持適度資金彈性，避免過度槓桿，逢回布局，AI概念及業績題材股，搭配短期營收動能股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、PCB供應鏈、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、塑化及特用化學等。

news.Title: OpenAI擬向Google採購AI晶片，台積電CoWoS與HBM供應壓力升高
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 08:33:20 數位內容中心 發佈

- OpenAI據報計劃向Google採購AI晶片，並透過Google Cloud部署最先進模型，市場焦點再度回到算力供應分配[1]。

- 當前最直接的瓶頸仍在先進封裝CoWoS與HBM記憶體供給。台積電傳出擬調漲CoWoS報價、拉長交期，HBM價格也預期大幅走升，短期供給難以同步放大[2][3]。

- 接下來，市場將觀察台積電CoWoS產能釋出進度，以及中國HBM良率是否如業界預期改善；同時，OpenAI採購規模、交期與封裝形式，也將牽動供應壓力如何在供應鏈間轉移[2][4][1]。

2026-10-28，科技媒體The Information引述知情人士報導，OpenAI正計劃向Google採購人工智慧晶片，並已與Google就透過Google Cloud提供最先進模型達成合作意向；報導未披露交易金額或交付規模，雙方也未置評[1]。消息傳出後，資本市場與供應端迅速反應，投資人與業界焦點再度回到最核心的問題：誰能提供足夠算力。

資金轉向記憶體與封裝族群

10月28日，市場資金明顯轉向記憶體與封裝相關族群，外資與投信大舉買超記憶體、台積電及封裝供應鏈個股。報導點名南亞科、台積電與華邦電獲單日巨量買超，顯示投資人正提前卡位可能的漲價與備貨題材[5][2]。同時，市場傳出台積電擬將CoWoS封裝報價調高最高20%，並把設備交期拉長至約8個月；若消息屬實，封裝成本與交期變化將立刻成為下游廠商必須面對的變數[2]。

CoWoS與HBM短期都難解壓

供應緊張並非一時形成。先進封裝CoWoS產能持續吃緊，雖然台積電與外部封測廠都在擴產，但產能釋放需要時間，封裝良率、載板與中介層等協同問題，也讓實際有效產能難以快速提升，訂單已有外溢至聯電、Amkor與其他OSAT業者的跡象[6][7][2]。法人估計，台積電CoWoS月產能正朝逾13萬片推進，長期目標上看20萬片，但短期供需缺口仍須由外溢廠分擔[2][6]。

記憶體方面，研究機構預估HBM供應吃緊恐將延續，明年HBM綜合平均售價（ASP）估計年增約121%。價格大幅上揚，已迫使終端廠調整記憶體搭載策略，業界也開始討論以降低HBM堆疊高度，例如從12hi降為8hi，來局部紓解成本與供給壓力[3][8]。另有陸方消息稱，國產HBM良率可能在半年內由約25%提升至40%至50%；若能實現，將有助擴充可用供給，但良率改善能否迅速轉化為出貨、進一步壓低ASP，仍有不確定性[4]。

產業一線的回應也反映出供給瓶頸。中華精測總經理黃水可在10月法說指出，多家大型IC設計客戶反映，當前最大挑戰在於產能跟不上成長速度。該公司今年HPC營收占比已由第二季的56.3%升至第三季的65.9%，並推動公司對明年營收近五成成長的預期，顯示AI相關拉貨壓力已一路傳導至封裝、HBM與先進製程等上游節點[9]。

全球主要雲端服務供應商（CSP）資本支出仍居高不下，九大CSP未來一到兩年的投資規模預期持續擴張，成為推升AI伺服器、GPU與HBM長期需求的重要背景；同時，GPU租賃價格與二級市場走勢也反映算力資產稀缺，進一步驅使雲端業者與AI實驗室尋找更多供應來源[10][11][12]。

新訂單只會把壓力往上游推

若OpenAI確實向Google大量採購晶片，短期對輝達（NVIDIA）的直接需求衝擊仍難量化，但任何新增系統訂單，都會一路傳導至台積電CoWoS與HBM等上游節點，放大既有缺口或改變分配方式[1][2]。系統整合端的反應已見端倪：ODM廠廣達表示，AI伺服器訂單能見度旺到2028年，顯示CSP及大型客戶拉貨動能仍在，眼前更像是供給受限，而非需求降溫[13][11]。

供應鏈目前主要沿兩條路徑調節壓力：一是台積電持續擴產，並由外溢廠承接部分訂單，縮小CoWoS缺口；二是下游廠商在HBM價格與良率不確定下，調整晶片設計與採購策略，包括降低HBM堆疊、改用不同記憶體組合，或加速自研ASIC，以避開高昂記憶體成本與封裝供給瓶頸[6][3][14]。此外，若OpenAI採購案包含完整系統封裝（如CoWoS套餐），短期壓力可能只是從GPU封裝端轉移到載板、封裝良率及HBM供給上[3][2]。

目前仍有幾項不確定因素待市場驗證：OpenAI採購規模、交期與是否包含系統整合細節尚未明朗，HBM價格走勢與CoWoS交期能否在短期內被供應鏈吸收，以及監管與地緣政治（如出口管制）對跨境算力採購的影響，都將左右供給如何重新分配[3][2][15][16]。

台積電能否如市場預期加快CoWoS月產能爬升，以及中國HBM廠良率提升能否真正轉化為可出貨供給，將影響這輪算力爭奪中，哪些廠商能先緩解壓力、哪些環節仍會持續卡關[2][4]。

news.Title: 台股反攻訊號？杜金龍：抱緊「這3檔」賺到明年Q1
news.Content:
財經中心／李明融報導

台北股市在經歷連日震盪洗盤後，昨（28）日多頭全面吹起反攻號角！加權指數狂飆939.35點、收在47,035.58點，不僅強勢收復4萬7千點大關，更一口氣站回季線之上。面對先前外資瘋狂拋售引發的市場恐慌，素有「股市老先覺」之稱的資深分析師杜金龍精準研判，大盤在45,676點至4萬6千點附近已展現銅牆鐵壁般的強勁支撐，且融資短線快速「減肥」、籌碼趨於乾淨，他已用真金白銀以身作則，將自身持股水位從原本的6成一口氣拉高至7成多；杜金龍更直言，年底至明年初的「跨年大行情」正式啟動，只要鎖定並抱緊台積電（2330）、欣興（3037）、南亞（1303）這3檔核心標的，就有機會一路賺到明年第一季。

波浪理論上看6萬點，三大關鍵進場時間點曝光。（資料照／民視新聞網）

波浪理論上看6萬點！三大關鍵進場時間點曝光　跨年行情一路旺到明年

「只要大跌，就是最好的買點！」杜金龍指出，大盤在殺破4萬6千點後迅速迎來護盤買盤進駐，短線底部型態已經確立，台股長線多頭主升段架構依然穩如泰山。他進一步公開這波反彈的「三大關鍵進場節奏」：第一波為大盤大幅急跌拉回時的逢低撿便宜時機；第二波落在美國大選前後的局勢明朗期；第三波則鎖定在台灣選舉前後（約11月27至29日）。杜金龍預估，隨著國內外政治干擾因素逐步沉澱，11月下旬起台股將迎來波瀾壯闊的跨年反彈大行情，這股上漲動能可望一路熱絡延續至2027年2月初乃至5月，依據波浪理論推算，指數波段高點上看53,000至60,000點，甚至已有外資喊出57,000點高標，凸顯長多格局並未改變。

台積電護盤神山目標價喊5千，老先覺點名「抱緊這3檔」。（資料照／民視新聞網）

台積電護盤神山目標價喊5千！欣興、南亞爆量換手　老先覺點名「抱緊這3檔」

要在這波千點反攻浪潮中搶佔先機，杜金龍點名三大值得重押抱緊的指標股。首先是權值龍頭台積電（2330），杜金龍透露已在2,420元與2,390元分批掛單抄底，分析其在2,380元附近擁有極為堅實的政府基金護盤支撐，長線更獲外資評估目標價上看5,000元，28日股價隨即強彈25元收在2,425元，後續只需緊盯先進製程與AI晶片需求，續航力無庸置疑；其次為ABF載板龍頭欣興（3037），杜金龍於1,090元買進卡位，看好法說會釋出的強勁展望，法人目標價已上看1,500至1,800元，產業領頭羊地位預期一路延伸至2028年；最後則是傳產老將南亞（1303），近期爆出歷史天量完成籌碼完美換手，受惠於轉投

news.Title: Microsoft and Alphabet Just Reported Earnings, Putting the AI Boom to the Test
news.Content: Two tech behemoths -- Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) and Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) -- reported earnings today. Both showed strong cloud growth, but the market is treating them very differently. Microsoft shares popped after hours while Alphabet stock sank. Why? I think a big part of the answer is how each plans to pay for the massive outlays both have planned. ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Both Microsoft and Alphabet reported strong cloud growth, but market reactions differed significantly, with Microsoft shares rising and Alphabet's falling.
• Microsoft's Q3 revenue was $92.3 billion (up 19% YoY), with Azure cloud revenue growing 48% to $33.17 billion.
• Alphabet's Q3 revenue was $127.6 billion (up 25% YoY), with Google Cloud revenue growing 103% to $30.7 billion and operating income of $11.1 billion.
• Alphabet's free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion due to $51.4 billion in capital expenditures, leading to a significant increase in long-term debt.
• Microsoft remained free cash flow positive, though its figure decreased by 27% YoY, with expectations of continued capex expansion.
news.Keywords: earnings, cloud growth, capital expenditures, free cash flow, debt financing, market reaction

news.Title: AI Spending Is Nearing $1 Trillion Annually. These 2 Stocks Are Most at Risk If It Slows.
news.Content:
Artificial intelligence (AI) capital expenditures are approaching $1 trillion annually, which is driving massive opportunities for chipmakers. But investors are growing increasingly concerned about how sustainable this spending boom really is.

Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) have been two major beneficiaries of the AI build-out spending spree, and both once again reported record results in their most recent quarters. That said, both could face a reality check if tech giants start cutting back on their AI investments. And one has more to lose.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Nvidia still has the most to lose if AI spending cools

The AI boom has been a big catalyst for Nvidia's surging stock price, but there's a natural catch: The company's growth is now closely tied to how much money the world's biggest tech companies are willing to pour into AI infrastructure .

Nvidia's latest results show just how strong that demand has been. In its fiscal 2027 second quarter, which ended July 26, the company reported revenue of $96.2 billion, with its data center business generating $89 billion.

Indeed, revenue from that segment more than doubled from a year earlier, reflecting the intense demand for compute power to train and run advanced AI models.

Now that the vast majority of its sales are coming from the AI build-out, if cloud providers start to delay data center projects, struggle to generate attractive returns, or decide that existing compute capacity is enough, orders for its chips could weaken. Plus, Nvidia faces intensifying competition from peer GPU makers like AMD and also from tech giants developing their own custom AI chips, while export restrictions could further limit its growth.

For investors, what matters is that AI demand continues to grow and supports AI infrastructure spending.

Nvidia could remain a dominant business even if infrastructure spending slows, but its stock could still face pressure if investors start to question how long its momentum can last.

Still, analysts are optimistic about the stock, with the vast majority of those covering the stock rating it a buy or a strong buy. The average 12-month price target implies a potential upside of roughly 51%, but at a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of roughly 24 times, investors aren't expecting the same rapid growth rates that prevailed at the start of the AI build-out.

Story Continues

Memory demand is strong, but a supply glut could hurt Micron

That brings us to another company with a different but equally important role in the AI build-out: Micron, which makes memory chips that are vital for keeping AI systems running optimally.

Micron has become a major beneficiary of the surge in demand for high bandwidth memory (HBM), a specialized type of memory that's heavily used in advanced AI chips. Having enough of those chips on board allows them to efficiently access and process the large volumes of data that AI workloads require.

Its latest results reflect just how far demand has outstripped supply. The company reported fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter revenue of $54.2 billion and full-year revenue of $133.2 billion -- both record figures.

Looking ahead, management expects another strong year of AI-driven demand across the business. Plus, the company reported that its HBM4 products entered high-volume shipments for its lead customer's platform.

However, memory is a cyclical business, and if history repeats itself, today's bull market will not last.

If Micron and its peers expand production aggressively in pursuit of greater market share amid this period of high prices, supply will eventually catch up with demand, resulting in memory prices falling. Too great an oversupply (perhaps as a result of overall demand slackening) would create a glut, leading to tumbling margins.

That could feed into a potential slowdown in AI spending.

Large customers could become more cautious about ordering memory, while new production capacity creates supply that's no longer needed.

On top of that, Micron has high capital expenditure needs, manufacturing risks, and faces competition from the handful of other major memory producers.

Still, nearly all Wall Street analysts covering Micron rate it a buy, with the average 12-month price target suggesting roughly 75% potential upside. But it trades at a forward P/E of just 5, which reflects investors' recognition that it operates in what has historically been a highly cyclical business that faces the risk of a meaningful downturn once this boom phase ends.

That's why even AI's biggest winners aren't without risk.

Nvidia and Micron could struggle if AI spending slows

Nvidia and Micron offer exposure to two important parts of the AI cycle, but neither is immune to a pullback in AI spending. As long as AI investment continues to expand, both companies should benefit; if spending growth cools, the market might quickly reassess their valuations.

Should AI spending slow, Nvidia looks like a better pick for investors who want a dominant business.

news.Title: Global stocks hold gains after Fed decision, oil prices rise
news.Content:
By Chris Prentice and Amanda Cooper

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Global stocks and major Wall Street indexes gained on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, as expected, and oil prices rose on renewed concerns over supply disruptions.

In a 10-2 decision, the US central bank said it ‌would maintain its benchmark interest rate within the current 3.75%-4.00% range.

The Fed upgraded its assessment of the economy while acknowledging inflation "remains elevated." After the release, ‌Fed Chair Kevin Warsh told reporters the central bank has made clear its willingness and readiness to act.

US Treasury yields gave up gains briefly after Warsh's comments. [US/]

Spot gold prices advanced in choppy trade. [GOL/]

MSCI's gauge of stocks ​across the globe rose 4.29 points, or 0.38%, to 1,134.03.

On Wall Street, the Dow Jones Industrial Average .DJI rose 97.53 points, or 0.19%, to 52,475.10, the S&P 500 .SPX gained 21.37 points, or 0.28%, to 7,743.97 and the Nasdaq Composite .IXIC gained 72.04 points, or 0.27%, to 26,549.85.

The pan-European STOXX 600 index rose 0.07%.

MORE EXPECTED FROM CENTRAL BANKS

The Fed's decision "reflects the continued balancing act between inflation concerns and an economy and employment situation that have remained relatively resilient," said Charlie Wise, head of global research at TransUnion in Chicago.

Earlier, market moves had been mostly modest ahead ‌of the Fed decision, outside Asia.

New Zealand's central bank surprised ⁠investors by leaving interest rates on hold, contrary to expectations for a hike, while the Bank of Canada raised rates for the first time in three years.

The European Central Bank and Bank of Japan are expected to issue policy decisions this week as well.

Traders' attention will ⁠also turn to Thursday's US Personal Consumption Expenditures data, which could offer further insight into the trajectory of monetary policy.

Financial markets are pricing in an 85.0% likelihood of a 25-basis-point rate hike at the Fed's December meeting, up from 78.3% on Tuesday, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

"While the September dot plot suggests just one more hike, another increase in energy prices or further strong ​data ​prints could bring additional tightening into play next year," said Kay Haigh, head of fixed income and ​liquidity solutions at Goldman Sachs Asset Management in New York.

AI RALLY'S ‌LATEST TEST

Technology giants Alphabet and Microsoft reported earnings after the close. Microsoft shares slightly extended gains after beating quarterly cloud revenue estimates.

Story Continues

Meanwhile, Alphabet's heavy spending drove a bigger-than-expected cash burn, sending shares lower after the bell.

A series of AI-related funding announcements from Meta, SpaceX and Broadcom this week has once again tested the market's willingness to pay for further building, though Anthropic's filing for an initial public offering showed results that many investors regarded as stronger than expected, providing support.

CENTRAL BANKS IN THE SPOTLIGHT

Earlier on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand surprised investors by keeping interest rates at 2.75% in a narrow vote, sending the kiwi down 1%.

"Today's decision shows the RBNZ is willing to surprise markets, ‌a reminder that central banks do not take orders from markets," Carol Kong, a currency strategist ​at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said.

In the UK, finance minister John Healey delivered a cautious first budget, one ​that prioritised stability in the bond market over the kind of big spending ​moves that Andy Burnham talked about when he became prime minister. Britain's stocks, bonds and currency barely reacted to the statement, in which ‌he pledged to stick to fiscal rules, while accepting a smaller ​fiscal cushion due to rising energy prices and ​borrowing costs.

The pound reversed earlier losses and was last up 0.17%.

Election results in Israel showed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc performing more strongly than expected, but still falling short of a parliamentary majority.

In commodities, oil prices rose after an attack on a refinery in Saudi Arabia, the world's biggest crude exporter, renewed ​concerns around the risks to supply in the Middle East. [O/R]

Brent ‌futures added 1% to finish at $115.32 per barrel, while US crude rose 3% to settle at $102.78.

US gold futures for December delivery settled 0.6% lower at $4,051.60 ​per ounce. Spot gold was up 0.27% at $4,070.28 an ounce.

(Additional reporting by Saeed Azhar in New York, Suzanne McGee, and Rae Wee in Singapore; ​Editing by Kate Mayberry, Toby Chopra, Keith Weir, Colin Barr, Nick Zieminski and Aurora Ellis)

Shares of the world's largest semiconductor firm by market capitalization have been on a rather steady upward trajectory over the course of the past decade. However, this past year has provided some volatility that many bulls may not be familiar with.

Much of this volatility isn't Nvidia's fault. Rather, it's the result of an investor rotation away from artificial intelligence (AI)-related tech giants and toward more defensive offerings. Still, Nvidia's recent $1 billion bid to boost AI and quantum computing efforts in the U.S. market may not help NVDA stock much moving forward. Here's why it may be a poor time to consider allocating new capital to one of the world's most valuable companies right now.

What Is Nvidia's $1 Billion Investment About?

Nvidia recently announced plans to invest around $1 billion in leading higher-education research universities "to advance U.S. science over the next five years," while supporting quantum improvements in cloud service providers across the United States. With Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang also receiving one of the highest U.S. medals for science from President Donald Trump on Oct. 8, there's plenty to say about how the broader system works overall.

That said, from a fundamental perspective — and given the amount of money Nvidia has pledged to its future customers — it's becoming clear that many investors are asking for a higher return on investment (and therefore a lower multiple) when considering NVDA stock.

Having once traded at triple-digit price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio, NVDA stock now trades at a forward P/E multiple of around 22.6 times. That's dirt cheap, by most historical measures, and suggests the market thinks that some sort of significant slowing may be on the horizon.

I won't say that's certainly the case, considering the potential impact this $1 billion investment (and previous investments in orders of magnitude higher) could have on Nvidia's bottom line over the long term. However, I do think that investors concerned about runaway spending have plenty to be thinking about right now, particularly as many of the top hyperscalers continue to spend over and above their current cash flow levels.

Story Continues

What Do Wall Street Analysts Think of Nvidia?

This award is certainly one thing for Huang and Nvidia overall. However, I think many Wall Street analysts are now starting to realize that it may not be a complete cake walk for the company that has benefited the most from the AI buildout so far.

Currently, some of the smartest analysts think that NVDA stock should be trading around $329 per share. The average price target of $328.75 suggests potential upside of about 53% from current levels.

That's a significant potential gain, and it's definitely possible. Especially if Nvidia can continue to grow its overall market share in the world of semiconductors simply by producing the fastest and best next-generation semiconductors.

Still, I'd also suggest that spending overhangs from some of Nvidia's key clientele could see them start to pull back on spending. That's what the data suggests, and if that does happen, many of the same scenarios we saw play out a little less than 30 years ago during the dot-com era could be at play once again.

We'll have to wait and see. But I think a price target closer to the Street-low of $180 per share is much more likely than the Street-high target of $515 for NVDA stock.

news.Title: Microsoft earnings live: Microsoft beats Q1 expectations on top and bottom line on AI growth
news.Content: Microsoft ( MSFT ) reported its first quarter earnings after the bell Wednesday, beating Wall Street's expectations on the top and bottom lines. Microsoft stock rose more than 4% on the news. For the quarter, Microsoft saw earnings per share (EPS) of $4.89 on revenue of $92.28 billion. Analysts were projecting EPS of $4.73 on revenue of $90.63 billion, according to Bloomberg consensus estimates. The company saw EPS of $4.13 and revenue of $77.6 billion in the same period last year. Q1 marks the first quarter of Microsoft's new segment structure . The Agents and Infra segment includes the revenue from Microsoft's Azure, Microsoft 365 cloud services, productivity and server licensing, industry solutions, and frontier and support services. The Devices and Consumer segment includes sales tied to Microsoft's search and advertising businesses, Xbox, and Windows OEM and devices. Agents and Infra revenue climbed to $76.8 billion, ahead of expectations of $75.6 billion, with Azure sales climbing 48% to $33.17 billion up from $22.38 billion in the same period last year. Devices and Consumer sales totaled $15.5 billion. Wall Street was looking for $15 billion. Capital expenditures, including leases, topped $39.37 billion, less than the $45.93 billion that analysts were anticipating. LIVE 13 updates 5 mins ago Alphabet outspends Microsoft on AI again Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ) more than doubled their quarterly spending on data centers and equipment from a year ago. Investors are treating the two bills very differently. Alphabet spent about $51 billion in the third quarter, up from $24 billion a year earlier. Microsoft spent about $39 billion, up from $19 billion, not counting leases. Both came in below Wall Street's estimates, per Bloomberg estimates. Microsoft's spending is paying off faster in the market's eyes. Azure revenue grew 48%. Alphabet burned about $9 billion in free cash flow for a second straight quarter and bought back no stock. Watch Amazon ( AMZN ) after Thursday's close. It's the last of the three biggest cloud companies to report this week. 9 mins ago Yahoo Finance Futurum CEO Daniel Newman dives into Microsoft's earnings 9 mins ago Jared Blikre OpenAI now pays Microsoft more than Xbox and Windows Microsoft ( MSFT ) stock is climbing in extended trading after Wednesday night's results, and its quarterly filing shows how much of the business now runs through OpenAI. OpenAI paid Microsoft $10 billion in the quarter that ended in September, including revenue-sharing payments. That's about 11% of Microsoft's $92 billion in revenue, and more than its Xbox and Windows businesses brought in combined. Microsoft also owns about 24% of the ChatGPT maker. OpenAI owed it about $7 billion at the end of the quarter, up from $6 billion three months earlier. Watch whether that reliance starts to weigh on the stock. Microsoft's backlog of signed contracts stalled at about $677 billion, and new bookings fell 12% from a year earlier. 16 mins ago Daniel Howley New segment reporting structure Ahead of Microsoft's earnings call, recall that the company has revamped its quarterly reporting structure, which is now divided into Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer. 21 mins ago Daniel Howley Billions spent on AI chips Microsoft said roughly three-quarters of its $45.2 billion in capital expenditures were for "short-lived assets." That includes things like CPU and GPU chips, as well as networking equipment for data centers. 24 mins ago Daniel Howley Remaining performance obligations rocket higher Microsoft's remaining commercial performance obligations, contracts that the company hasn't been paid for yet, rocketed 73% year over year in Q1 to $677 billion. That's the revenue the company will realize as it scales up AI computing capacity over time. Microsoft says the smaller historical sequential dip is a result of a large Azure commitment in the quarter. 41 mins ago Daniel Howley Microsoft's Windows and devices segment revenue drops Slowing demand for PCs and Xbox game consoles dinged Microsoft's Devices and Consumer segment in Q1. The company says Xbox hardware sales fell some 14%, while Windows OEM and devices revenue fell 22%. Xbox console and PC prices have ballooned due to the ongoing memory and storage shortage. Microsoft, however, also attributes the PC declines to difficult comparisons versus last year, when the company was ending support for Windows 10, forcing enterprise customers to buy new PCs during the period. 57 mins ago Daniel Howley Microsoft's Nadella on Q1 results "We are delivering greater capability, choice, control, and cost efficiency for customers across our entire stack," Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said in a prepared statement. "By helping organizations build and own their own intelligence, and earning trust through agent safety and security, we are translating our innovation into growing adoption and real-world impact across every industry." news.Title: Notes on FOMC Decision and Earnings After the Close
news.Content:
Major stock market indexes finished in the green today, bolstered somewhat by the expected "no move" decided by the Fed at its latest Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, which concluded today. Volatility picked up on the news headline and subsequent press conference with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. The Dow was up +71 points, the Nasdaq +72 and the S&P 500 +21 points. The small-cap Russell 2000 Index gained 6 points on the regular trading session.

Two Dissents as Fed Keeps Rates Unchanged

The FOMC today delivered the expected headline: "No Change to Fed Funds Rate." In a 10-2 vote, the Fed decided to keep interest rates at their +3.75-4.00% range. Only Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented — they voted for a quarter-point raise to +4.00-4.25%. "Resilient," "strong" and "robust" words used to describe the U.S. economy — and in fewer than 200 words altogether.

The statement also cited inflation as being "elevated," although the "accumulation of information will help the Committee determine its policy stance… to the +2% (inflation) goal…" That's about as close to "guidance" investors have gotten from the Fed this time around. In his presser following the statement release, Warsh did say that, while the FOMC will again hold eight meetings next year, only six of these would decide on monetary policy.

Earnings Reports at a Glance: MSFT, GOOGL & More

Microsoft MSFT posted strong fiscal Q1 numbers this afternoon — a day after the company said 60K in the tech giant's workforce are eligible for severance packages. This suggests a new round of job cuts, much like Meta META, Amazon AMZN and others had reported recently. (Spared will be those jobs in Data Center, Cybersecurity, etc.)

Earnings of $4.89 per share rose +19% year over year — higher than the $4.70 per share expected and $4.13 reported in the year-ago quarter. Revenues came in at $92.3 billion, above the $90.58 billion anticipated at +21% year over year. Shares are up +4% in late trading.

Google parent Alphabet GOOGL missed estimates on both top and bottom lines in its Q3 report after Wednesday's close, with earnings of $2.12 per share on revenues of $111.2 billion (ex-TAC; $127.6 billion with TAC not taken out). Cloud gained +103% year over year to $30.7 billion in the quarter. Services were led by Search, up another +12%, with query growth its highest in five years. This is only the second earnings miss for GOOGL in five years, and shares fell -7.5% immediately after.

Speaking of earnings misses, ServiceNow NOW posted its first-ever earnings miss since Zacks began tracking the company in 2014: $1.00 per share versus expectations of $1.02. Revenues, on the other hand, outpaced estimates — $4.107 billion in the quarter, up from an expected $4.09 billion. Even with a new OpenAI deal announced today, ServiceNow shares plummeted -16% on the earnings news.

Ford Motor Co. F rolled over expectations on both top and bottom lines this afternoon, with earnings beating the Zacks consensus by a solid dime to $0.49 per share on $49.5 billion in quarterly sales. In truth, these were pretty low bars to get over — both earnings and sales were expected to trail last year's quarter. A harsh $4 billion loss on Ford's Model e, however, dampened the proceedings, and shares are down -1.9% in late trading.

news.Title: Meta Just Priced a Stock Sale at $625 a Share. I'd Consider Buying at the Same Price.
news.Content:
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) just asked investors for lots of money. The social media giant priced 40 million Class A shares at $625 apiece on Oct. 26, a $25 billion sale. It also priced 250 million depositary shares of mandatory convertible preferred stock at $50 each, worth another $12.5 billion.

All told, Meta is raising about $37.5 billion in new equity, after spending $26.2 billion buying back its own stock in 2025. And the stock trades near $625 as I write this, over 20% below its all-time closing high of $790, set in August 2025.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

But is the cost of all the new shares worth what the money buys? I think the cost is lower than the $37.5 billion number makes it look.

Image source: Getty Images.

A raise in two parts

Meta won't get the common stock money right away. Under forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs, it issues the new shares and collects the roughly $24.9 billion in net proceeds once the agreements settle, which Meta expects by Nov. 19, 2027.

The preferred stock pays a 6.5% annual dividend, or around $813 million a year. In August 2029, each depositary share converts into 0.0681 to 0.0800 Meta shares, based on the stock's price then, before adjustment for a planned Class C stock dividend.

Meta plans to use the cash for general corporate purposes. But its Oct. 21 earnings release said the investment needed "to compete, sustain growth, expand infrastructure, and pursue new strategic initiatives" during the industry's move to artificial intelligence (AI) "is significant."

What does it cost shareholders?

Meta had around 2.56 billion Class A and Class B shares on Sept. 30. The 40 million new common shares, plus the 17 million to 20 million shares the preferred stock could convert into, would add around 2.2% to 2.3% to that count.

That's on top of a slower climb. Without buybacks since the third quarter of 2025, Meta's average number of shares outstanding has grown in four straight quarters, by 8 million to 9 million shares every time. It hit 2,552 million in the third quarter of 2026, up around 1.4% year over year.

Around 2.3% more shares means each share's piece of future profits shrinks by a little over 2%. At around $625, the stock trades at about 18 times expected 2027 earnings. With those profits spread across the higher share count, the price-to-earnings ratio would still be under 19 times earnings -- even if the new money never added a dollar of profit.

Story Continues

Spending has outrun the cash

In the third quarter, Meta spent around $2.1 billion more on capital expenditures (including principal payments on finance leases) than its operations took in. A year before, operations covered the spending with around $10.6 billion left over. And management expects 2026 capital expenditures of $135 billion to $145 billion.

Meta has also borrowed heavily, raising about $29.9 billion of long-term debt in the fourth quarter of 2025 and $24.9 billion more in the second quarter of 2026. By Sept. 30, long-term debt had hit $80.9 billion, almost matching Meta's $82.5 billion of cash and marketable securities.

I'd say selling stock makes more sense for Meta today than adding more debt.

And the spending seems to be paying off in the core business. Advertising revenue climbed 26% year over year to $63.1 billion in the third quarter. The same release said its AI investments "are already delivering substantial incremental advertising revenue."

This might not be the last raise. Meta also plans an at-the-market program to sell around $60 billion more stock after its new Class C shares start trading, but it hasn't set the timing. At today's price, that would be close to another 4% of the company.

Big buyers paid close to today's price

Meta priced the common stock less than 1% under the $630.56 last sale price on Oct. 26, after increasing the sale from the $22.5 billion it first announced. Nvidia said it would invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering.

The preferred buyers gave up some upside. In return for the 6.5% dividend, they take the stock's losses under $625. But they don't share in any gains until Meta passes about $734, about 17.5% over the offering price. These terms suggest they see today's price as a sensible spot to own Meta.

Is Meta stock a buy near $625? I think so. True, giving up a little over 2% of the company costs existing holders something, and the planned $60 billion program might take more. But the cash comes to more than Meta spent on capital expenditures in the third quarter, while its ad sales are still rising more than 20%.

I'd consider buying shares at about the same price Meta's new investors just paid.

news.Title: Oracle has a spending question its new chip deals can’t answer
news.Content: If you asked ChatGPT a question this week, the reply probably landed in seconds. Behind it sat racks of chips, cooling systems, and power lines someone paid for long before you typed. Oracle Corporation (ORCL) is one of the companies that pays first and collects later. On Oct. 27, Oracle lined up more chips for that business. Its cloud will offer processors from Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google, Nvidia Corporation (NVDA), Intel Corporation (INTC), and Cerebras Systems (CBRS). It also pulled OpenAI deeper into its business software. Yet none of these deals answers the question investors bring to Oracle's Investor Day on Oct. 28: how Oracle pays for everything it has promised to build. Also read: Oracle CEO admits its software can take years to get running Evercore ISI estimates that Oracle needs $50 billion to $60 billion in additional funding, according to Seeking Alpha . The firm sees that need lasting until free cash flow turns positive in fiscal 2029. Oracle's building plans are running ahead of the cash its business brings in. The new chips come with new bills The Google deal shows the tradeoff. Oracle said its cloud will be the first large provider outside Google to offer Google's custom chips, called TPUs, starting in 2027. The same press release says Oracle will supply the power, cooling, and data center networking to run them. The release does not say who pays for the chips themselves. Either way, Oracle must house and power several kinds of hardware. Oracle also plans clusters measured in gigawatts on Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems, plus a multiyear Intel Xeon deal, according to Seeking Alpha . Nvidia's Ian Buck said the aim is to help customers "put more of their infrastructure to work today and sustain its value as AI evolves." Meanwhile, CNBC reported that Oracle's cloud will also host OpenAI's Jalapeño chip. Mahesh Thiagarajan, president of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, told the network that chips remain scarce and customers like OpenAI benefit from having options. I read that as Oracle protecting its supply, which is sensible. Yet Thiagarajan also called Nvidia's chips "the best, most fungible," meaning the easiest to shift between models and workloads. Hardware must stay useful long enough to pay for itself. By his own measure, the other accelerators joining Oracle's cloud are less flexible bets. The market already values the AI cloud below zero Those bets come while investors already doubt Oracle's AI cloud. Evercore valued Oracle's software and non-AI cloud businesses at about $197 per share after accounting for debt. By Evercore's math, the market assigns Oracle's AI cloud a negative value. Story Continues If investors see the AI cloud as a drag, more of it cannot fix that. Evercore said investors need "a clearer picture of the remaining funding needs." Oracle has already leaned on equity investors. The company sold $20 billion of common stock during its fiscal first quarter, according to its earnings release . New shares spread future profits across more owners. Oracle has forecast $90 billion to $95 billion in capital spending for fiscal 2027, according to Seeking Alpha. The spending plan roughly equals the $90 billion or more in revenue Oracle expects this fiscal year, according to its earnings release. In other words, Oracle plans to spend about as much on building as it collects. Oracle says it is structuring new deals to ease that strain. Its earnings release said more than $30 billion in AI contracts booked last quarter added nothing to its capital-raising plans. That covers new contracts, not those already driving the bill. OpenAI moves into Oracle's safer business The OpenAI announcement matters most to me because it reaches the businesses Evercore says carry Oracle's value. OpenAI said Oracle's applications and data are coming into ChatGPT, and OpenAI models will power new Oracle products. Oracle's own recruiting team now prepares some market research in 15 to 20 minutes instead of two to four days, OpenAI said. Results like that become Oracle's sales pitch. Thiagarajan told CNBC that using ChatGPT "allows anybody to build an application, deploy it, manage it." Software sales do not need a new data center for each customer, making this the cheapest growth Oracle announced on Oct. 27. However, the catch is concentration. OpenAI is now Oracle's compute customer, the designer of a chip headed to its cloud, a partner in its apps, and a vendor to its staff. Evercore said investors want clarity on Oracle's contracted backlog excluding OpenAI, a sign the market treats that link as a risk. Reports in April that OpenAI fell short of several sales targets showed how quickly that link can turn. Tying Oracle's steadier software business to the same partner raises the cost of any OpenAI stumble. More Oracle: CoreWeave, Oracle have an interest rate problem Oracle boss Larry Ellison just suffered a historic wealth collapse Oracle's 'force majeure' warning lands as AI power gets scarce Investors want a funding plan, not more chips The recent deals also hint at who will carry the AI buildout's cost. Google placing its chips in a rival hyperscaler's cloud for the first time suggests chip designers want reach without building every data center. Someone still owns the power, the cooling, and the debt. Oracle has volunteered for that role. It works if customers keep paying and help fund the build. Evercore listed customer funding, alternative financing, and possible data center delays as details investors will watch. The Oct. 28 test is simple. Oracle needs to put its own number on the funding gap and show who fills it. The next phase of the AI boom may reward companies that finance data centers more than those that fill them with the most chips. news.Title: Applied Digital Insiders Just Bought More Shares. Should You Join Them?
news.Content:
Applied Digital (NASDAQ: APLD) insiders have been buying the dip as the artificial intelligence (AI) stock continues to slide. The company's CEO and president bought a combined $6.7 million worth of shares on Oct. 16. Despite the insider buying, Applied Digital is down by more than 30% over the past month.

No doubt, sentiment around AI stocks has soured lately, but that doesn't mean fundamentals have weakened. These are some details to consider when deciding whether Applied Digital is a buy.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Applied Digital is realizing AI revenue

Applied Digital makes money by building AI data centers . The company creates the facilities, and then it's up to customers to bring their own hardware. CoreWeave is one of Applied Digital's largest customers with 15-year leases valued at up to $11 billion in revenue over that stretch.

The total deal covers 400 megawatts, putting the value of each megawatt at $1.83 million per year. While some AI data center companies are multiple years away from building facilities and generating revenue, Applied Digital is already seeing big gains on its balance sheet. Revenue surged by 322% year over year to reach $341.9 million in its fiscal 2027's first quarter.

Costs have also been surging, leaving the company still unprofitable, though that's common in the AI data center industry. Even Nebius remains deeply unprofitable despite high revenue growth. This is normal because it costs a lot of money to build data centers. As Applied Digital completes more of its facilities and attracts more customers, revenue will start to outpace costs.

AI demand isn't going anywhere

Every quarter seems to feature a news cycle of waning demand for AI and concerns about a popping bubble. However, the tech executives who know the most about the industry regularly speak about substantial growth and demand, and their fundamentals back up their talk.

Elon Musk told investors when discussing Space Exploration Technologies ' quarterly results that the company is "hounded" by hyperscalers and dozens of smaller companies that are seeking compute. Demand is still accelerating, prompting higher contract values.

It's a good environment for Applied Digital as it brings more of its facilities online. Not only will it start to realize more revenue from its backlog, but Applied Digital is also gaining the flexibility to charge higher prices to future customers.

Story Continues

Musk told investors to expect $100 billion in annual recurring revenue by December. Applied Digital benefits from the same tailwinds as SpaceX's AI business. That should eventually show up in the stock price even though doom and gloom has been the common narrative in recent weeks.

Applied Digital's Achilles' heel

Although Applied Digital is in the right industry and is building high-demand infrastructure that can command lofty contract values, there are some problems. The two big flaws are that Applied Digital uses a colocation model and locks in long-term contracts. Colocation involves building a facility and letting the hyperscaler bring their own chips and other resources. It's a less capital-intensive effort, which lets Applied Digital build more data centers with less overhead.

However, there's a big catch. Remember the $1.83 million annual megawatt value Applied Digital secured with CoreWeave? That's not much when compared to Nebius landing $40 million to $50 million per megawatt each year on short-term deals.

Nebius puts more capital into its data centers and also operates a cloud platform. Neoclouds are more complex to set up than colocation facilities. However, the revenue ceiling is much higher. Nebius was only receiving annual contract values of $12 million per megawatt. The value of a megawatt has more than quadrupled in less than one year for short-term deals, and that type of momentum suggests more lucrative deals in the future.

Applied Digital hasn't put itself in a good position to capitalize on rising megawatt prices since it isn't a neocloud and it signs 15-year leases with its tenants. Meanwhile, capital expenditures can climb at these sites where Applied Digital has locked in relatively low annual contract values per megawatt. Applied Digital is in the right industry and looks oversold at current levels, but pure neoclouds are a better way to approach the opportunity.

news.Title: AAOI's CATV Business Gains Momentum: Can It Beat LITE and COHR?
news.Content:
Applied Optoelectronics AAOI is benefiting from robust demand for its cable television (CATV) products, driven by accelerating network upgrades and increasing adoption of DOCSIS 4.0 technology. Strong shipments of next-generation amplifiers, expanding customer relationships, and growing demand for software solutions are strengthening the company's growth prospects and competitive positioning against Lumentum LITE and Coherent COHR in the optical networking market.

In the second quarter of 2026, CATV revenues surged 43.8% year over year and 20.6% sequentially to a record $80.6 million, which accounted for approximately 42% of total revenues. Results benefited from significant shipments of 1.8 GHz amplifiers to its largest CATV customer and growing engagement with newer multiple-system operator customers.

AAOI's selection by Mediacom as its primary vendor for DOCSIS 4.0 network upgrades represents another significant growth opportunity. The deployment of QuantumLink software and next-generation 1.8 GHz Quantum bandwidth smart amplifiers is expected to improve network reliability while reducing operational costs.

Further expanding its portfolio, in September, AAOI announced plans to showcase its first live Quantum30 3.0 GHz proof-of-concept demonstration at SCTE TechExpo in Atlanta. The demo will feature live downstream operation at 3.0 GHz over a coaxial network using a concept amplifier, SC-QAMs, OFDM channels and a 3.0 GHz DOCSIS signal generator. Building on its Quantum18 platform, AAOI aims to help cable operators evaluate network requirements beyond DOCSIS 4.0's 1.8 GHz capacity. The company also released a white paper examining engineering, operational, and economic considerations associated with expanding hybrid fiber-coaxial networks toward 3.0 GHz.

AAOI's expanding CATV portfolio, growing customer adoption and continued investments in next-generation broadband technologies are expected to sustain growth momentum and strengthen its competitive position against Lumentum and Coherent. The company expects third-quarter 2026 CATV revenues between $100 million and $110 million, reflecting strong sequential growth. It also anticipates annual CATV revenues exceeding $325 million, supported primarily by amplifier shipments and initial software contributions.

How Competitors Fare Against AAOI

Applied Optoelectronics is facing stiff competition from Lumentum and Coherent in the AI space.

Lumentum is benefiting from strong demand for its optical components and systems, driven by the industry shift to AI workloads and increased data center connectivity. Key growth drivers include record shipments of 800G and next-generation 1.6T cloud transceivers, strong momentum in pump and EML laser sales and successful ramp-up of new technologies like near-packaged optics and co-packaged optics.

Coherent is benefiting from the strong demand in AI data center and communications markets, leading to record revenues and accelerated growth. Key drivers included strong customer bookings, expansion of production capacity, especially in 6-inch indium phosphide output and the ramp-up of new products like advanced transceivers and optical circuit switching systems.

news.Content: 中經院看好AI需求將帶動出口、投資及消費的正向循環，再度上調2026全年經濟成長率至10.35%；受惠全球AI浪潮及科技產業升級趨勢，帶動長線資金進駐台股基金，據投信投顧公會統計今年以來至9月底，台股共同基金整體規模翻倍成長，規模最大的配息型台股共同基金「元大台灣高股息優質龍頭基金」更突破千億大關，凸顯長期投資熱度。 據投信投顧公會資料，今年以來至9月底台股共同基金規模成長125.7%，138檔中有3檔規模已逾千億，元大台灣高股息優質龍頭基金規模達1,046.9億，今年以來報酬率146%為同類型第一，大型共同基金透過主動選股，依然能追求超額報酬。 元大投信旗下共9檔台股主動共同基金，今年以來至9月整體基金規模成長143%，每月申購金額、定期定額扣款金額則分別成長138.4%、46.5%；據Lipper統計，今年以來平均績效達120.5%。 元大台灣高股息優質龍頭基金為台灣首檔結合月配息、年終配息及收益平準金的台股基金，提供投資人兼顧現金流需求、長期資本增值機會。 產業方面，台積電於第二季法說會上修全年資本支出至600億至640億美元，聚焦先進製程、封裝與海外擴產，定調AI成長前景，產業生態系持續成長有利主動選股表現空間。台股主動共同基金為積極掌握市場趨勢，由基金經理團隊依專業判斷彈性選股，以追求報酬表現，可能出現類股相對集中之配置，波動度可能較大盤為高，投資前應留意。

news.Title: Why Arm’s Q2 Earnings Could Spur a Recovery in Its Stock
news.Content:
Arm Holdings (ARM) will release its fiscal 2027 second-quarter earnings on Nov. 4. While profit booking following a significant rally has led to a correction in its stock price, its solid Q2 performance and strong Arm AGI CPU demand could spur a recovery.

Arm continues to see strong customer demand across its business, which indicates solid growth ahead. Moreover, it has signed multiple high-value agreements that will support long-term growth.

Arm's Q2 Outlook

Arm entered fiscal 2027 on a strong footing, led by solid momentum across its business. Strong demand for ARM-based computing architectures across cloud infrastructure, consumer electronics, automotive systems, and emerging AI applications positions it well to deliver solid growth in Q2 and beyond.

Arm reported first-quarter revenue of $1.29 billion, up 22% year-over-year (YoY). The top line benefited from solid performance in the royalty business. Its royalty revenue increased 22% YoY to $715 million, with cloud AI and data center infrastructure emerging as the primary growth engines. Data center royalty revenue more than doubled from the previous year, supported by the expanding adoption of ARM-based server processors among major hyperscalers.

In addition, the growing deployment of data processing units (DPUs) and SmartNICs is providing another growth source, as Arm technology is incorporated into a broad range of leading data center networking products.

In the consumer segment, Edge AI royalties continued to expand despite weakness in the smartphone market. Higher royalty rates, driven by growing adoption of Armv9 architectures and compute subsystems, helped offset softer smartphone sales and the pressure from elevated memory prices. Physical AI also contributed positively, with continued adoption of ARM-based technologies in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous applications supporting demand across the automotive ecosystem.

Licensing revenue is another key growth driver. License and other revenue reached $574 million, up 23% YoY, reflecting strong customer demand for next-generation architectures and deeper strategic relationships with major technology companies. Arm also secured multiple high-value agreements as existing customers renewed long-term licenses. These arrangements, involving hyperscalers, automotive and robotics companies, and handset manufacturers, strengthen Arm's competitive position.

Story Continues

Demand for Arm's AGI CPU offering is also gaining traction, with reported demand exceeding $2 billion. The addition of customers across the U.S. and China, alongside an expanding overall pipeline, points to strong growth ahead.

Looking ahead, management expects the growth trajectory to remain strong in the second quarter of fiscal 2027. Arm forecasts revenue of $1.38 billion, representing approximately 22% YoY growth. Licensing and other revenue are projected to rise about 30%, while royalty revenue is expected to grow at a low-teens rate.

The earnings outlook is also solid, with management projecting adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $0.47 for Q2, up 21% YoY.

Why ARM Stock Appears Compelling Ahead of Q2

Arm's upcoming Q2 earnings could be a key catalyst for a stock-price recovery, supported by strong customer demand, expanding data center adoption, and growing traction for its AGI CPU offering.

Arm is expected to deliver solid revenue and earnings growth, driven by strength in royalty revenue. Higher licensing revenue and long-term agreements with major technology companies also highlight its solid growth prospects. Moreover, rising adoption of ARM-based architectures across AI infrastructure, automotive systems, and consumer electronics provides multiple avenues for sustained growth.

Although ARM stock still trades at a high valuation, the 49% decline from its 52-week high has eased some of these concerns ahead of the earnings announcement.

Analysts currently have a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating on ARM stock and a mean price target of $292.72.

news.Title: Microsoft names the hackers who slipped in through a backup app
news.Content: Every business owner keeps a mental list of the keys that matter. The bank login, the payroll account, the alarm code for the front door. What rarely makes that list are the apps your IT provider plugged into your company email years ago. They don't log in like a person or get a text code. They just run in the background. Most small companies outsource IT to managed service providers, or MSPs, which wire backup and security tools straight into each client's Microsoft 365 account. Each tool holds standing permission to read and write your data with no person signing ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Microsoft identified Storm-0940, a China-state-aligned group, as the culprit behind a breach exploiting a backup app's credentials.
• The attackers used an AI-driven hacking tool called ARTEX to target over 2,250 Microsoft accounts, achieving privileged access rapidly in some cases.
• The breach leveraged stolen credentials from ConnectWise Cloud Backup, allowing attackers access to emails, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams chats.
• Business email compromise, facilitated by such breaches, cost U.S. victims over $3 billion in 2025, highlighting the financial impact of compromised accounts.

news.Title: 台股狂飆939點來真的？美伊和談重燃行情　郭哲榮點名這些低基期補漲股
news.Content:
台股今（28）日多頭氣勢強勁，終場加權指數狂飆 939.35 點，收在 47,035.58 點，成交量為 7,221.35 億元，期貨盤中更一度猛拉超過千點。面對這波驚天動地的漲勢， 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮（哲哲） 指出，台股爆發強勁反彈背後的核心推手，源於地緣政治迎來歷史性轉折，隨著美伊衝突與俄烏戰爭傳出和談曙光，觀望資金迅速回流，同時也為低基期補漲股開啟了絕佳的接棒舞台。

【美伊和談迎曙光！地緣政治解凍全球AI資金鏈】

中東與俄烏衝突長期推升油價與通膨，迫使聯準會維持高利率，高借貸成本也讓高度依賴資金灌溉的 AI 企業承受嚴峻考驗。郭哲榮分析，隨著伊朗最高領袖釋出談判訊號，雙方具備以戰逼和的交集。若和平協議達成，油價與通膨降溫將帶動企業資金成本大幅下降，被壓抑的 AI 科技股可望迎來資金回流派對，甚至為大盤帶來再向上推升一千至兩千點的龐大動能。

【AI裁員浪潮袭來！買進AI股票當職場失業保險】

除了宏觀資金面，AI 技術進步對就業市場的衝擊同樣值得關注。全球科技巨頭微軟規劃精簡高達 6 萬名員工，顯示企業導入 AI 提升效率、削減傳統人力的不可逆趨勢。面對被科技淘汰的風險，郭哲榮提出獨到觀點：與其消極擔心失業，不如主動布局 ASIC 晶片、自動駕駛與機器人等 AI 產業鏈，將投資 AI 股票視為個人的「失業保險」，讓科技紅利轉化為資本利得，對沖職場風險。

【低基期與黑馬股接棒！華新科、精材台股後市解析】

在個股與族群配置上，郭哲榮點名 強勢股 與 低基期補漲股 並進的關鍵標的：

1. 華新科（2492） ： 在 369 元附近低檔布局後，單日大漲近 7%，波段獲利已達 44%，展現被動元件低基期的強勁爆發力。

2. 精材（3374） ：受惠於強勢技術線型，股價由 180 至 190 元低位一路飆升至 500 元，波段漲幅高達 159%。不過因已遠離成本區， 特別叮嚀投資人切勿盲目追高。

3. 智原（3035） ：智原具備 ASIC 客製化晶片題材且基期較低，反彈動能備受期待。

4. 記憶體族群 ：AI伺服器對高效能記憶體的需求持續受到市場關注，SK 海力士優異財報帶動韓國股市打底完成，記憶體長線缺貨與需求趨勢依舊確立，低檔拉回仍是布局時機。

news.Content:
美股周三(28日)開盤走高，標普500指數與那斯達克指數雙雙上揚。SK海力士(SKHY-US)亮眼財報提振記憶體與半導體類股，帶動科技股持續領先大盤，那斯達克100指數延續前兩個交易日漲勢。

美股期指周三小幅走高，投資人等待科技巨頭財報與聯準會(Fed)利率決策。標普500期指上漲0.2%，那斯達克100指數可望連續第三個交易日收高，SK海力士(SKHY-US)亮眼財報帶動AI相關類股走強。

市場對AI支出終將帶來回報的信心回升，資金重新流向科技股，焦點轉向盤後公布財報的微軟(MSFT-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)。Fed則普遍預期將維持利率不變，決策前美債殖利率小幅攀升，美元大致持平。

Vanda Research的Jai Malhi表示，科技股部位清洗已有結束跡象，有助近期反彈。SK海力士財報是好兆頭，但大型雲端業者的資本支出展望仍是關鍵風險，可能讓部分投資人暫時觀望。

Fed上月才一致通過升息，以因應升溫的通膨壓力，若本次按兵不動，主席華許可能須說明政策官員暫不行動的理由。

news.Title: 美股季節性「黃金半年」將啟動 投資人該準備進場了嗎？
news.Content:
美股歷史上最受矚目的「萬聖節指標」(Halloween indicator)，或稱「最佳六個月」效應將於11月正式啟動。這項策略主張投資人於10月底買進股票並持有至次年4月，隨後在夏季5月至10月淡出股市。

此規律最早由Yale Hirsch於1986年發現，其子、《股票交易員年鑑》(Stock Trader's Almanac)總編輯Jeffrey Hirsch於2026年版中引述並指出：「你可以將一年畫分為兩個階段，幾乎所有的漲幅都集中在其中半年的時間，而另外半年則所剩無幾。」

歷史統計顯示，自1950年至1987年間，道瓊工業指數在11月至4月的平均漲幅約為7%，而5月至10月僅有不到1%。若自1950年起，每年僅將1萬美元投入於淡季半年，資產將萎縮至約4,300美元；反之，若僅投資於旺季半年，1萬美元則大幅成長至約130萬美元。

即使在規律發表後的39年間(1986年之後)，黃金半年的1萬美元投資，也已累積至約120萬美元，相較於淡季半年的5,800美元，展現出極為顯著的報酬差異。

然而，近年來傳統「5月賣股離場」策略正面臨環境轉變。自1988年以來，夏季半年的平均漲幅已提升至約3%。在過去十年間，淡季與旺季半年的平均報酬率甚至平分秋色，均達到約7%，其中5月至10月更有5個年份表現超越旺季，包含2025年夏季高達約23%的漲幅。

對此，Jeffrey Hirsch分析表示：「搶先布局者、文化行為的改變以及更快速的資訊流，近年來已改變了季節性效應。」 此外，指數型基金與401(k)退休金計畫的定期定額資金持續流入，也成為支撐夏季股市的重要推手。

儘管季節性效應出現質變，但在美國國會期中選舉年份，「黃金六個月」的優勢依然極為亮眼。數據顯示，自1950年以來，期中選舉年隨後的11月至4月期間已連續19次上揚，平均漲幅高達約15%。

據《Yahoo財經》報導指出，雖然夏季未必完全風險重重，但歷史上包含2001年大跌約15%、2002年跌幅約18%及2008年重挫約30%等極端行情，均發生於夏季，因此對現代投資人而言，更明智的作法或許是在5月進行「避險」而非完全「離場」。

news.Title: Want Income for Life? This Dividend Stock Has Funded Investment Portfolios With Growing Passive Income for 57 Straight Years.
news.Content:
Growth investors typically buy stocks based not on what a business is today, but on what it could become in the future. For dividend investors, it's frequently the opposite idea. Take, for example, the investment thesis for Altria Group (NYSE: MO), the giant tobacco company behind Marlboro.

Although cigarette smoking is a slowly dying trend in the United States, and has been for decades, investors have continued to buy Altria stock for its steadily growing dividend. The company is a Dividend King , with a streak of 57 consecutive annual payout hikes. (To earn the title of Dividend King, a company must boost its payouts for at least 50 straight years -- a rare accomplishment.)

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That history, combined with the business's financial staying power, gives shareholders the confidence that those dividends will continue rolling in.

How Altria makes and pays shareholders more each year

Altria only sells cigarettes in the United States, and smoking rates domestically have been in decline for decades. (It split off its international business as Phillip Morris International back in 2008.) Marlboro is the nation's top cigarette brand by a wide margin, so it will come as little surprise that Altria has been selling fewer and fewer cigarettes every year for quite some time. But cigarettes are infamously addictive and smokers demonstrate remarkable brand loyalty -- a combination of factors that has given Altria strong pricing power. It has used that to regularly boost its prices per pack, offsetting its shrinking sales volumes with higher cigarette prices.

From there, the formula is pretty simple. Altria distributes about 80% of its cash flow via dividends and uses most of the rest to buy back its stock. With fewer shares to pay dividends to, Altria has been able to raise its dividend year in and year out while keeping its payout ratio in check.

MO Cash Dividend Payout Ratio data by YCharts.

In fact, Altria's free cash flow per share is up by a whopping 194.8% over the past decade alone. But even if something were to happen to Altria's business, its strong balance sheet could still support the dividend.

Among other assets, Altria owns roughly 150 million shares of Anheuser-Busch InBev , worth approximately $12.6 billion at today's prices. That's a nice stack of financial chips that management can cash in on whenever it feels the need to.

Story Continues

Eventually, change will probably come

Altria has been following the same playbook of raising cigarette prices to great success for decades now, so there's no glaring reason to fear for its dividend -- at least, not while the company has billions of dollars in cash and equity backing the payout ratio. Who knows? Depending on your age, an investment in Altria could provide you with a growing income stream for the rest of your life.

But the further out you look, the more the risks to the business model and the dividend increase. There could come a point where Altria struggles to offset the impact of its declining sales volumes with price hikes imposed on the smokers who remain. There could come a point when a critical mass of smokers are left struggling to afford the habit, and sales volume losses accelerate.

Either way, Altria may need to diversify its business more than it has. It hasn't been for lack of trying. Altria has some high-profile failures on its record; just look up the Juul debacle. The company is building some solid sales momentum with smoke-free products such as its On! nicotine salt pouches. But smokeable products still carry most of the business.

Investors should keep an eye on the company's long-term progress with brands other than Marlboro cigarettes. In the meantime, you can buy Altria stock for its 6% dividend and feel reasonably sure that the income stream it provides is secure.

news.Title: 〈房產〉AI紅利勁道強 國城建設洪平森：房市最壞市況將過 還有新投資規劃中
news.Content:
南台灣品牌建商國城建設插旗台南東區平實特區的大型公辦都更案「國城寳實」，一、二期總戶數834戶，已售出670戶，銷售率逾80%，其中來自科技產業的客戶達35-40%的占比，國城建設創辦人洪平森今(28)日指出，在AI紅利帶動下，房市最壞市況將過去，也預期2027年首季的房市交易市況轉優。

同時，南台灣半導體S廊帶在台積電(2330-TW)帶動之下，洪平森指出，國城建設除在南台灣從事建築開發事業之外，因科技、傳統產業帶動商務開發需求，公司同步看好現代化商用辦公室的需求應運而生，也在準備開發商用不動產因應軟體科技園區周邊的需求。

目前，包括如興富發(2542-TW)也看好高雄亞灣區商用空間的需求快速成長以及科技產業週邊供應鏈的商用需求，並規劃在亞灣區積極開發微型商辦提供企業運用。

國城建設目前手中擁有台南、高雄、嘉義大型都更開發案，仍堅守在南台灣打拚的規劃，對於台積電聯合帆宣(6196-TW)、華懋科技(5292-TW)、捨得企業、安葆國際(7792-TW)、兆聯實業(6944-TW)、和淞科技(6826-TW)以及矽科宏晟(6725-TW)等七家供應鏈廠商，進駐屏東科學園區，記憶體大廠南亞科(2408-TW)在屏東也有大手筆的投資，洪平森指出，國城建設持續觀察科技產業所帶動對屏東住宅的需求，尤其是以屏東市為重點。

洪平森指出，在AI紅利帶動下，至少有5至10年的榮景不致壞，而目前台灣房市最壞的市況將過去，並預期2027年首季的房市交易市況轉優。

洪平森今天隨著「寳實二代」公開，國城建設同步宣布台南店面「三年免租金」計畫，並借鏡日本都市更新重視街區規劃與長期經營的思維，減輕特色店家創業初期的租金負擔，吸引經營者投入產品、服務與空間之後，對於國城建設的的走向接受訪問並提出對台灣房市走勢的看法。

台南東區平實重劃區近年成為建商推案一級戰區，國城建設、豐邑機構陸續進場，達麗(6177-TW)、國建(2501-TW)也插旗布局，區域狂吸台南過半買氣，其中國城建設在平實重劃區的建案，除去年7月推出第一期、今年7月推出第二期，合計834戶，已售出670戶，銷售率逾80%之外，還有第三期待推出。

The introduction of its 7060XE7 Series has extended Arista's offerings into next-generation 1.6-terabit networking. These platforms are designed to support increasingly demanding AI workloads through high-bandwidth connectivity and advanced cooling options. Continued adoption of Ethernet-based AI infrastructure and expansion across scale-up, scale-out and scale-across deployments could support revenue growth in the September quarter.

During the quarter, Arista introduced AI-Driven Zero Trust Branch, integrating AI-powered security, identity-based access, and cloud-managed networking into a unified platform. The solution enhances branch protection, simplifies policy enforcement, improves operational efficiency, and enables secure, scalable connectivity for distributed enterprises and hybrid work environments. Such innovative product launches are expected to have a favorable impact on third-quarter results.

Arista's broader networking portfolio may provide additional support. Its software-driven Extensible Operating System, CloudVision platform and enterprise campus networking offerings help address requirements beyond hyperscale data centers. From a valuation standpoint, Arista appears to be trading at a premium compared with the industry and above its mean. Going by the price/earnings ratio, the company's shares currently trade at 37.83 forward earnings, higher than 28.67 for the industry and lower than the stock's mean of 45.

Arista's growth outlook remains supported by expanding AI infrastructure investment, demand for high-speed Ethernet networking and continued product innovation. Supply chain execution is another important aspect. Management reported progress in supplier diversification, component availability and manufacturing capacity, but industry-wide component tightness and higher procurement costs persist. Arista's multiyear purchase commitments reached approximately $9.7 billion by the end of the second quarter, reflecting efforts to secure components and meet expected demand.

Based on our proprietary calculation, trailing 12-month return on invested capital (ROIC) is 27.1%, above Arista's 10-year median of 23.9% and the 12.6% industry median; the 3-year median of 27.1% also shows that returns have remained elevated recently. ROIC helps investors assess whether growth is being generated with productive use of committed capital. Arista's software-driven architecture, strong operating profitability and asset-light outsourced manufacturing model support attractive capital efficiency.

End Note

Arista enters the third quarter of 2026 with strong AI networking momentum and a growing product portfolio. A strong focus on innovation, broader enterprise adoption and supply chain improvements are major tailwinds. Upward estimate revision reflects growing investors' confidence in the stock's growth potential. With a Zacks Rank #2 and strong price performance, Arista appears to be a good investment option at present.

news.Title: Premarket movers: Vertiv, SK Hynix jump; Enphase, NXP slide
news.Content:
Investing.com - Nasdaq futures advanced on Wednesday after stronger-than-expected results from South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix sparked a global rally in artificial intelligence-linked semiconductor stocks. Investors were also looking ahead to earnings from major technology companies and a Federal Reserve interest rate decision.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

By 06:06 ET (10:06 GMT), Nasdaq 100 futures had gained 132 points, or 0.4%, while S&P 500 futures had risen 10 points, or 0.1%. Dow futures, meanwhile, had dropped 105 points, or 0.2%.

Here are some of the biggest premarket U.S. stock movers today:

SK Hynix shares surged 7.4% in premarket trading to $156.15 after the memory chipmaker reported record third-quarter 2026 results, with revenue exceeding KRW 100 trillion for the first time in a single quarter. Revenue reached KRW 104.62 trillion, while operating profit jumped 632% year-over-year to KRW 83.33 trillion, representing an operating margin of 80% and beating analyst expectations. The company also announced plans to return approximately KRW 100 trillion to shareholders through fiscal 2026, including at least KRW 30 trillion in cash dividends and at least KRW 60 trillion in share repurchases and cancellations, marking its largest shareholder-return commitment to date.

Vertiv Holdings surged 15.1% before the bell after the data-center power and cooling equipment provider reported third-quarter results that comfortably beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year outlook. Adjusted earnings came in at $2.21 per share, above the $1.82 consensus, while revenue jumped 61% year-over-year to $4.31 billion, topping forecasts of $3.75 billion. Organic orders more than doubled from a year earlier, easing concerns that delays in AI-related projects were holding back revenue growth. Vertiv raised its 2026 adjusted earnings forecast to $7.15 per share, compared with the previous consensus of $6.73, and projected revenue of $14.65 billion, above expectations of $13.99 billion. Its fourth-quarter outlook also exceeded analyst estimates.

Ultra Clean Holdings climbed 12% in premarket trading after the semiconductor equipment supplier reported record third-quarter results and issued an upbeat forecast for the current quarter. Adjusted earnings reached $1.15 per share, beating the $0.94 analyst consensus, while revenue rose nearly 49% year-over-year to a record $759 million, above estimates of $728.07 million. Profitability also improved, with non-GAAP gross margin expanding to 17.3% from 15.7% in the previous quarter and operating margin increasing to 9% from 7%. For the fourth quarter, the company forecast revenue of $800 million to $860 million, with the midpoint above the $813.9 million consensus, and adjusted earnings of $1.11 to $1.35 per share.

Story Continues

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

GE HealthCare Technologies jumped 5.4% before the open after the medical technology company reported better-than-expected third-quarter results and raised its full-year outlook. Adjusted earnings came in at $1.34 per share, ahead of the $1.20 analyst estimate, while revenue reached $5.5 billion, exceeding expectations of $5.35 billion. Revenue grew 7.2% overall and 6.2% organically. Net income margin expanded to 11.1% from 8.7% a year earlier, while adjusted EBIT margin rose to 16.6% from 14.8%, supported by volume growth, pricing and cost productivity. Free cash flow increased by $310 million year-over-year to $793 million.

F5 fell 6.6% in premarket trading after the application security and delivery company paired a fiscal fourth-quarter earnings beat with a 2027 outlook that disappointed investors. The company forecast revenue growth of 8% to 9% for the coming fiscal year, while projecting a non-GAAP gross margin of 80.5% to 82.5%, below the 84% reported in the latest quarter. The outlook raised concerns that higher component costs and increased investment in sales capacity could weigh on profitability, despite the latest earnings beat.

Enphase Energy plunged 15.8% after the solar technology company reported third-quarter earnings and revenue below expectations and issued a weaker-than-anticipated fourth-quarter forecast. Adjusted earnings came in at $0.41 per share, missing the $0.51 consensus, while revenue of $293.3 million fell short of estimates of $303.85 million and declined sharply from the year-earlier period. Enphase forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $225 million to $255 million, with the midpoint of $240 million well below analysts' expectations of around $300.5 million, pointing to further sequential weakness in sales.

SolarEdge Technologies fell 7.1% in premarket trading to $29.87, following the selloff in solar stocks triggered by Enphase Energy's disappointing results and weak revenue guidance. Enphase's earnings miss and forecast for fourth-quarter revenue well below Wall Street expectations heightened concerns about demand across the solar sector, dragging down peer stocks.

NXP Semiconductors dropped 8.5% before the bell as investors focused on the chipmaker's fourth-quarter outlook despite a stronger-than-expected third-quarter performance. Revenue rose 19% year-over-year to $3.79 billion, while adjusted earnings of $4.20 per share topped the $4.11 consensus. However, the company's fourth-quarter revenue forecast of $3.85 billion at the midpoint came in slightly below analyst expectations. Its projected adjusted operating income of $1.374 billion to $1.442 billion also fell short of the $1.44 billion FactSet consensus at the midpoint, raising concerns about a slowdown from the previous quarter's momentum.

Boston Scientific slid 3.6% in premarket trading to $43.42 after the medical device maker reported a third-quarter earnings miss and lowered its full-year forecast. Adjusted earnings came in at $0.73 per share, below the $0.75 consensus, while revenue of $5.14 billion edged past estimates of $5.12 billion and grew 1.5% year-over-year. The company forecast fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $0.77 to $0.79 per share, below the $0.83 analyst consensus, and cut its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings outlook to $3.16 to $3.18 per share from $3.28 to $3.32. Boston Scientific also expects fourth-quarter sales to decline 1% to 3% year-over-year, citing lingering disruption from an August cyberattack that affected manufacturing, order processing and global shipments.

VF Corporation fell 5.5% before the bell despite the apparel maker reporting better-than-expected fiscal second-quarter 2027 results. Adjusted earnings reached $0.70 per share, beating the $0.53 analyst consensus, while revenue of $2.7 billion topped estimates of $2.66 billion. Adjusted operating income of $364 million also exceeded the company's guidance of approximately $315 million. The decline came despite the earnings beat, as investors appeared to take profits after the stock had rallied sharply ahead of the results.
