news.Title: Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It
news.Content:
Marvell Technology (MRVL) is one of the stocks most watched by Zacks.com visitors lately. So, it might be a good idea to review some of the factors that might affect the near-term performance of the stock.

Shares of this chipmaker have returned -7.5% over the past month versus the Zacks S&P 500 composite's -0.2% change. The Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry, to which Marvell belongs, has lost 14.4% over this period. Now the key question is: Where could the stock be headed in the near term?

While media releases or rumors about a substantial change in a company's business prospects usually make its stock 'trending' and lead to an immediate price change, there are always some fundamental facts that eventually dominate the buy-and-hold decision-making.

Revisions to Earnings Estimates

Rather than focusing on anything else, we at Zacks prioritize evaluating the change in a company's earnings projection. This is because we believe the fair value for its stock is determined by the present value of its future stream of earnings.

Our analysis is essentially based on how sell-side analysts covering the stock are revising their earnings estimates to take the latest business trends into account. When earnings estimates for a company go up, the fair value for its stock goes up as well. And when a stock's fair value is higher than its current market price, investors tend to buy the stock, resulting in its price moving upward. Because of this, empirical studies indicate a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and short-term stock price movements.

For the current quarter, Marvell is expected to post earnings of $1.10 per share, indicating a change of +44.7% from the year-ago quarter. The Zacks Consensus Estimate has changed +0.2% over the last 30 days.

The consensus earnings estimate of $4.21 for the current fiscal year indicates a year-over-year change of +48.2%. This estimate has changed +0.2% over the last 30 days.

For the next fiscal year, the consensus earnings estimate of $7.36 indicates a change of +74.8% from what Marvell is expected to report a year ago. Over the past month, the estimate has changed +9.3%.

Having a strong externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool, the Zacks Rank, offers a more conclusive picture of a stock's price direction in the near term, since it effectively harnesses the power of earnings estimate revisions. Due to the size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, Marvell is rated Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

Story Continues

The chart below shows the evolution of the company's forward 12-month consensus EPS estimate:

12 Month EPS

Revenue Growth Forecast

Even though a company's earnings growth is arguably the best indicator of its financial health, nothing much happens if it cannot raise its revenues. It's almost impossible for a company to grow its earnings without growing its revenue for long periods. Therefore, knowing a company's potential revenue growth is crucial.

In the case of Marvell, the consensus sales estimate of $3.16 billion for the current quarter points to a year-over-year change of +52.2%. The $12.05 billion and $19.99 billion estimates for the current and next fiscal years indicate changes of +47% and +66%, respectively.

Last Reported Results and Surprise History

Marvell reported revenues of $2.74 billion in the last reported quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +36.5%. EPS of $0.94 for the same period compares with $0.67 a year ago.

Compared to the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2.71 billion, the reported revenues represent a surprise of +1.03%. The EPS surprise was +1.08%.

Over the last four quarters, Marvell surpassed consensus EPS estimates three times. The company topped consensus revenue estimates each time over this period.

Valuation

No investment decision can be efficient without considering a stock's valuation. Whether a stock's current price rightly reflects the intrinsic value of the underlying business and the company's growth prospects is an essential determinant of its future price performance.

Comparing the current value of a company's valuation multiples, such as its price-to-earnings (P/E), price-to-sales (P/S), and price-to-cash flow (P/CF), to its own historical values helps ascertain whether its stock is fairly valued, overvalued, or undervalued, whereas comparing the company relative to its peers on these parameters gives a good sense of how reasonable its stock price is.

The Zacks Value Style Score (part of the Zacks Style Scores system), which pays close attention to both traditional and unconventional valuation metrics to grade stocks from A to F (an A is better than a B; a B is better than a C; and so on), is pretty helpful in identifying whether a stock is overvalued, rightly valued, or temporarily undervalued.

Marvell is graded F on this front, indicating that it is trading at a premium to its peers. Click here to see the values of some of the valuation metrics that have driven this grade.

Bottom Line

The facts discussed here and much other information on Zacks.com might help determine whether or not it's worthwhile paying attention to the market buzz about Marvell. However, its Zacks Rank #2 does suggest that it may outperform the broader market in the near term.

news.Title: ICM攜手康和投顧 聚焦美國陽光帶工業不動產發展趨勢
news.Content:
北美資產管理公司ICM Asset Management（簡稱ICM）及旗下美國子公司ICM Realty Group宣布與康和投顧展開合作，聚焦美國陽光帶工業不動產市場，並看好台積電擴大投資亞利桑那州後，帶動半導體、先進製造、航太國防、與生技產業等發展。

台積電鳳凰城已逐步形成半導體產業廊帶；ICM表示，將參與開發面對台積電鳳凰城北部廠區的Halo Vista大型開發計畫，規劃涵蓋工業製造、辦公、零售、住宅及教育等多元用途，整體開發面積最高可達3,000萬平方英尺（約279萬平方公尺）；首期工業開發計畫預計興建七棟建築，總面積約78萬平方英尺（約7.25萬平方公尺），提供台積電供應鏈赴美辦公的據點選擇。

這次參與Halo Vista大型開發計畫可望以私募方式進行，康和投顧董事長黎奕彬表示，台積電走向全球，在海外帶動新的供應鏈及實體資產需求，這次與ICM合作，目前先規劃康和客戶透過政府推動位於高雄的亞洲資產管理中心來參與私募，結合國際專業與在地能力，以更宏觀的視角掌握台積電全球布局所帶動的產業發展，同時強化國際視野與專業能力，未來也不排除與亞洲資產中心其他私人銀行合作，為台灣資產管理產業的深化與發展貢獻力量。

ICM過去亦曾在鳳凰城地區參與多項工業不動產開發，包括位於西谷地區Loop 303交通廊帶、面積約27萬平方英尺的Glendale Industrial開發案，以及位於10號州際公路沿線、由兩棟建築組成、面積約25萬平方英尺的Buckeye Industrial開發案，分別於2022年及2024年出售。此外，ICM亦曾與Mack Real Estate成立合資事業，參與鄰近台積電鳳凰城廠區的Mack Innovation Park開發計畫，累積從投資機會辨識、土地開發、招商租賃至資產處分等實務經驗。

ICM也聚焦德州奧斯汀及周邊成長廊帶受到科技與半導體產業發展帶動，三星電子位於泰勒市興建中的半導體廠，也為當地工業及物流市場帶來新的產業需求。佛羅里達州奧蘭多具備航太國防及工業發展基礎；北卡羅來納州及南卡羅來納州則受惠於港口物流、汽車與航太供應鏈，以及製造業持續移入。上述地區與喬治亞州共同構成美國陽光帶重要的產業及物流網絡。

ICM Asset Management執行長、合夥人暨投資組合經理John Courtliff表示，ICM很高興與康和投顧展開合作，並期待將深耕北美多年的工業不動產經驗與市場觀察帶到台灣；他指出，鳳凰城的長期人口與就業成長，加上半導體、先進製造、航太國防及科技產業發展，正形成具實際企業需求支撐的工業市場。

ICM美國區合夥人暨董事總經理Spencer Patton表示，美國陽光帶工業不動產市場正逐步進入新的發展週期。經歷前一階段大量新增供給後，新建案開工速度已明顯放緩；另一方面，來自先進製造、半導體、航太國防、資料中心及製造業回流相關供應鏈的需求仍持續累積。

ICM Asia負責人暨共同董事總經理Stanley Kung表示，台灣及韓國對全球半導體供應鏈具有高度理解，而台積電與三星持續擴大美國投資，不僅帶動晶圓廠建設，也創造工業廠房、物流設施及供應商基礎建設需求。

news.Title: "Big Short" Investor Steve Eisman Warns: OpenAI Bankruptcy Could Cause a Recession
news.Content:
Steve Eisman, one of the investors who got famous for shorting the U.S. housing market before the 2008 mortgage crisis, was recently interviewed on Ritholtz Wealth Management's The Compound and Friends podcast.

Eisman, whose story was among those told in the bestseller and movie The Big Short, warned that the U.S. stock market has become heavily concentrated in the artificial intelligence (AI) trade, and asserted that if one major AI start-up goes out of business, it could trigger a recession.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Eisman is not warning about a repeat of 2008. He didn't say that he believes that any major AI companies are in immediate danger. But if you want to understand the possible risks that the AI stock boom poses to the stability of the whole S&P 500 , he is worth listening to.

Where did the AI boom come from? Corporate investment

The AI sector's boom has been driven by hundreds of billions of dollars of capital investments by some of the biggest companies on Earth. Hyperscalers like Alphabet and Microsoft are spending hundreds of billions of dollars a year to build AI data centers, buy semiconductors from companies like Nvidia , and build AI models to power products like Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini.

OpenAI and Anthropic, the developers of ChatGPT and Claude, respectively, are not publicly traded yet, although both companies are preparing for initial public offerings (IPOs). But these AI labs have become highly important to the U.S. stock market because so many major tech companies are buying from them, building with them, investing in them, and selling compute and cloud services to them.

The impact of these AI capital expenditures has spilled over into the rest of the U.S. economy. Construction companies, energy companies, utilities, and other industries have benefited from rising revenues and earnings as they've collected shares of that spending. According to a recent Goldman Sachs analysis, through September, the AI boom was responsible for nearly 50% of S&P 500 earnings per share (EPS) growth in 2026.

So what's the problem? What if the AI boom just keeps going for years to come?

Eisman warns: The AI sector has a "concentration problem"

Here's the biggest risk facing the stock market, based on what's going on with AI stocks right now: concentration risk. The S&P 500 index has become top-heavy, with tech stocks and just a few big companies driving much of the recent AI-related economic activity.

Story Continues

"The problem with the AI story is a concentration problem," Eisman said on The Compound and Friends. He pointed out that about 70% of Nvidia's accounts receivable comes from just five customers -- what happens if one of those customers goes away? He also noted that about 70% of the hyperscalers' AI revenue comes from just two companies: Anthropic and OpenAI.

What if one of those AI labs struggles or fails to live up to its investors' expectations? The entire structure of the AI stock boom could start to wobble. Eisman did not make any specific predictions about either Anthropic or OpenAI, nor did he forecast where he sees individual AI stocks going. But he made a thoughtful analysis of the risks. And he said -- although he's not predicting that this will happen -- "If OpenAI went bankrupt tomorrow... the U.S. economy would go into recession."

Should you still invest in the S&P 500 with AI bubble risks?

The "AI bubble," if you want to call it that, might not burst. These major tech companies are betting heavily on a bright future powered by AI tools that could boost productivity and efficiency in ways that drive big economic gains for years to come. It might work.

But even if there is a slowdown in AI investment, or a big AI stock market crash, Eisman doesn't believe it will be as bad as the 2008 stock market crash. The risks we're seeing now in AI stocks are "not the same thing" as those seen in the 2008 global financial crisis, he said.

Over the past 10 years, the S&P 500, as reflected in the index-tracking Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSEMKT: VOO), has delivered an average annual return of about 15.3%. Over the past five years, VOO has delivered annualized returns of about 13.8% -- and that period included a bad bear market in 2022.

These strong returns might not continue. But the S&P 500 has a long-term track record of resilience, despite the occasional crashes along the way. Over the long run, the S&P 500 tends to be a great investment even if you buy shares right before a bubble bursts.

news.Title: Etsy (ETSY) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
news.Content:
Etsy (ETSY) came out with quarterly earnings of $1.55 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1.34 per share. This compares to earnings of $0.63 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items.

This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +15.67%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this online crafts marketplace would post earnings of $1.17 per share when it actually produced earnings of $1.34, delivering a surprise of +14.53%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates four times.

Etsy, which belongs to the Zacks Internet - Commerce industry, posted revenues of $692.47 million for the quarter ended September 2026, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 3.51%. This compares to year-ago revenues of $678.03 million. The company has topped consensus revenue estimates four times over the last four quarters.

The sustainability of the stock's immediate price movement based on the recently-released numbers and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's commentary on the earnings call.

What's Next for Etsy?

While Etsy has outperformed the market so far this year, the question that comes to investors' minds is: what's next for the stock?

There are no easy answers to this key question, but one reliable measure that can help investors address this is the company's earnings outlook. Not only does this include current consensus earnings expectations for the coming quarter(s), but also how these expectations have changed lately.

Empirical research shows a strong correlation between near-term stock movements and trends in earnings estimate revisions. Investors can track such revisions by themselves or rely on a tried-and-tested rating tool like the Zacks Rank, which has an impressive track record of harnessing the power of earnings estimate revisions.

Ahead of this earnings release, the estimate revisions trend for Etsy was mixed. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock. So, the shares are expected to perform in line with the market in the near future. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

It will be interesting to see how estimates for the coming quarters and the current fiscal year change in the days ahead. The current consensus EPS estimate is $1.91 on $880.93 million in revenues for the coming quarter and $6.15 on $2.85 billion in revenues for the current fiscal year.

Story Continues

Investors should be mindful of the fact that the outlook for the industry can have a material impact on the performance of the stock as well. In terms of the Zacks Industry Rank, Internet - Commerce is currently in the bottom 24% of the 250 plus Zacks industries. Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperform the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1.

One other stock from the same industry, Amazon (AMZN), is yet to report results for the quarter ended September 2026. The results are expected to be released on October 29.

news.Title: Why Elon Musk's Latest Trillion-Dollar Forecast for SpaceX Is One That Investors Should Take With a Grain of Salt
news.Content:
Investors expect big things from Space Exploration Technologies Corp (NASDAQ:SPCX), and CEO Elon Musk often pumps up the company's growth prospects, both in the long run and in the short term. Between telecom, artificial intelligence (AI), and space, there is an abundance of growth potential for the business. And that's a key reason many investors don't balk at buying the stock despite its high valuation -- SpaceX has a market cap of around $2 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies in the world.

While there's no shortage of excitement around its opportunities, Musk's latest forecast for the business stood out for multiple reasons. Not only did it call for $1 trillion in revenue at an earlier time frame than in the past, but the range was also incredibly wide; investors should take it with a grain of salt.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Musk's latest forecast isn't much of a forecast at all

SpaceX reported earnings last week, and much of the focus was on what lies ahead for business. This is, after all, a company whose valuation is more closely tied to future expectations rather than what it has accomplished thus far. With grand ambitions related to space travel , AI, and disrupting the telecom sector, investors are always eager to hear about SpaceX's future.

Previously, Musk said that SpaceX could hit $1 trillion in revenue by 2030. Now, however, Musk has suggested that the business could hit that milestone even earlier, saying on the company's recent earnings call that its annual recurring revenue could get to $1 trillion by the end of next year. But that's the top end of the range. His full range was $500 billion to $1 trillion. It's little wonder that CFO Bret Johnsen reportedly laughed when hearing that outlook, since that doesn't amount to much of a forecast at all.

The broad range is what's troubling, as it implies a great deal of uncertainty, as if Musk threw out the number to suggest it is possible to get there in the near term. But given the significant range, investors shouldn't take it too seriously.

Buying SpaceX stock based on lofty future expectations is risky

While SpaceX has a bright future and a ton of growth potential, investors who buy the stock shouldn't ignore its high valuation . At around $2 trillion in market cap, it might seem like a cheap buy if its revenue does hit $1 trillion within a few years, but a lot would have to go right for that to happen. The company generated $14.6 billion in revenue during its most recent quarter, putting it at an annual run rate of around $58 billion -- nowhere near $1 trillion.

Story Continues

Investing in a stock based on incredibly optimistic growth prospects is dangerous because if the business doesn't execute successfully and hit its targets, the stock could be vulnerable to a significant sell-off.

"Musk's framing was blunt: debt markets have 'almost entirely shut off' for companies without substantial revenue independent of AI data centers, and more than 200 neoclouds face consolidation or failure. SpaceX gets the money because Starlink and launch throw off cash that has nothing to do with AI, the same reason the hyperscalers can keep spending while single-purpose compute renters are repriced. We disagree with the broad version of that call: compute demand still exceeds supply, and neoclouds with contracted capacity and funded balance sheets will keep filling the gap the hyperscalers cannot. But there will be losers, and they will be the ones that built on debt against uncontracted demand. SpaceX is making itself one of the handful of balance sheets that can fund gigawatts."

However, a crucial component that Ives highlighted is worth noting regarding the potential merger and its acceptance among Tesla shareholders when he said, "The hurdle is a Tesla shareholder base that owns the stock for autonomy and Optimus and will not vote for an exchange ratio that values those businesses at today's price."

Thus, it is worth examining what the possible implications would be if these two trillion-dollar companies do eventually come together. Let's find out.

A $3.5 Trillion Giant

The combination of SpaceX and Tesla, if and when it happens, would be historic in numerous ways. For instance, it will be the first time in history that two companies with market caps exceeding $1 trillion would combine and create a behemoth whose market cap would be around $3.5 trillion, making it the fifth-largest company in the world. Together, they would be operating in myriad industries like automobiles, space exploration, data centers, AI, social media, and energy.

Story Continues

Notably, formal processes have already begun, with both companies forming committees of independent directors to consider it.

In terms of synergies, the most tangible one is power for AI data centers, because the companies are already doing business here. SpaceX bought $480 million of Tesla Megapack products during the first nine months of 2026. Tesla says its batteries can support large data center loads, help manage swings in demand, and strengthen power reliability. Thus, a merged company could plan battery supply, installation, and data center expansion under one capital budget, potentially resulting in lower costs.

Meanwhile, chips offer another specific point of overlap. Tesla is building compute for vehicle and robot development, with a stated goal of reaching 400 megawatts of training capacity by the end of 2026. SpaceX needs enormous computing capacity for its own AI models and services. Musk has also identified chip design and the companies' planned Terafab manufacturing project as reasons to cooperate. A merger could give their engineers one process for deciding which chips to design, which workloads receive scarce capacity, and how much manufacturing risk to take.

Finally, software is a similar mix of opportunity and overlap. SpaceX's AI business includes Grok and its agent products. Tesla reported 1.74 million active subscriptions to its supervised driving software at the end of September and said Cybercab passengers can already access Grok and Grok Bot by voice. Common ownership could make it easier to coordinate assistants, entertainment, and fleet services across vehicles, phones, and other devices.

However, some concerns may also arise. Apart from the acceptability of the exchange ratio for Tesla shareholders, the spectre of regulatory scrutiny is there as well, as the merger would put Tesla's substantial China manufacturing business under the same corporate parent as a major United States space and defense contractor, inviting scrutiny that a commercial partnership might avoid.

Shares of SpaceX are down 9% since its listing, while TSLA stock is down 9% on a year-to-date (YTD) basis.

Analyst Opinion on SPCX and TSLA Stocks

Overall, analysts have deemed both SPCX and TSLA stocks as consensus "Moderate Buys." While the mean target price for SPCX stock is $249.70, the one for TSLA is $412.29, indicating upside potential of 68% and 5.2%, respectively. Out of 40 analysts covering SPCX stock, 27 have a "Strong Buy" rating, three have a "Moderate Buy" rating, eight have a "Hold" rating, one has a "Moderate Sell" rating, and one has a "Strong Sell" rating. For TSLA stock, out of 41 analysts, 16 have a "Strong Buy" rating, two have a "Moderate Buy" rating, 20 have a "Hold" rating, and three have a "Strong Sell" rating.

news.Title: Will Midterm Elections Cause the Trump Bull Market to Crash? History Says There's Good and Bad News...
news.Content:
From a statistical standpoint, Wall Street couldn't be happier with President Donald Trump's time in the White House. The average annual return of the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES:^DJI), S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC), and Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) has been higher under Trump than under most other presidents over the last 130 years .

But the Nov. 3 midterm elections can change everything for the Trump bull market. Though not all laws passed on Capitol Hill have a bearing on Wall Street, Congress is ultimately responsible for crafting the fiscal policy that directly influences corporate America.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

President Trump may be working with a divided Congress come January 2027. Image source: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok.

Based on what prediction markets expect and what history tells us, a good-news/bad-news scenario awaits stocks.

Will there be a Trump bull market crash?

Entering midterm elections, Republicans hold narrow leads in the House of Representatives (218 of 435 seats) and the Senate (53 of 100 seats). As of Oct. 24, traders on Polymarket believe there's a 66% chance that Democrats will retake both houses of Congress. Another 26% of traders expect the GOP to retain the Senate but lose the House.

While prediction markets offer no guarantees, there's an overwhelming belief that President Trump will be working with a divided Congress come January 2027.

A few years ago, online retirement planning platform Retirement Researcher calculated the average annual return of the S&P 500 from 1926 to 2023 under four political scenarios: Unified Democrat, Unified Republican, Democratic president with a divided Congress, and Republican president with a divided Congress. Whereas the first three scenarios generated average annual returns ranging from 14.01% to 16.63%, a divided Congress with a Republican president produced the worst average annual return: 7.33%.

Although history points to subpar stock market returns if Republicans lose one or both houses of Congress on Nov. 3, the odds of a stock market crash are no higher in this scenario than in any other. Even at 7.33%, the average annual return of stocks remains superior to other asset classes, such as commodities, real estate, and bonds.

Story Continues

Image source: Getty Images.

A divided Congress would offer benefits and drawbacks for investors

In some ways, a divided Congress can be preferable for Wall Street and investors.

For example, the ideological differences between America's two prominent political parties make it unlikely that major legislation will be signed into law during the second half of Donald Trump's term. This means federal tax law and projected government spending should be highly predictable for the foreseeable future. If there's one thing investors absolutely love from Washington, D.C., it's predictability.

But there are still potential speed bumps for the stock market if prediction markets prove accurate and Democrats retake one or both houses of Congress. Arguably the biggest headwind for Wall Street, aside from persistently elevated inflation, is the potential for a prolonged government shutdown.

Unified governments rarely have any issues raising America's debt ceiling. But when one or both houses of Congress are controlled by the party opposite to a sitting president, political gridlock can lead to protracted government shutdowns that do real damage to the economy (and the stock market).

Thankfully, decades of return data show that the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite have risen regardless of which party holds the majority in Congress. But this doesn't mean the next two years won't be a bumpy ride.

news.Title: 現在是進場時機？德銀揭美股百年規律 年底多頭劇本浮現
news.Content:
德意志銀行（德銀）根據近百年市場數據分析，美股可能正接近2026年最後一波季節性回檔的低點。隨著美國期中選舉將至，歷史上的選舉週期與年底行情有望形成雙重順風。德銀全球宏觀研究主管Jim Reid指出，從1928年以來的歷史走勢觀察，10月27日前後通常是標普500指數年內最後一波回檔的落底時間，之後市場往往震盪走高至年底。

不過，德銀也提醒，歷史平均走勢不代表未來必然重演，伊朗局勢、人工智慧（AI）支出與法國政治風險，仍是市場不能忽視的變數。

百年數據指向10月底 歷史上年底行情偏強

德銀以1928年以來的標普500指數走勢為基礎，分析不同年份的市場變化。整體平均走勢顯示，指數通常在9月初附近見頂，9月底出現一波低點，短暫反彈後，10月下旬再經歷最後一波回檔，並於10月27日前後觸底。

依照這項歷史規律，10月底落底後，標普500指數在典型年份中往往逐步走高，延續至年底。這也讓10月下旬成為觀察美股是否可能進入年底上漲階段的重要時間點。

不過，整體年度平均走勢與期中選舉年的路徑並不完全相同。德銀指出，期中選舉年通常在4月下旬見頂，隨著選舉不確定性升高，指數回落約4%至5%，並在10月初附近觸底。兩種歷史模式雖然時間有所差異，但都指向秋季回檔後，市場可能在年底轉強。

過去23個期中選舉年 21次在隨後三個月上漲

過去23個美國期中選舉年中，有21年標普500指數在10月初起算的3個月內上漲，比例約91%。這段期間涵蓋年底的耶誕行情，也就是市場常在年末出現的季節性漲勢。

2026年的市場表現，則被德銀視為期中選舉年歷史模式的溫和版本。標普500指數在5月29日收於歷史新高，年初至今漲幅約11%，但此後近5個月的累計漲幅已不到1%，呈現高點過後動能放緩的情況。

隨著美國期中選舉定於11月3日舉行，德銀認為，期中選舉週期與年底季節性走勢的有利因素正逐漸匯聚。從歷史統計來看，這為標普500指數後續走勢提供偏正面的參考，也讓年底是否有機會展開耶誕行情，成為市場關注焦點。

歷史規律不等於必漲 3大風險仍待觀察

儘管過往數據呈現偏正面的季節性模式，Jim Reid仍提醒，平均值可能掩蓋不同年份之間的巨大差異。歷史上也曾出現期中選舉年遭遇熊市的情況，代表即使季節性因素有利，也無法排除市場大幅下跌的可能。

德銀特別點出3項值得留意的風險。首先，伊朗局勢可能影響能源價格，進而牽動全球通膨與利率展望。其次，人工智慧領域龐大的資本支出，以及支撐相關支出的融資安排，仍是股票投資人關注的問題。此外，法國的財政與政治壓力，也可能加劇歐洲市場波動。

news.Title: Global stocks get AI boost ahead of packed 48 hours
news.Content:
By Amanda Cooper

LONDON, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Global stocks rose on Wednesday, boosted by renewed enthusiasm over AI ahead of earnings from industry bellwethers later on, while in Europe financial shares weighed on the broader market on a big day for results, and oil rallied.

The coming 48 ‌hours are packed with potentially market-moving events, including rate decisions from major central banks including the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank and Bank of ‌Japan, as well as results from some of the beacons of the AI trade, such as Microsoft and Alphabet.

New Zealand's central bank delivered the first major surprise by leaving interest rates on hold, contrary ​to expectations for a hike, triggering the biggest daily drop in the currency in seven months .

On the equity market, Europe's STOXX index was down 0.25%, pulled lower by a decline in shares of Banco Santander, UBS and an 11% slide in the stock of payments company Adyen.

MSCI's All-World index, meanwhile, was up 0.2%, as US stock futures edged up between 0.1% and 0.4% and stocks in Asia rallied, led by a 6% surge in South Korea's Kospi after blockbuster earnings from chipmaker SK Hynix.

The AI rally faces its next test ‌when technology giants Alphabet and Microsoft report earnings after the ⁠market close on Wednesday. Investors will be scouring for evidence of returns that would justify the hefty cost of the AI build-out.

"Investors want to see how these two mega-cap tech stocks are monetising their AI investments," XTB director Kathleen Brooks said.

"These results could ⁠determine if the tech/AI rally has legs. Any signs of 1, a failure to monetise investments, or 2, a slowdown in capex spend, could have big repercussions for the AI trade on Wednesday night and Thursday," she said.

A series of AI-related funding announcements from Meta, SpaceX and Broadcom this week has breathed new life into the AI trade, with Anthropic's filing ​for ​an initial public offering also providing support.

"Not all big tech stocks should be treated equally ​regarding future potential growth. The period of a rising market lifting ‌all stocks has started to shift," said Chris Brigati, SWBC's chief investment officer.

CENTRAL BANK SURPRISES

Beyond earnings, investors are awaiting the Bank of Canada and the Fed's respective policy decisions later on Wednesday.

Expectations are for the BoC to raise rates and the Fed to keep them unchanged, though analysts at JPMorgan said in a note they anticipate at least two dissenting voices from US policymakers, which could send a hawkish signal to markets.

Story Continues

Earlier on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand surprised investors by keeping interest rates at 2.75% in a narrow vote, sending the kiwi down more than 1.3%, in its largest one-day fall since mid-March.

"Today's decision shows the RBNZ is willing ‌to surprise markets, a reminder that central banks do not take orders from markets," Carol ​Kong, a currency strategist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said.

In the UK, finance minister John Healey ​will deliver a cautious first budget on Wednesday, one that prioritises stability in ​the bond market over the kind of big spending moves that Andy Burnham talked about when he became prime minister.

The pound ‌was down a touch at $1.3293, while UK government bond yields edged ​up 2 basis points to 5.363%, as prices ​dipped. Gilt yields are heading for their first monthly decline since June this month, down 7 bps.

Israel's shekel fell 2.2%, set for its largest daily fall in about 16 months, as election results showed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc performing more strongly than expected, but still falling short of ​a parliamentary majority.

Elsewhere, oil prices rose after an attack on ‌a refinery in Saudi Arabia, the world's biggest crude exporter, renewed concerns around the risks to supply in the Middle East. [O/R]

Brent crude futures ​were up 1.1% at $115.13 a barrel, while European natural gas futures rose to fresh four-year highs, up another 3.3% at €99.2 per MWh.

(Additional reporting ​by Rae Wee in Singapore; Editing by Kate Mayberry, Toby Chopra and Keith Weir)

news.Title: 聯電估明年平均售價升10%　3年內AI營收比重達25%
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年10月28日電）晶圓代工廠聯電 (2303) 預期，第4季需求動能可望持續強勁，晶圓出貨量及產能利用率將維持穩健。執行長王石表示，2027年產品平均售價將較2026年揚升10%，3年內單季AI相關營收占比將挑戰25%。

聯電今天召開線上法人說明會，王石表示，電腦市場需求疲軟，不過，高階智慧手機和工業市場需求強勁，車用市場需求健康復甦，第4季客戶需求動能可望延續，晶圓出貨量將季增1%至3%，產能利用率約91%至93%，產品平均售價持穩，毛利率與第3季相當。

王石說，2027年營運可望維持成長趨勢，人工智慧（AI）是關鍵的成長驅動力，包括電源管理晶片、現場可程式化邏輯陣列（FPGA）、連接應用、矽光子和先進封裝將成長。因產能利用率已超過90%，多項製程接近滿載，出貨量成長可能越來越受到限制。

除8吋和12吋晶圓代工報價都有提升空間，王石表示，聯電產品組合也將更加豐富，2027年產品平均售價將較2026年上揚10%。

至於電源管理晶片、FPGA、矽光子和先進封裝等AI相關營收展望，王石說，未來3年內單季AI相關營收占總營收比重將挑戰25%。

王石表示，2026年資本支出20億美元。因應先進封裝與矽光子新業務需求明顯增加，聯電正將部分既有產能轉作相關用途，因應短期內尚未滿足的需求。

王石說，董事會今天核准追加約32億美元資本支出預算，約新台幣1027.81億元，將有助於加快新加坡和南科擴產時程，同時緊密配合客戶產品藍圖與需求。

聯電第3季受惠各終端市場需求維持穩健，整體產能利用率達92%，數座12吋晶圓廠產能滿載，8吋晶圓廠營運亦強勁復甦。

聯電第3季晶圓出貨量逾120萬片12吋約當晶圓，創下歷史新高，季營收新台幣742.4億元，季增8%，毛利率34%，較第2季上揚1.5個百分點，營業利益186.4億元，季增24.7%，因業外收益縮水影響，歸屬母公司淨利164.34億元，季減61.1%，每股純益1.32元。

聯電累計前3季營收2040.1億元，年增16.1%，毛利率32%，較去年同期揚升3.6個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利748.65億元，年增136.5%，每股純益6元。

隨著客戶持續完成顯示驅動IC、車用雷達及Wi-Fi晶片等新產品設計定案，聯電第3季22奈米及28奈米業務再創單季新高，其中22奈米營收占晶圓銷售達18.3%。

news.Title: Can nVent Electric Become the Next Vertiv?
news.Content:
Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) has become the leader in liquid cooling solutions for artificial intelligence (AI) AI data centers , but a 700% run-up in the stock price during the past five years may have some investors feeling they missed the ride. For investors seeking a second chance at this opportunity, nVent Electric (NYSE: NVT) has a shot at becoming the next Vertiv.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

How they are similar

Vertiv and nVent Electric were both around long before AI demands necessitated liquid cooling solutions. While nVent Electric's brands date back to 1894, Vertiv has been around for 80 years.

Data center growth has been a main story for each company. nVent Chief Executive Officer Beth Wozniak cited "significant data center growth" in the company's Q2 earnings press release while announcing a manufacturing expansion for liquid cooling.

Less surprisingly, Vertiv CEO Giordano Albertazzi mentioned intensifying demand for AI compute, which has led to more advanced, infrastructure-intensive deployments of liquid cooling systems. As AI evolves and becomes more complex, Vertiv stands to make more money from manufacturing and installing its liquid-cooling solutions in data centers.

Vertiv and nVent Electric both raised full-year forecasts as AI demand continues to exceed expectations. They also have vast backlogs. nVent closed out the quarter with a $2.5 billion backlog, while Vertiv has a $15 billion backlog.

The differences

nVent is a smaller company. It has a $21 billion market cap against Vertiv's $80 billion. The former is also growing faster, with 53% year-over-year revenue growth compared to Vertiv's 24%. Both companies have similar net profit margins, but nVent's profits are growing faster.

Valuation metrics also favor nVent, which has a 19.5 forward P/E ratio compared to Vertiv's 21.8 forward P/E ratio. A lower valuation gives nVent a somewhat higher margin of safety than Vertiv at current levels, as long as both companies maintain their current growth rates.

One of the biggest distinctions between these investments is the extent to which they are involved in liquid cooling solutions for data centers. It's at the forefront of Vertiv's business, but nVent is more diversified.

More diversification isn't always a good thing. A higher percentage of Vertiv's business centers on the hottest industry, whereas that share is a smaller slice of nVent's total sales. That gives Vertiv greater exposure to AI, but it also means that as nVent's AI data center business becomes a larger share of total sales, its revenue growth rates can accelerate and remain faster than Vertiv's.

Story Continues

How to approach nVent

nVent is at the right place at the right time and stands to boost its revenue and profit margins thanks to the AI build-out. Right now, it's a smaller slice of nVent's total business than Vertiv, but that may create the opportunity for elevated future returns.

Since nVent has a smaller market share in the AI data center industry, it has more room to expand than a more mature company like Vertiv. Furthermore, as noted, nVent has a more attractive valuation.

nVent also saw its free cash flow soar 125% year over year, reaching $167 million. That means the company can keep and increase its cash even as capital expenditures continue to grow. While nVent benefits from rapid capital expenditure increases, it's also encouraging to see positive free cash flow as the company seeks to expand its manufacturing capabilities.

nVent looks very much like a smaller Vertiv. Although Vertiv has a much deeper backlog, nVent is delivering higher growth rates right now. As its AI industry presence expands, it can scale its pipeline over time.

news.Title: Tesla's Free Cash Flow Just Turned Positive. Here's Why That's Only Half the Story.
news.Content:
Tesla 's (NASDAQ: TSLA) third-quarter earnings report came with at least one notable surprise -- the company announced that it generated $1.53 billion in free cash flow, just one quarter after burning through more than $1 billion in cash.

That's certainly encouraging news for a company spending heavily on artificial intelligence (AI), autonomous vehicles, and humanoid robots.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

But before investors get too excited, there's something important buried in those numbers. Tesla's free cash flow fell 62% from a year earlier, and the positive result was largely due to lower capital expenditure (capex) than forecast.

That raises some interesting questions about how Tesla intends to finance Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk's ambitious plans -- and what those investments could mean for Tesla stock .

Tesla's cash flow surprise comes with a catch

In the third quarter, Tesla generated $6.26 billion in operating cash flow, essentially matching the $6.24 billion it produced a year earlier. That was an improvement from the $4.7 billion generated in the second quarter.

But capital expenditures tell a different story. Tesla's capex totaled $4.73 billion during the quarter, down from $5.79 billion in the second quarter. That helped turn a $1.09 billion free cash flow deficit into a $1.53 billion surplus.

The result was also considerably better than Wall Street expected. According to Tesla's own pre-earnings average estimate, analysts had anticipated about $7.77 billion in third-quarter capex and negative free cash flow of $4.51 billion.

Instead, Tesla spent roughly $3 billion less than expected.

That's a big difference. And while generating positive free cash flow is preferable to burning cash, spending less money doesn't necessarily mean the underlying business has become more profitable.

In fact, Tesla's third-quarter operating income fell 56% year over year to $718 million, while net income attributable to common shareholders declined 43% to $787 million.

The company is generating cash, but its earnings remain under pressure.

Tesla still has billions left to spend

Earlier this year, Tesla announced it would make more than $25 billion in capex. But during the third-quarter earnings call, Chief Financial Officer Vaibhav Taneja lowered that outlook to about $20 billion.

Story Continues

That's a substantial reduction, but Tesla isn't exactly putting its checkbook away. Through the first nine months of 2026, the company's capex totaled $13.01 billion, more than double the $6.13 billion spent during the same period last year.

Reaching $20 billion would require another $7 billion in spending during the fourth quarter -- considerably more than Tesla spent in either of the previous two quarters. And the company's latest regulatory filing still projects capital expenditures exceeding $20 billion this year.

So, although Tesla's third-quarter free cash flow looks encouraging, the spending demands aren't going away.

Musk has outlined plans to expand Cybercab production , build manufacturing capacity for Optimus robots, invest in AI computing, and develop semiconductor manufacturing capabilities. These are expensive undertakings, and most have yet to demonstrate that they can generate meaningful profits.

Tesla also secured $30 billion in additional borrowing capacity in the third quarter to help finance its future investments. Management says it doesn't expect to draw on those funds during 2026.

What does this mean for investors?

I've previously written about Tesla's ambitious spending plans and the challenges of turning its AI and robotics investments into profitable businesses. The latest earnings report hasn't resolved those concerns.

There are some encouraging developments. Tesla's operating cash flow improved sequentially, automotive gross margins strengthened, and the company continues to generate substantial cash from its existing operations. But Tesla is also spending aggressively at a time when its operating profits are declining.

For investors, the next few quarters should provide a better indication of whether Tesla can fund its ambitions without placing additional pressure on its balance sheet. With billions in additional spending still on the agenda, Tesla needs to demonstrate that its cash generation can keep pace with Musk's ambitions.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger

Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

Continue »

Patrick Sanders has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has positions in and recommends Tesla. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy .

news.Title: 大都會投信發表One MIM新品牌 投資長喊：7480億美元AUM應援 不漏接台股黃金行情
news.Content:
大都會投信今(28)日舉行記者會宣布邁入「One MIM」品牌新紀元。大都會投信投資長黃軍儒於會中強調，隨著柏瑞投資與大都會投資完成整合並發揮顯著綜效，全球總公司將會特別力挺台灣在地股票團隊，給予最豐厚的全球研究資源與資金支持，展現深耕台灣市場的堅定決心，絕對不會錯過台股當前與長線的黃金行情。總經理董俊男與亞洲區行銷長張靈靈亦表示，品牌整合標誌著公司邁向新前沿，未來將憑藉全球7480億美元資產管理規模，為投資人打造全方位的資產管理服務。

大都會投信總經理董俊男指出，完成品牌整合、邁向 One MIM 不僅是公司發展升級的重要里程碑，更是邁向「新前沿(New Frontier)」策略的關鍵一步。憑藉跨越全球19個國家及地區的服務網絡，以及管理資產規模高達7480億美元的全球平台，大都會投信將能以更具前瞻性的眼光與充沛的資源，應對快速變化的金融市場。

董俊男表示，全新的品牌代表著嶄新的開始，未來大都會投信將持續發揮母集團的全球資產管理能力，同時深化對台灣在地市場的長期承諾，協助客戶在不確定的市場環境中把握更多成長契機，邁向卓越的投資成果。

針對整合後的強大綜效，大都會投資全球通路零售及亞洲區行銷長張靈靈說明，過去柏瑞投資在亞洲及新興市場股票、多重資產與槓桿融資領域擁有非常深厚的耕耘與通路基礎；而大都會投資(MIM)則背靠大都會人壽集團逾150年的金融底蘊，在公私募固定收益、房地產與嚴謹的風險管理紀律上享譽全球。兩家強強聯手整合為 One MIM 後，不僅擴大了資產管理的廣度與深度，更實現了全球資源共享與在地決策機制的緊密結合。

談及台股市場的戰略布局，黃軍儒表示，台灣作為全球半導體與AI供應鏈的核心重鎮，台股市場近年展現出極具韌性與強勁的成長動能。在柏瑞投資與大都會投資整合為 One MIM 之後，台灣團隊不僅能即時取得全球逾850位投資專家的總體經濟與產業研究數據，總公司更是明確給予資源傾斜與政策支持，全力做為台灣股票團隊的堅強後盾。

黃軍儒指出，總公司未來會特別挺台股團隊，無論是在投資研究工具的導入、跨國團隊的協同分析，或是產品發行的彈性上，都會給予最高規格的全力應援，確保投資團隊能精準抓緊台股的黃金行情，為在地投資人創造亮眼的超額報酬。

展望台股與全球市場後市，黃軍儒分析，當前全球主要央行貨幣政策仍受通膨與經濟動向牽動，市場波動度相對增加，但台灣企業在AI浪潮與全球科技供應鏈轉型中佔據不可替代的利基地位。隨著總公司傾力相助，台灣股票團隊將能結合全球視野與在地專業，深入挖掘具備高成長潛力與強健基本面的台股優質企業。

黃軍儒強調，台股長期結構性成長趨勢明確，在總公司資源全面力挺下，團隊將以主動管理的專業實力，密切追蹤產業趨勢變化，全力協助投資人參與台股黃金行情的紅利盛宴。

大都會投信強調，全新品牌「Where Conviction Leads(信念領航)」反映了公司致力於提供優質投資解決方案的堅定承諾。透過結合大都會人壽集團150餘年的長期風險管理經驗，以及整合後的全球龐大投資平台，One MIM 將持續深耕台灣在地連結，並在總公司全力支持台股團隊的策略方向下，發揮跨國資產管理公司的最大綜效，引領台灣投資人共享全球與在地市場的成長果實。

news.Title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent Just Called the Genius Act a "Watershed Moment in American Finance." Here's What's Next for Stablecoins.
news.Content:
On Oct. 21, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that the Genius Act, which regulates stablecoins in the U.S., was "a watershed moment in American finance." His comments come right as regulators finalized their rules for the stablecoin market, which is valued at $298 billion.

In a questionable rhetorical flourish, Bessent likened the law to President Lincoln's National Currency Act of 1863, which created the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). Given that monumental framing, what's going to be the next big development in stablecoins, and how can investors profit from it?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

AI agents have made 138 million stablecoin payments already

The next big thing for stablecoins is probably their steady integration into the backend of ordinary financial products.

The most straightforward way to gain from that process is by owning the stocks of the biggest stablecoin issuers and distributors, like Circle Internet Group (NYSE: CRCL) and Coinbase Global (NASDAQ: COIN), which we'll get to a bit later. A second trend, AI agents paying for things on their own, could eventually add far more payment activity than those mundane applications, though for now it's more promise than revenue.

AI agents, which is to say software that's capable of paying for goods and services without a human's direct permission for every transaction, are the most-hyped driver for stablecoin adoption. And there's already some substance behind the hype, so don't assume this trend is about to peter out when it's just picking up.

In an October report, the Chainalysis crypto research group identified more than 138 million agent-made payments processed through x402, a Coinbase-built protocol that's used for paying in stablecoins. Separately, in August of this year, Circle said that 99.3% of x402 agent-payment dollars settled in its stablecoin, USDC , the second-largest stablecoin by market value after Tether's USDT .

The catch is that the individual payments by agents, at least for now, are almost exclusively made in minuscule amounts. In July, x402 handled about 75 million payments, but that sum was worth just $24 million, meaning an average of about $0.32 each.

Was any of that actually enabled by the Genius Act? Probably not, because the infrastructure for automated payments with stablecoins existed well before its passage last year.

Story Continues

Who gets paid as stablecoins ramp up?

Holding stablecoins won't earn you anything from their adoption. The Genius Act bans issuers from paying holders any interest.

Stablecoin issuers themselves can still earn interest on the reserves that back the coins people hold, but that's not something that scales per payment, and agents spending pennies have little need to hold much of a balance in their wallets anyway. That leaves a handful of crypto stocks as the best way to get some upside here.

Circle is the purest stablecoin play because it issues USDC, but it also needs to share the pie. In Q2, it paid $410.4 million in distribution and transaction costs, 58.5% of its $701.3 million in revenue, per its earnings release. Much of those distribution fees go to Coinbase, which racked up $292 million in stablecoin revenue in Q2.

Base, Coinbase's own blockchain where many of its USDC are hosted, takes transaction fees, including for stablecoin payments. So Coinbase may actually be better positioned than Circle, as it gets paid distribution fees first, and then transaction fees from the users it distributes to.

Interest rates are the biggest risk to stablecoin reserve income, so they pose a threat both Circle and Coinbase. Reserve income made up 95.2% of Circle's Q2 revenue, so rate cuts by the Federal Reserve would hit Circle Internet Group stock hardest.

Coinbase is the better buy for most investors to get exposure to the future of stablecoins, since stablecoins are a quarter of its revenue. If agent payments grow into real dollar amounts, Base fees could add modestly to Coinbase's revenue.

news.Title: SK Hynix Stock Gains 1.9% on AI Chip Demand, Dividend Hopes
news.Content:
SK hynix Inc. 's SKHY shares jumped on Oct. 27, supported by optimism over potential shareholder payouts, resilient demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips and expectations surrounding the memory-chip maker's quarterly results. The stock's movement reflected investors' continued interest in companies supplying critical components for AI infrastructure, as data-center operators and technology companies maintain substantial spending on advanced computing capacity.

A major near-term catalyst was the anticipation of SK Hynix's third-quarter earnings announcement, scheduled for Oct. 28. Reports that the company was considering a special dividend of about 16 trillion won ($12 billion), potentially funded by gains from its investment in Japanese memory-chip maker Kioxia, also boosted sentiment. However, SK Hynix clarified on Oct. 26 that no decision had been finalized, saying it was reviewing various shareholder-return measures.

The dividend speculation came against a favorable industry backdrop. SK Hynix is a major supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), which is essential for advanced AI accelerators and data-center applications. Increasing demand for these products has supported memory pricing and strengthened expectations for revenue growth. Investors have also been monitoring developments in next-generation HBM technology and manufacturers' ability to expand production to meet customers' requirements.

Broader market sentiment provided additional support. Asian equities advanced as technology shares benefited from renewed optimism about AI-related investments following a rally on Wall Street. SK Hynix's prospects remained closely tied to capital expenditure by major cloud-service providers and the pace at which AI adoption translates into sustained demand for memory chips.

Comparison With Peers

SKHY, which currently carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), is part of the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry. Its shares have gained 14.4% over the past three months against a 1% decline for the industry. Lam Research Corporation LRCX and Broadcom Inc. AVGO, two of SKHY's peers from the same industry, have lost 4.5% and 7.5% in the period, respectively. While AVGO carries a Rank #3, LRCX has a Rank #2 (Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

Bottom Line

Overall, SK Hynix's Tuesday advance reflected earnings anticipation, potential shareholder returns and confidence in AI-driven memory demand. Nevertheless, the proposed special dividend remained unconfirmed, while investors still weighed the sustainability of elevated chip prices and continued AI infrastructure spending when assessing the stock's outlook.

Story Continues

news.Title: Is Polymarket About to Launch a Crypto Token? Before You Buy It, This Is What You Need to Know.
news.Content:
The prediction market Polymarket might launch a crypto token soon, according to its CEO. At the annual TOKEN2049 crypto conference in Singapore on Oct. 7, CEO Shayne Coplan said that his business was considering whether to issue an "on-chain asset" that would be tied to the company's economics. Per Bloomberg, in August 2026, the prediction market was valued at $21 billion.

There isn't any token to buy yet, nor is the launch date or any specifics about the asset's tokenomics or other features known. Here's what to read up on to do your due diligence once there's a bit more information available.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Polymarket has $166 million in revenue already

The first thing to appreciate here is that Polymarket probably doesn't have a specific business need to issue a cryptocurrency. Its existing crypto protocol generated $137.5 million in revenue over the 12 months ending on Oct. 26, making it one of the industry's most used platforms. That means any new coin it launches is likely intended to be another source of income.

In terms of how the token might be structured, one path that's almost certainly under consideration is tokenized equity, meaning that the company's shares would be recorded on a token that's held on a blockchain. Polymarket isn't currently public, so this approach would be the only way for common investors to gain control of some of its shares.

But Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) staff said in January 2026 that shares of stock remain an equity security in the eyes of regulators, regardless of the technical format in which they're issued. So issuing tokenized equity would mean obeying securities law obligations, including registration requirements, and it'd also likely mean that there would be at least some limits on buyers.

The other path is for Polymarket to issue a native crypto token that is not backed by the company's equity. Hyperliquid could be the template here; it routes nearly all of its protocol fees into buying back its own token, like an automated share buyback program with no limits and no need for renewal by a board. That would be one way to tie the token to Polymarket's economics.

If Polymarket issues a separate native token, every dollar routed to holders is a dollar shareholders don't keep, so expect a stingy design.

Story Continues

What should you check before buying a Polymarket token?

There are three things that will largely decide whether a Polymarket token is worth owning.

First, the value-capture mechanism, such as buybacks or fee sharing. Knowing what makes a cryptocurrency valuable means insisting that the mechanism be written into code or contracts, not merely promised as a later addition.

The second element is the supply overhang, meaning the portion of the token's supply that its insiders could sell later. Learn how much insiders hold and when they're allowed to sell.

The final thing is to see where the token gets listed. Polymarket's international site excludes U.S. residents, so a token could debut on exchanges Americans can't use.

Until the official launch announcement, treat any Polymarket token as fake. If a token design is published in the next few quarters, take a look, as it's probably worth considering even if it's not the right pick for everyone.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again

In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. If you'd invested $5,000 then, you'd be sitting on $2,807,778 today.*

Now, for the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. It's a key player in the $1.8 trillion space race, and with the stock recently sitting 20% off its highs, the window to get in early is closing fast.

Continue »

*Stock Advisor returns as of October 28, 2026.

news.Content:
Meta Platforms META is leaving no stone unturned in its efforts to raise funds for its AI ambitions. The company intends to raise up to $95 billion to finance its expanding AI program. NVIDIA NVDA plans to invest $3 billion in Meta, as the social media giant ramps up its AI infrastructure spending through a massive fundraising plan.

The investment also underscores NVIDIA's close relationship with Meta, which relies on its chips to expand computing capacity and develop AI capabilities. NVIDIA said the companies would expand their work on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve training and inference performance, as reported by Yahoo Finance.

Meta Plans a Massive Capital Raise to Fund AI Expansion

Meta will begin with an initial $35 billion offering of common and preferred stock. The company said its major chip suppliers, NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices AMD and Broadcom AVGO, had expressed interest in purchasing up to $5 billion in aggregate equity.

Meta is also selling nearly $100 billion of stock to pay for AI, per Yahoo Finance. Meta priced $25 billion of regular stock at $625 a share, below the closing price on Oct. 23, 2026. Another $12.5 billion went into preferred stock that pays 6.5% and turns into common stock in 2029.

The biggest chunk, up to $60 billion, hasn't been sold yet. It's a new class of nonvoting stock that Meta plans to sell a little at a time starting next year.

The fundraising marks a shift for Meta, which has traditionally used advertising revenue to fund technology investments but is increasingly tapping capital markets to finance rising AI infrastructure costs.

AI Infrastructure Spending Is Pressuring Cash Flow

Meta's AI ambitions come with a substantial financial burden. The company's free cash flow went into negative territory for the first time since 2012, according to the supplied report, and mentioned on Yahoo Finance.

Meta now expects its full-year capex to range from $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the bottom of the range from $130 billion.

Debt Investors Signal Growing Concerns

The cost of insuring Meta's debt against default reportedly reached a record 127 basis points before easing, reflecting growing concern about its financial commitments, as mentioned on the same Yahoo Finance article.

Five-year credit default swaps trading around 120 basis points imply a higher perceived credit risk than a year ago.  For Meta, if monetization falls short of expectations, negative free cash flow and increased financing requirements could weigh on the stock.

Story Continues

Why Meta Could Be a Good Bet Now

Despite the risks, Meta's established advertising business and expanding AI capabilities provide a potential foundation for long-term growth. The investment case rests on several factors.

AI could strengthen Meta's core advertising business: Meta's family of apps gives it a large audience and an established advertising platform. Better AI models could improve ad targeting, campaign performance, content recommendations and user engagement.

AI agents offer new monetization opportunities: Meta is developing AI products that could expand beyond traditional social networking. In September, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg outlined the company's plans to monetize its rapidly growing Muse AI agent (read: Meta Maps Out Muse Monetization Strategy: Tap With ETFs or Stock?).

Decent Meta valuation: Meta's Price-to-Free-Cash-Flow (P/FCF) ratio stood at 46.6X as of Sept. 24, 2026, in line with the underlying Computer Software Services industry. The stock trades at a forward P/E multiple of 21.45X versus 21.46X for the underlying industry.

However, Meta's valuation looks pricey in terms of its price/sales ratio. The stock's price/sales ratio stands at 6.65X, higher than the industry average of 3.30X.

Long-term monetization potential remains:: Wedbush described Muse monetization as a longer-term opportunity and said it is too early to estimate advertising and payments revenue with certainty, per MT Newswires, as reported by Yahoo Finance.

Note that four of 11 analysts upped Meta earnings estimates for the upcoming quarter over the past seven days while five cut the same. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the December quarter has been upped by six cents to $8.13 over the past one month while the estimate stayed the same over the past one week.

Price Target

Based on estimates from 50 analysts, Meta Platforms has an average short-term price target of $857.58, ranging from $650 to $1,050. This implies 36% upside from its Oct. 26, 2026 closing price of $630.56.

Broker Rating

Meta Platforms has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.29, unchanged from a month ago, based on 56 brokerage recommendations. Of these, 47 are Strong Buy and two are Buy, accounting for 83.93% and 3.57% of total recommendations, respectively.

Meta shares have a strong Momentum Score of A and a Growth Score of B.

ETF Picks

Against this backdrop, investors can gain exposure to Meta through a basket approach using ETFs, as hurdles remain and the stock's valuation is not particularly cheap. The basket approach can help reduce company-specific concentration risk.

Meta-heavy ETFs include the likes of Fidelity MSCI Communication Services Index ETF FCOM, Global X PureCap MSCI Communication Services ETF GXPC, Meta AI Lab Ecosystem ETF MTAW, State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR ETF XLC and Vanguard Communication Services ETF VOX. Each of these ETFs allocates at least one-fifth of its portfolio to Meta shares.

news.Title: Onto Innovation's Q3 Revenue Outlook: Can Sales Hit $400M?
news.Content:
Onto Innovation Inc. ONTO has provided an encouraging revenue outlook for the third quarter of 2026, supported by strong demand across advanced packaging and advanced nodes. The company expects third-quarter revenues between $380 million and $400 million, indicating continued sequential growth from the second quarter. On the last earnings call, management anticipated further revenue improvement for the fourth quarter, reflecting increasing customer demand and stronger business visibility.

The optimistic outlook follows a robust second-quarter performance, during which revenues reached $343 million, increasing 18% sequentially and 35% year over year. Advanced nodes revenues surged 50% sequentially to approximately $120 million, driven by broad-based strength across memory and logic applications. Memory revenues increased roughly 60% sequentially, while logic revenues grew more than 40%.

Advanced packaging also remains a significant growth driver. The company's inspection business, led by its Dragonfly product family, recorded 30% sequential growth, benefiting from strong demand for 2.5D logic and high-bandwidth memory applications. The successful launch of Dragonfly G5 has further strengthened customer demand, prompting management to raise its 2026 advanced packaging growth outlook to approximately 80% from the previously projected 50%.

Encouraged by improving demand conditions, Onto Innovation raised its second-half 2026 revenue growth outlook to at least 25% over the first half from its earlier expectation of 15%. The company's record backlog exceeded $1.1 billion, providing additional visibility into future revenues. Management indicated that 60%-70% of the backlog relates to 2026, while the remaining 30-40% extends into 2027.

Alongside revenue growth, Onto expects further profitability improvements. Gross margin is projected to expand by approximately 50 basis points in each of the third and fourth quarters. Operating margin is expected to reach 32% in the third quarter and at least 33% by year-end. At the midpoint of its third-quarter revenue guidance, the company anticipates earnings of around $2.28 per share.

With accelerating advanced packaging demand, expanding advanced nodes opportunities and improving customer visibility, Onto Innovation's outlook supports the possibility of third-quarter revenues reaching the $400 million upper end of its guidance.

Taking a Look at ONTO's Competitors

KLA Corporation KLAC remains positioned to outperform as AI infrastructure spending broadens demand for process control across leading-edge logic, memory and advanced packaging. Rising chip complexity, larger die sizes and tighter defect requirements should increase inspection and metrology intensity. A backlog above $12 billion and improving supply availability provide visibility into 2027, while advanced packaging offers added share gains as front-end tools move into packaging flows. Services add recurring revenue as the installed base expands. KLA's differentiated portfolio, operating leverage and capital-return framework support long-term earnings growth. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, KLA expects revenues of $4 billion (plus or minus $200 million).

Story Continues

Applied Materials AMAT benefits from AI-led investment in leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM and advanced packaging, where rising process complexity supports demand for its equipment. New deposition and inspection technologies, value-based pricing and a growing services base strengthen its margin and cash flow outlook. Longer customer forecasts and expanded manufacturing capacity also provide visibility into future ramps. For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Applied Materials expects total revenues of approximately $10.25 billion (+/-$500 million), implying 51% year-over-year growth at the midpoint.

ONTO Price Performance, Valuation and Estimates

ONTO's shares have gained 56.2% in the past year, outperforming the Zacks Nanotechnology industry's growth of 49.6%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

On a forward price-to-earnings basis, ONTO's shares trade at 19.34X, higher than the industry's 3.57X.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for ONTO has remained unchanged for 2026 over the past 60 days.

Onto Innovation currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

news.Title: South Korea media commission fines Google and Apple over app payment systems
news.Content:
SEOUL, Oct 28 (Reuters) - South Korea's Media and ‌Communications Commission has fined ‌Google and Apple for limiting ​users to specific app payment systems and ordered corrective measures, the regulator ‌said on ⁠Wednesday.

Google was fined 42.9 billion won ($32.35 million) ⁠and Apple 20.8 billion won, the commission ​said in ​a ​statement.

Apple said it ‌disagreed with the decision and was evaluating options in accordance with South Korean laws. It said ‌it has worked ​with outside ​developers ​to enable innovation through ‌its App Store.

Google ​did ​not immediately have comment when contacted by Reuters.

($1 = ​1,326.0900 ‌won)

(Reporting by Jack KimEditing ​by Ed Davies and ​Tomasz Janowski)

news.Title: Morning Bid: Information overload
news.Content:
By Mike Dolan

Oct 28 (Reuters) - Much of this week's busy event calendar gets packed into the next 24 hours.

The day ahead includes the Federal Reserve's expected "hawkish hold", a possible Bank of Canada rate hike, AI hyperscaler earnings from Microsoft ‌and Alphabet after the bell, and even Britain's annual government budget.

The mood going into the barrage of news on Wednesday ‌was buoyant, with AI stocks rallying further on Tuesday and South Korean chip giant SK Hynix surging 10% overnight after reporting a tripling of net profit over the past ​year, while planning to give a whopping $75 billion back to shareholders.

The interest rate market was calm as the Fed decision loomed, with all the focus now on how Chair Kevin Warsh couches a likely pause in rate rises - as well as any indications of another hike by year-end. The number of policymaker dissents to a decision to hold may be key in that regard.

With both inflation above its 2% target and unemployment below ‌5% for more than five years now, the ⁠Fed needs to recalibrate what it considers "neutral", as both headline and core annual rates of inflation are rising again and financial conditions remain relatively loose.

The Bank of Canada is expected to hike for the first time ⁠in three years, however.

One possible shot across the bow there came from the other side of the world overnight, with New Zealand's central bank narrowly voting to keep its rates steady despite widespread expectations of another hike. That sent the kiwi dollar down more than 1%.

There's little reason for relief on ​energy ​prices, however, as Brent crude continues to push above $115 per barrel, with reports ​that the US is considering resuming attacks on Iran ‌after next week's midterms.

Elsewhere, Britain's usually anxious annual budget set piece has been defused somewhat by finance minister John Healey's signalling that no major changes to the government's tax, spend or borrowing programme are afoot.

To those outside the countries in question, any national budget can appear "boring", but this one is being deliberately billed as such.

CHART OF THE DAY

This year's Iran war has taken its toll on global energy prices and regional economies, but the damage to Iran's economy itself has been building for a decade and the Iranian rial has been in freefall for ‌most of that time.

Qatari mediators presented Iran with a new draft deal on ​Sunday to end the war with the US and Israel, and Tehran is expected ​to send a response to the draft by the end ​of the week.

Story Continues

President Trump, meantime, repeated threats to strike Iran again after next week's midterm elections, while Iranian ‌officials said Tehran had drawn up detailed plans to attack ​Gulf undersea cables if those attacks ​resume.

Today's events to watch

• Federal Reserve interest rate decision (2 p.m. EDT), Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference (2:30 p.m. EDT)

• US corporate earnings: Alphabet, Microsoft and others

• Bank of Canada interest rate decision (9:45 a.m. EDT)

• UK annual budget (8:30 a.m. EDT)

Want to receive the Morning ​Bid in your inbox every weekday morning? Sign ‌up for the newsletter here. You can find ROI on the Reuters website, and you can follow us on LinkedIn ​and X.

Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under ​the Trust Principles, is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

news.Title: 12 Companies That Launched Bitcoin Treasuries in 2025 Have Sold All Their Bitcoin. Here's the Potential Impact.
news.Content:
A dozen of the digital asset treasury (DAT) companies that started buying and holding Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) last year have already sold all their coins. According to Bitwise's October 2026 market report, the sales were mostly performed to repay debt or return cash to investors after their stocks fell.

Although this might seem bearish for Bitcoin, the reality is a bit sunnier, so let's analyze the impact of these treasury companies cashing out.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Corporate buyers absorbed about 18% of new Bitcoin supply in Q3

The 2025 class of DATs all followed the same game plan, which was pioneered by Strategy (NASDAQ: MSTR). That plan was to sell their shares or new debt to the market, use the proceeds to buy more coins, and then repeat while their stock traded above their coins' value; once that premium vanished, the script ran backward.

Sequans Communications , a chipmaker with a Bitcoin treasury, is an illustrative example. It launched its plan in June 2025, subsequently accumulating more than 3,200 coins, and by Sept. 24 of this year, it had sold the last of them after Bitcoin sales had already been used to eliminate its convertible debt.

Most of the sellers among the DATs probably took steep losses, as Bitcoin was in a bull market until October 2025, after which it entered into a bear market that sent its price below their cost basis. Public companies held Bitcoin at an average cost of $80,500 in September 2026, and that average includes the $75,412 per coin paid by Strategy, the biggest and first DAT.

So the rest paid more for their coins during the bull market, and then sold them in the bear market, when the price was lowest. It's often been said that the best approach is the opposite course of action: to buy low and then later sell high. That's easier said than done, apparently.

The more important point here is that all the selling those holders did ended up barely denting the coin's price.

In the third quarter of this year, Bitcoin's miners produced about 41,400 coins, so corporations absorbed a net of about 18% of new supply in that quarter. Meanwhile, other big buyers, like spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), acquired $6.4 billion worth of the crypto.

So the sellers never controlled much of the supply anyway, and now they're out of the market. That suggests the future impact of their sales is nil.

Story Continues

Can the biggest Bitcoin treasury company move the price?

The impact that smaller digital asset treasury companies had on Bitcoin's price is a different matter from the impact that Strategy has.

It held 848,517 coins as of Oct. 26, which is about 4% of Bitcoin's 21 million total supply limit. Although it has sold small portions of its coins from time to time, it controls enough of the supply that if it became a big seller, it would be a very big detriment to price.

Nonetheless, Strategy's size alone hasn't been able to impact the price via its purchases in instances where the market was already moving in the opposite direction. For instance, Strategy added 83,901 coins in Q2 2026, but Bitcoin still fell in June to its bear market depths, about 52% below its $126,080 peak. That doesn't particularly matter in the long run, as locking up more coins is still an upward pressure on price because it makes new buyers compete with each other to gain control of a portion of the supply.

A future DAT capable of moving the coin's price directly would need a huge stack, and, critically, it would need the nerve to keep buying through bear markets and dips, which Strategy has shown more consistently than its rivals. And matching Strategy's hoard would cost about $69.2 billion, which makes a new giant among cryptocurrency stocks unlikely anytime soon.

news.Title: ICM攜手康和投顧 聚焦美國陽光帶工業不動產市場
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-28 18:11:31 丁于珊 發佈

北美資產管理公司ICM Asset Management及旗下美國子公司ICM Realty Group宣布與康和投顧展開合作，聚焦美國陽光帶工業不動產市場，分享其對半導體、先進製造、航太國防及物流產業發展趨勢的觀察。

隨著全球供應鏈重組、美國製造業回流，以及半導體產業持續擴大在美投資，工業廠房、物流設施及供應鏈基礎建設需求受到市場關注。ICM認為，美國陽光帶地區具有人口成長、企業遷入及產業投資等長期動能，其中亞利桑那州鳳凰城已逐漸成為半導體與先進製造產業的重要聚落。

ICM指出，台積電(2330)持續擴大亞利桑那州投資，也使鳳凰城北部逐步形成半導體產業廊帶，帶動工業製造、倉儲物流及供應商設施等相關需求。鄰近台積電鳳凰城北部廠區的Halo Vista大型開發計畫，規劃涵蓋工業製造、辦公、零售、住宅及教育等多元用途，整體開發面積最高可達約279萬平方公尺；首期工業開發計畫預計興建七棟建築，總面積約7.25萬平方公尺。

ICM過去亦曾在鳳凰城地區參與多項工業不動產開發，包括位於西谷地區Loop 303交通廊帶、面積約27萬平方英尺的Glendale Industrial開發案，以及位於10號州際公路沿線、由兩棟建築組成、面積約25萬平方英尺的Buckeye Industrial開發案，分別於2022年及2024年出售。此外，ICM亦曾與Mack Real Estate成立合資事業，參與鄰近台積電鳳凰城廠區的Mack Innovation Park開發計畫，累積從投資機會辨識、土地開發、招商租賃至資產處分等實務經驗。

除鳳凰城外，美國陽光帶其他市場亦持續受惠於人口成長、企業遷入及製造業投資。德州奧斯汀及周邊成長廊帶受到科技與半導體產業發展帶動，三星電子位於泰勒市興建中的半導體廠，也為當地工業及物流市場帶來新的產業需求。佛羅里達州奧蘭多具備航太國防及工業發展基礎；北卡羅來納州及南卡羅來納州則受惠於港口物流、汽車與航太供應鏈，以及製造業持續移入。上述地區與喬治亞州共同構成美國陽光帶重要的產業及物流網絡。

根據ICM提供的2026年第三季市場資料，鳳凰城都會區就業人口約250萬人，過去一年增加約2.4萬個工作機會，人口成長速度約為全美平均的四倍。工業不動產市場方面，鳳凰城2026年第三季空置率降至10.3%；過去12個月淨吸納量達2,050萬平方英尺，超過同期新增供給900萬平方英尺的兩倍。其中，面積達30萬平方英尺以上的大型工業設施空置率為5.1%，反映大型製造及物流業者仍具空間需求。

除台積電擴大亞利桑那州投資外，英特爾（Intel）Fab 52晶圓廠的發展，亦預期持續帶動高薪就業及供應鏈企業進駐。根據相關產業資料，大鳳凰城地區航太與國防產業於2025年雇用約10萬8,377名員工，顯示當地產業結構已逐步涵蓋半導體、航太、國防科技、太空產業及新世代通訊等領域。

ICM Asset Management執行長、合夥人暨投資組合經理John Courtliff表示，ICM很高興與康和投顧展開合作，並期待將深耕北美多年的工業不動產經驗與市場觀察帶到台灣。他指出，鳳凰城的長期人口與就業成長，加上半導體、先進製造、航太國防及科技產業發展，正形成具實際企業需求支撐的工業市場。

ICM美國區合夥人暨董事總經理Spencer Patton表示，美國陽光帶工業不動產市場正逐步進入新的發展週期。經歷前一階段大量新增供給後，新建案開工速度已明顯放緩；另一方面，來自先進製造、半導體、航太國防、資料中心及製造業回流相關供應鏈的需求仍持續累積。

ICM Asia負責人暨共同董事總經理Stanley Kung(附圖右)表示，台灣及韓國對全球半導體供應鏈具有高度理解，而台積電與三星持續擴大美國投資，不僅帶動晶圓廠建設，也創造工業廠房、物流設施及供應商基礎建設需求。

ICM Asia共同董事總經理Pablo Romero(附圖中)表示，鳳凰城、奧斯汀、喬治亞州及南北卡羅來納州等市場，正處於科技發展、人口成長與工業需求交會的位置。ICM在北美工業不動產領域累積的經驗，也將成為其深化亞洲市場交流的重要基礎。

康和投顧董事長黎奕彬(附圖左)表示，台積電走向全球，不僅展現台灣產業的實力，也在海外帶動新的供應鏈及實體資產需求。此次與ICM合作，讓康和能以更宏觀的視角掌握台積電全球布局所帶動的產業發展，同時進一步強化國際視野與專業能力。康和也將持續響應政府推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，結合國際專業與在地能力，為台灣資產管理產業的深化與發展貢獻力量。
